Incident Description: During a communication tower warning light installation at 394 feet, Employee #1 fell approximately 300 feet to their death.  Employee #1 was descending the tower while Employee #2 remained near the top securing equipment.  The fall resulted from multiple injuries.

While collecting residential waste, a 20-year-old employee was struck and killed by a northbound semi-truck.  He was standing near the center line of the road, having just replaced a waste bin and waiting for southbound traffic to clear.  The impact caused fatal blunt force injuries.
A school crossing guard slipped on ice, hit his head on the curb, and was taken to the hospital. His condition worsened, and he passed away on February 4, 2016, from a subdural hemorrhage.

While repairing a mule corral, a Forestry Service employee was injured while lifting a bowed log with a grip hoist. The log shifted, striking the employee's head and causing a severe spinal cord injury. The employee became paralyzed and later died.

An employee, while retrieving a hoist using a mobile cart, was found unconscious in the cart, which had backed up to a set of stairs. His safety gear, including goggles and hard hat, was found nearby, indicating a possible fall.

A forklift operator was fatally injured while unloading a truck.  After raising a pallet, he exited the forklift to remove an airbag from beneath it. The forklift's load unexpectedly descended, crushing him between the pallet and the truck bed, causing blunt torso trauma and mechanical asphyxia.

While feeding metal into an unguarded metal form roll machine (RF18, serial #9770) during a supervisor-directed adjustment, an employee's gloved hand was caught in the moving parts, resulting in the amputation of three fingers and injuries to his hand and wrist.  He was transported to LAC+USC Medical Center for surgery.
An untethered employee fell from an order picker while lifting a 40-pound box of wine, sustaining fatal head, shoulder, arm, and hip injuries.  Death occurred 15 days later.

While installing insulated metal wall panels on a scissor lift during freezer/cooler construction, a worker was killed when high winds dislodged the panels from their temporary bracing, causing the lift to overturn. The insufficient bracing and lack of a fully enclosed building contributed to the collapse, resulting in the employee's fatal fall and blunt force trauma.
A volunteer firefighter and employee suffered a fatal cardiac arrest at home hours after responding to a business smoke alarm call.
An inmate ignited a trash can in Unit Tan 2, Block D's common area.  While a correctional officer extinguished the fire, the inmate assaulted and ultimately murdered her with the fire extinguisher.

During sanitary sewer line installation, a trench collapse occurred, trapping Employee #1. Despite a foreman's warning, Employee #1 was unable to escape the collapsing 13.5 foot trench near a gas line, resulting in a fatal accident. Employee #2 successfully escaped the trench unharmed.

On October 12, 2016, at approximately 1:15 p.m., an employee installing metal roofing panels fell through an opening in the roof, suffering fatal injuries. The employee, who was not wearing fall protection, fell approximately 20 feet to the concrete floor below, sustaining severe head trauma, a fractured arm, and a fractured leg.

While disconnecting a pressurized natural gas pipe without following lockout/tagout procedures, Employee #1 was struck in the face by released gas, resulting in fatal injuries.  The awkward working position exacerbated the risk.
A forklift operator accidentally reversed, striking a garage truck and door frame before pinning a nearby employee between the forklift and a dumpster, resulting in the employee's death.
While unloading a box truck, an employee was fatally struck when the driver reversed unexpectedly.

While preparing for a pump replacement on a 30,000-gallon anhydrous ammonia tank, a coworker partially drained the lines and loosened the pump bolts, noticing gas escaping before leaving the area.  A second employee, unaware of the leak and the loosened bolts, completed pump removal, resulting in anhydrous ammonia release and chemical burns to their hands, arms, and chin.

Two employees were fatally injured when the company-owned 2006 Chevy Equinox they were driving eastbound on the highway crossed the center line and collided with a pickup truck.  Both occupants were pronounced dead at the scene.

During a landslide at a landfill, a compacting equipment operator was buried under tons of garbage.  Recovery efforts located the employee deceased on February 10th, 2017; the cause of death was asphyxiation.

A 16-year-old employee was fatally crushed by a mobile home while attempting to mount axles beneath it. The mobile home, supported by temporary wood cribbing, shifted and collapsed, pinning the employee underneath. The employee died on-site from asphyxiation due to the injuries sustained.

A window cleaner fell 58.8 feet to his death while using a rooftop rigger that wasn't properly secured.  The rigger tipped over, causing the employee to fall despite being attached to a lifeline, and he died from blunt force neck injuries.  The counterweights were not used, and the rigger wasn't tied to a separate anchor point.

A 22-year-old engineer was electrocuted while working on a hydraulic cart. The cart was powered by a 480-volt 3-phase connection and had a reversed-polarity pigtail adapter. This energized a portion of the cart and hydraulic hoses, leading to the employee being electrocuted while handling the hoses.

While trimming a silver maple encroaching on 69kV power lines, a 25-year-old employee was electrocuted.  A 3.5-inch diameter limb, pushed away from the lines, unexpectedly swung back, contacting the lines during a windy period (8-13 mph WSW).

A 27-year-old electrician died at a worksite after becoming trapped and unconscious between a boom lift and a steel beam 20 feet high.  A coworker discovered him wedged against the beam, used the lift controls to lower him, and EMS performed unsuccessful CPR.  The coroner pronounced him dead at the scene.

A 30-year-old male laborer died suddenly at work after experiencing dizziness and cramps.  His lack of sweating prompted concern, and he collapsed shortly afterward.  The coroner attributed his death to hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, with a contributing factor of methamphetamine use.

A 35-year-old employee was fatally electrocuted while reaching through energized 480-volt wiring to close a guard on a plastic blow molding machine. The employee accidentally contacted the live conductors with his left arm, resulting in an entry wound on his arm and an exit wound on his head. The incident occurred without witnesses.

A 38-year-old male employee, working alone in a pressure release valve room, was fatally struck on the head by a steel coupling.  The coupling detached from a heavy steel pipe he was installing, apparently after he accidentally struck the pipe with the scissor lift he was using for access.

While two coworkers trimmed a tree, a 38-year-old ground worker suffered a fatal head injury.  A climber noticed him lying on the ground bleeding, and emergency services were called, but he later died from a skull fracture.

A 39-year-old demolition worker was killed while cutting a portion of an inner wall in a horizontal grain dryer. The section of the wall he cut became unstable and collapsed, crushing him. The wall section was approximately 28 feet long, 4 feet tall, and weighed 3,000 pounds. The accident occurred while the employee was working alone inside the partially demolished dryer.

A 39-year-old framing contractor employee fell 2.7 meters (9 feet) from unsecured roof joists onto the floor, sustaining a headache.  He was hospitalized overnight at Emanuel Hospital, and Oregon OSHA was notified.

A 41-year-old male employee was fatally injured when a 150-pound cart fell from a malfunctioning dump station table onto him while he was cleaning.  The incident resulted in a skull fracture and head injuries, and there were no witnesses.

A 42-year-old male employee suffered fatal blunt force head injuries when a pneumatic joint tester ruptured inside a confined space, releasing pressurized air and striking him.  The incident also resulted in rib and wrist fractures. He died five days later, on October 26, 2015.

A 43-year-old welder fell 45 feet to his death from a scaffold while working on a tank roof.  He had removed a scaffold board for access, allegedly also removing his safety harness.  The fall resulted from stepping too close to the resulting opening.
A 46-year-old male masonry worker suffered a fatal fall of approximately 49 feet from a tube and coupler scaffold onto a cement surface.  The impact resulted in immediate death.

A 48-year-old male employee operating a cherry picker at 26 feet fell to the concrete floor after a turret truck collided with the cherry picker's base.  He sustained fatal blunt force trauma to the head.

A 48-year-old male employee operating the CML2 production line was found unresponsive on the floor. CPR was administered, but he was pronounced dead at the local hospital. There were no witnesses to the incident.

A 50-year-old male employee operating a pneumatic platform to trim steel coils was fatally crushed.  A dislodged pneumatic hose caused the platform to drop, sending him into a scrap pit and into the baler.

A 51-year-old employee suffered severe hand injuries, including fingertip fractures and amputation, when his glove was caught in an unguarded electric roller while manually feeding material.  The incident occurred due to a lack of safety procedures, training, and machine guarding.  The roller was infrequently used, and no witnesses were present.

While removing railroad ties with a backhoe, a 52-year-old laborer was struck in the chest by a dislodged rail.  The rail, freed from a pile by the backhoe, swung unexpectedly, causing fatal injuries. The employee died at a local hospital.

A 53-year-old painter fell 4.5 meters from a scaffold after lowering planks, sustaining blunt force trauma to his torso.  He died the following day from multiple injuries including fractured ribs and sternum, lacerated liver and pancreas, and severe lung damage.

A 55-year-old woman died two days after suffering fatal head injuries in a fall while mopping a three-tier staircase at work.  Found unresponsive on the first landing with multiple skull fractures, there were no witnesses to the incident.
A 56-year-old employee operating an order picker fell 7.6 meters from an elevated platform onto concrete, sustaining fatal injuries.  He was not wearing the provided safety harness.

A 58-year-old mechanic was fatally injured while attempting to free a jammed log from a portable chipper.  While positioned between the feed roller and mill drum, the unlocked roller descended, crushing his lower body and causing severe trauma.  A coworker's attempt to lift the roller exacerbated the injuries, resulting in the mechanic's death.
A 62-year-old laborer on a county road crew widening a road was fatally struck by a backing dump truck.  He was pronounced dead at the scene.

A 63-year-old maintenance technician was fatally injured while repairing a hydraulic leak on a Bobcat skid steer.  While working under the machine's bucket, supported by jack stands, a hydraulic hose failed, causing the bucket to fall and crush him, resulting in compressional asphyxia.

A 64-year-old truck driver was fatally injured when he was struck by a moving semi-truck while uncoupling his trailer.  The driver of the other truck felt a bump, stopped, and discovered the victim pinned under his tandems. The victim sustained severe head and chest trauma.

During demolition, a collapsing masonry wall struck two employees.  One employee was fatally injured, while the other sustained severe injuries requiring hospitalization. The wall collapse occurred while a high-reach excavator was removing the building's roof.

While acting as a safety spotter on an overhead crane, a 68-year-old mechanic was fatally injured when the crane operator moved the crane as he dismounted, causing his leg to be crushed between the crane and the platform gate.  He suffered a fractured femur and hip, and succumbed to his injuries during subsequent surgery.

A 70-year-old man died from burns, broken bones, and internal bleeding after an explosion during a diesel fuel transfer between tanker trucks.  The explosion occurred while he was using a rubber hose and brass nozzle to transfer fuel through a top hatch.  He was knocked from the truck by the force of the blast.
A deceased individual was discovered inside a vehicle parked in a parking lot by a customer. The cause of death remains undetermined.

A carpentry employee, experiencing illness on the job site, left to seek medical attention. He drove himself to a convenience store but collapsed and was taken to the hospital, where he later passed away.

While carrying a bucket between car wash bays, an employee tripped, falling into a puddle containing a live extension cord.  Their foot became trapped between metal beams and wood, resulting in electrocution and death.
A gas station convenience store clerk was fatally shot during a robbery while working at the cash register.
During an overnight shift, a cashier was fatally shot by a customer who robbed the store.

While removing trash from a pull bar in front of a processor, a worker was fatally pinned between the pull bar and the blade of a moving Caterpillar log skidder.  The skidder's operator was unaware of the worker's presence behind the machine.

While inspecting an electrical panel in a partially enclosed alleyway behind a building under construction, a construction engineer fell 30 feet through a deteriorated plywood hatch cover lacking a top rail.  The fall resulted in severe injuries, including a fractured leg, ribs, and spine, a punctured lung, and facial lacerations, ultimately leading to his death two months later.

A contract employee working on a bridge construction project complained of feeling unwell and left the site to return to his hotel. He collapsed and was found unconscious in the hotel hallway, later declared dead by emergency services. While a heat-related injury was suspected, no autopsy was conducted.
While backing a trailer tandem, a contracted driver struck a parked empty trailer, causing it to crush and fatally injure Employee #1 between two trailers.

While a contractor and homeowner discussed a project, a temporary employee fell into a lake from a boat slip.  A search and rescue operation recovered the employee's body from the 7-8 foot deep water.  Emergency medical services were unable to revive the employee, who was pronounced dead at the scene.
During his shift, a convenience store clerk was fatally shot in the head during a robbery.  He died from his injuries.

An employee was found unresponsive with head trauma near a damaged ATV on the farm.  The medical examiner ruled the death an accidental result of an ATV accident; the employee apparently struck a ditch, causing the ATV to flip and roll.

A garbage truck, left unattended in neutral without the parking brake engaged, rolled downhill.  Two employees, working on opposite sides of the truck, chased it; one employee fell and was fatally injured when pinned between the truck and a telephone pole.

Following a coworker's assignment of trailer relocation to Employee #1, a loud noise was heard.  Upon investigation, Employee #1 was found unresponsive after the tractor-trailer he was moving had collided with another trailer.  Employee #1 sustained fatal blunt force and crushing injuries.

While unclogging shrubs under a running tractor equipped with a brush shedder, Employee #1 was run over by a wheel, sustaining broken ribs and collapsed lungs because the tractor's engine was not turned off and the power source disconnected.

While working 10 feet above ground, a coworker dropped a 24-foot wooden post he was drilling, striking an employee 24 feet away.  The falling post caused a broken rib and eardrum, resulting in hospitalization for the injured employee.

A crane, driven to a job site by its operator, became disabled on a highway shoulder. While a dispatched mechanic was working underneath it, a pickup truck veered onto the shoulder, striking and fatally injuring the mechanic.

A crane operator died from blunt force trauma after being pinned between a 61,670-pound steel coil he was lifting with a remote-controlled crane and other coils in the storage area.  The accident occurred while moving the coil from a storage field to the facility's curt line.

A crane operator was moving a heavy steel coil when it fell from the clamp, striking another coil. This impact caused a chain reaction, knocking a third coil onto the operator, who was walking nearby. The operator was fatally crushed between the coils.

A carpenter working on the fifth story of an apartment building fell to his death after a makeshift brace he was using for support gave way. The brace, constructed of a 2x4 nailed to a column, failed when the carpenter leaned too far out, causing him to fall five stories. He sustained multiple injuries and died despite receiving immediate medical attention.

While paving a rural road near a railroad crossing, a dump truck driver, backing up to deliver asphalt, was struck by a train.  Despite warnings from coworkers and the train's horn, the driver, likely unable to hear over his truck's engine, was killed instantly by the impact. The truck was pushed approximately 40 feet.

While dismantling a quality lab, an employee removing screws from a metal roof panel stepped on the panel, causing it to collapse. He fell six feet and was impaled by a measurement tool, resulting in fatal injuries.

While loading logs with a Bobcat, a foreman accidentally struck and fatally injured a crew member who was standing near the dump truck.  A log being loaded rolled off the truck's side, impacting the employee.

Two temporary employees, working unsupervised at a concrete recycling plant, were operating a horizontal shaft impactor.  While one employee was servicing the machine's interior after shutting it down, a hydraulic line failed, causing the rear door to close and fatally injure him.  The other employee discovered the accident and called for emergency services.

During roadbed compaction work, a road roller operated by Employee #1 overturned on its side, falling approximately 24 feet.  The ROPS crushed Employee #1's upper chest and neck, resulting in a fatal cervical spine fracture.

While cutting an overhanging tree limb with a chainsaw atop a brush pile, an employee was struck by the limb when it snapped above his cut.  This resulted in a fractured heel and wrist, requiring hospitalization.

An inexperienced electrical contractor employee, working on relocating a junction box high above the ground, fell from a makeshift scaffold while attempting to reach the box. The employee, who was relying on a foreman to shut off power to the junction box, lost his balance while sitting on an I-beam and fell, fatally striking his head on the electrical panel and then the concrete floor. The incident highlights the dangers of working at heights, inadequate safety procedures, and the lack of proper training and supervision.

During land clearing, a falling tree branch struck and fatally injured a chainsaw operator.  The branch, from a tree being lowered by an excavator, hit the employee in the head causing a skull fracture and ultimately cardiac arrest. The excavator operator did not see the employee before the tree fell.

While cutting an iron pipe in an 11-foot trench with a Hilti Cut-Off Saw, an employee suffered a fatal neck injury.  The saw, which had a rock lodged in the blade, apparently kicked back after the blade became caught, resulting in the employee being struck.  The exact moment of impact was not witnessed.

While rigging a large bridge girder in a paint shop, a crane hook snagged the girder's bottom flange during unhooking. This caused the girder to tip over, striking and fatally injuring an employee, and also knocking over two adjacent girders.  The incident involved two crane operators and occurred during a tandem lift.

At 6:44 p.m., a tow truck driver was dispatched to assist a stranded motorist.  While attaching the customer's vehicle on I-65's emergency lane at approximately 7:37 p.m., a northbound vehicle left the roadway and fatally struck the driver.

While assisting with loading freight, a dockworker was struck by falling cargo when the securing bands broke.  The accident resulted in head injuries and a fractured right ankle, requiring a two-day hospital stay.
While unloading fiberglass camper shells from a curtain-sided semi-trailer, the driver fell, striking his head on the pavement.

A delivery driver, carrying coffee and a donut, suffered a compound ankle fracture when struck by a 200-lb box in a warehouse aisle.  The box, left by a contractor group, fell from a stack improperly placed on the opposite side of the aisle. The employee required a six-day hospital stay.
While walking to a ride home after her employer ended work early due to heat, a vineyard worker suffered chest pains, became unresponsive, and despite CPR attempts, died of natural causes.

A farm employee riding rear-facing in a company minivan was ejected and killed when the vehicle accelerated unexpectedly.  The rear doors were unlatched, causing him to fall and strike his head on the pavement.  He suffered fatal head trauma.

While preparing a hay bale for processing, a farmworker was caught between the bale and the machine's knives.  The resulting injuries, including a lower leg amputation and severe torso trauma, proved fatal.

During a live burn training exercise, a firefighter tripped and fell while deploying a hose line inside a burn building.  The fall, caused by the hose's recoil, resulted in a fractured fibula, subsequent bilateral pulmonary emboli, and ultimately, the firefighter's death.

At 9:30 a.m., while filling a bucket with water from a CIFA K47X/RZ concrete pumper truck, an employee was fatally injured.  The employee was pinned between a retracting outrigger and the truck body, sustaining severe head trauma.
A food truck worker became sick while cleaning the stove, was taken to the hospital for exposure to toxic fumes, and unfortunately passed away.

A construction worker was hit and killed by a passing pickup truck while working on removing a telephone pole with his foreman using a mounted truck. The incident occurred in the East bound lane, partially blocking traffic.

Employee #1 and Employee #2 were sent by a foreman from the fourth floor to the first floor of a 100-year-old building. Unfortunately, the floors collapsed, leading to debris falling on both employees. Tragically, Employee #1 lost their life, while Employee #2 suffered a broken foot and back injury, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was injured while trying to disconnect a tow chain between two forklifts. The towing forklift unexpectedly moved backwards, pinning the employee between the two machines. The employee suffered dislocated ribs and a bruised lung as a result.

While removing carpet bails from a stack 9.5 feet high at a recycling facility, a forklift operator accidentally dislodged one, causing it to fall. In attempting to stop the falling bails, the employee sustained multiple bone fractures to his arms, back, and legs.
A forklift struck a stack of 4 x 8 sheets of melamine paneling and the material fell on and crushed the employee.

A worker at a gas processing plant was fatally injured in a flash fire while attempting to ignite a flare that was not burning. The worker suffered severe burns to over 60 percent of his body during the incident.

An employee driving a John Deere riding lawn mower down a wet 25-degree embankment slipped on the grass, causing the mower to tip over and crush him underneath, resulting in fatal thoracic injuries. The incident occurred during the employee's normal task of mowing the area, and he was working alone at the time.

A grocery store employee suffered a serious injury when he reached over to the right while stocking inventory and fell from the third step of a 26 inch step ladder. The employee was transported to a medical center and was treated for a fractured tibia, fibula, and related leg injuries.

During maintenance at a residential subdivision lake, two employees in a sinking boat called for help from coworkers on another boat. Two employees on shore attempted to swim to the sinking boat but tragically drowned before reaching it. The workers on the sinking boat were rescued, while Employee #1 and #2 were found by a dive team in 10 feet of water.

During a routine engine service on a 40-ton Kumatsu articulator earth mover, a heavy equipment mechanic's hand was severely injured when the cab of the vehicle fell on it after a chain and hook used to lift the cab became dislodged. The employee sustained severe lacerations and ligament damage as a result.
A homeless person was on the public sidewalk and he was found under a collapsed scaffold that was constructed on the side walk to protect the public. It is unknown as to why the scaffold collapsed.

A job superintendent was measuring structural supports over a hotel swimming pool for skylight installation. He set up a ladder in the drained pool, climbed it to tear a hole in the drywall for measurements, but fell approximately 17 to 19 feet and hit his head at the bottom of the pool, resulting in severe head injury and memory loss. Investigation revealed the ladder may have slipped from under him during the incident.

A Kamatsu excavator had a hydraulic line rupture, causing the bucket to drop on an employee striking the back of his head and neck. The employee suffered from blunt force trauma and was transported to the hospital, where he died.

A landscaping employee was standing in the street behind a work truck. The truck was struck by another vehicle and then struck the employee. The employee was taken to the hospital and died from blunt trauma to the chest and abdominal injuries. The driver of the vehicle did not see the employee or work truck.

While hand polishing a metal cylinder on a CNC lathe, a lathe operator became entangled in the running equipment. Despite being transported to a local hospital, the employee succumbed to multiple blunt force injuries.

While standing in the bucket of a front end loader, a loader operator employee was trimming a branch at a height of 10 to 12 feet. Unbeknownst to the operator, a chain was attached to the limb and the loader bucket. The employee believed the branch was to be partially cut and then pulled down with the bucket. However, when the loader moved, the branch snapped, pinning the employee against the bucket. The employee fell out of the bucket and ultimately succumbed to blunt

While troubleshooting a machine, a machine operator accidentally activated it while washing parts with hot water, resulting in Employee #1 being burned on the wrists, hands, cheek, and forehead. Employee #1 was hospitalized for second degree burns to his left hand.

A maintenance employee was clearing a jam on a dryer door while standing on an elevated conveyor, approximately eight feet above the floor. The computer-operated dryer system activated the conveyor, propelling the employee into rotating Dryer Number 11. Despite being rescued alive, the employee ultimately succumbed to their injuries and passed away on August 27, 2015 from a head injury.

A maintenance employee was installing a guard on the right side of a vat drier washer machine #116. An accident took place and the employee sustained a pulmonary embolism and second and third degree burns on the chest, right arm, torso and right foot during the install. install.

The maintenance technician was working alone to install a hydraulic hoist cylinder on a 2,000-pound automatic dock platform. While underneath the platform, it unexpectedly fell and struck him, causing multiple blunt force injuries. Tragically, the technician later succumbed to his injuries and passed away.

A maintenance worker fell from a ladder while hanging a sign outside a store, sustaining injuries to his head and shoulder. Although he received medical evaluation, he was not hospitalized. Unfortunately, his health deteriorated after returning to work and he ultimately passed away.

A masonry employee, was working from 2 x 10 #2 lumber wooden platform on a tubular welded frame scaffold assembly installing a masonry facade for a chimney.The wooden platform broke mid point and the employee fell 28 feet to the ground. The employee was killed from multiple broken bones. en bones.

The mechanic was operating a Mitsubishi forklift to raise a trailer when it fell from the forks and pinned him underneath. He suffered fatal injuries, including fractures to his skull, vertebrae, and ribs, leading to his death.
A mechanic was walking out a when a bus drove out of the wash facility, struck and killed the mechanic.
A painter who was served legal papers returned to work and shot employees in the workplace. The painter was shot by police and died.

A pedestrian sat on a side walk next to a trench box, 10 foot by 10 foot, weighing approximately 4,000 pounds. He had been warned earlier to stay out of the area.  An excavator knocked over the trench box which crushed and killed the pedestrian.
A piece of metal steel fell on to the hand of an employee inspecting a piece of metal. The metal lacerated three of the employee's fingers. The employee was hospitalized for the amputation.

The printing press operator left work to get sinus medicine, returned, punched in, then punched out moments later and drove to a secluded corner of the company parking lot where he shot himself in his pick-up truck.
A project manager employee died from a heart attack.

A property manager arrived at a residence alone to conduct a property inspection after the tenant moved out. Unfortunately, a gas leak from a removed gas dryer caused an explosion that resulted in fatal injuries to the property manager.

An employee failed to use a warning device to alert a powered industrial truck operator that they were in a freezer compartment. The operator, with obstructed vision, entered the freezer and struck the employee, resulting in multiple fractures of the left foot. Despite being trained and certified, the operator was involved in the accident.

A roofer fell approximately 15 feet through a hole on the roof to the concrete floor of the building. Other employees called emergency personnel. The employee was killed due to head, neck and back injuries.

A roofer was installing a self-adhering membrane on a sloped roof. While trimming the membrane, he walked backwards, reached the roof edge, and fell off. He suffered severe injuries including head trauma, a collapsed lung, and broken bones.

While applying aluminum fiber coating on a row home roof, a roofer inadvertently touched overhead 7,200 volt powerlines with a 10-foot extension pole attached to a 28-foot tall ladder. The contact caused the roofer to fall onto a concrete sidewalk, resulting in electrocution.

During a roofing job, an employee was lowering tool bags from the roof using a materials hoist. The employee was on a commercial flat roof with two coworkers who were also finishing up for the day. As the employee was lowering the tool bags with a Garlock Equipment Company Swing Hoist, the boom assembly tipped over the edge of the roof, causing the employee to fall to the ground and sustain a fatal traumatic brain injury.

A sand truck driver employee was found dead in his truck after unloading frac sand on a hot day at a frac site. The employee had been outside for over an hour watching gauges on the truck before pulling over to report feeling very hot and in need of water. It is suspected that the employee may have become overheated while working in the hot weather during the unloading process.

While trying to adjust a malfunctioning positioning pin on the Pre-Position Infeed Table at the Gang Saw, an employee's coat got caught in an unguarded rotating sprocket, causing him to become entangled in the equipment. Tragically, he suffered fatal injuries including broken ribs, a broken sternum, collapsed lungs, and loss of consciousness.

While helping students board buses parked at the curb, a school employee was tragically hit and killed when one of the buses unexpectedly moved forward onto the sidewalk. The reasons behind the bus's sudden movement remain unclear.

A security officer was out on routine patrol at a downtown business parking structure in Bloomington, IL. The employee was found unresponsive on the first level of the parking garage by two coworkers walking to their cars. The employee died as a result of head injuries sustained in a fall.
A self-employed, sole proprietor working as a handyman collapsed and died from a heart attack.
A service technician was accessing a stairwell when he fell, sustaining a cut on his head, broken ribs and a ruptured spleen. He was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

An employee of the sewer department was fatally struck and run over by a 1997 GNC 8500 Cabover truck equipped with a Safejet water jetting system used for flushing municipal sanitary sewers. The truck was controlled by an Allison Transmission and had a CS10 Series Power Take Office.
A skidder operator left the skidder and was struck by it, causing fatal head trauma.

While transporting limbed trees to the landing area, a skidder operator mistakenly picked up a tree that had not been limbed, not realizing an employee was using a chainsaw within the canopy. The skidder operator dragged the tree out before realizing the mistake and dropping it to the side of the path. Unfortunately, Employee #1 had been dragged 35 feet and sustained a fatal neck injury from the chainsaw during the incident.
A slitter machine operator was caught in an unguarded rotating drum of the coil rewinding slitter machine and the employee was killed.
While supervising adolescents in a residential treatment facility, a staff member was fatally attacked by a resident with a rebar fire poker, resulting in fatal head injuries.
A store cashier was killed during an armed robbery.
A store manager was using a ladder that was too short to remove something from a shelf. The store manager jumped while on top of the ladder and fell, breaking his left leg.

The superintendent was driving an ATV with three employees as passengers on a dry river bed when the vehicle crashed into an embankment at high speed. Employee #1 was fatally injured and the three other employees sustained injuries from being ejected from the ATV.

A supervisor and Employee #1 were using a Toyota forklift to transport a wooden crate of plate glass to a loading dock. Employee #1 stood on the forks to stabilize the load, but when they were close to the dock, the load shifted and fell onto Employee #1, causing fatal injuries.

During the construction of a new water retention pond, a team of two employers and three workers were working on installing an 8 foot diameter PVC drainage pipe. The crew was digging a trench for the pipe in three sections, with Employee #1 in the trench while the others assisted. Tragically, the trench collapsed unexpectedly, burying Employee #1 and leading to their death from suffocation.

A temporary employee was using a metal sample rod to retrieve a sample from a powder pigment steel blending tank under a nitrogen blanket. The employee accidentally dropped the equipment into the tank and while trying to retrieve it, fell halfway into the tank and could not be pulled out, resulting in death due to asphyxia from an oxygen-deficient atmosphere. The coworker who was assisting the employee was also a temporary hire.

A temporary employee at a distribution center was instructed to move to a new work station, which required her to cross a bridge and descend a ladder. She fell approximately 4 feet to the concrete floor below and fractured her right shin. Emergency services were called and she was hospitalized for treatment. Investigation revealed she had not received training on ladder safety.

While operating a roll sorting machine at a facility, a temporary employee's hand became caught between two cylinders when attempting to clear a jam. The employee suffered injuries to her hand and wrist, requiring hospitalization and treatment.

A temporary employee at a hatchery suddenly fell ill while working and emergency services were called. Despite efforts to resuscitate him for 20 minutes, the employee passed away on site. The cause of death was determined to be Mitral Valve Prolapse, a preexisting medical condition.

A bakery delivery truck became stuck in mud, prompting a tow truck service to assist in moving it. An employee passing by offered to help, and together with the tow truck driver, they attempted to free the truck. Unfortunately, the employee became pinned between the two vehicles and tragically lost his life due to severe injuries.
During the setup of a construction zone on the subway tracks, a transit employee was tragically struck and killed by a subway train while placing warning lights.

While securing a lock on a dumpster after emptying it into the trash truck, a chain broke and struck a trash collection employee in the head, resulting in a fatal injury. The incident occurred when the lift hook of the driver's side chain caught on the truck frame.

During a tree trimming operation, a crew of five employees were removing debris and damage caused by a hurricane. One coworker was climbing a tree, while another was working out of a bucket truck cutting down a branch from a live oak. The employee being trained to climb trees walked towards the skid steer operator, passing underneath the coworker working in the bucket. As the coworker cut a branch, it swung towards the employee, striking them in the face and chest. The employee suffered fatal injuries and

Employee #1, a tree worker, was part of a crew tasked with removing 54 Ponderosa Pine trees from a site. With a Foreman overseeing operations, Employee #1 was assigned as the feller and worked with two ground men. While removing one of the last four trees on 05/04/16, Employee #1 was crushed between the tree and a large boulder resulting in fatal blunt force head and neck trauma.

A truck driver and forklift operator were unloading heavy metal pipes from a flatbed trailer. The pipes were stacked vertically in three rows, with the top row containing two 25-foot long pipes and the bottom and middle rows holding four 40-foot long pipes each. Made of high density polyethylene, the pipes weighed approximately 1,100 pounds each. Tragically, during the unloading process, a pipe fell from the trailer and struck the truck driver, resulting in a fatal injury

During the offloading of two Tigercat grapple skidders from a semi-truck and detachable gooseneck lowboy trailer, the truck driver started reattaching the trailer on an incline with a steep grade. Unfortunately, the truck and trailer began to roll downhill towards a highway, fatally running over the truck driver. The investigation showed that the brakes were not set and the trailer was not chocked, leading to the tragic incident.

A truck driver at PEER 48 arrived to deliver a container in a stable gravel yard. The employee lined up the container for unloading and was crushed and killed when the truck and trailer rolled backwards while disconnecting the cable. Camera footage showed the tragic incident unfold.

A truck driver delivered a JLG Telehandler to a rental company on a step-deck trailer. The driver backed the trailer against an offloading platform, and an employee of the rental company began to back the machine off the trailer. As the machine engaged its auto-leveling system, the pressure caused the work-lights to be sheared off and hit the truck driver in the face, causing him to fall off the loading dock.

A truck driver delivering soy bean oil to an industrial facility fell from a ladder attached to the tanker truck, resulting in fatal injuries. Despite successfully descending the ladder once, the driver climbed it again and lost his balance at the top, falling approximately eleven feet to the concrete below. Emergency services were unable to revive him, and he was pronounced dead at the scene due to skull fractures and brain contusions.

A truck driver was found unconscious next to his rig by a coworker and emergency services were unable to revive him. Investigation revealed that he had been transferring tools between trucks when he suffered a fatal cardiac arrest.

The truck driver was discovered unconscious after falling from a semi-truck trailer he was loading. He was airlifted to a nearby medical center where he tragically passed away the following day due to severe head injuries. The investigation determined that he had been securing loads on the trailer with ratchet tie-downs before the fall occurred.

An employee was caught between two belly dump trailers while a truck driver was trying to hook up the Mack truck to one of the trailers. The employee was pinned in between the trailers and was found in that position.

The truck driver uncoupled the tractor from the trailer and as he was attempting to do so, the tractor began to roll down a hill. The brake lines between the tractor and trailer broke, causing the tractor brakes to engage. The driver was thrown from the tractor and landed beside the cab, resulting in a fatal heart attack.

During Rough Ocean Water Rescue Training with a personal watercraft (PWC) equipped with a sled, an employee was found face down in the ocean after cresting a wave. Tragically, he had suffered fatal injuries including blunt force trauma to his head, cervical fractures, and damage to his spine.
A vehicle rolled down hill and pinned the employee between two vehicles. The employee was killed.

During a washout of the pre-mix kettle on Ribbon 1, hot water overflowed and spilled onto an employee, causing first and second degree burns to his back, chest, and arms. The incident occurred when the employee attempted to clear a clog in a 2 inch pipe using a pressurized air hose, but mistakenly connected the hose to the pre-mix kettle instead.

A work crew from Hi-Way Safety Systems was striping I93 Northbound at Exit 33, with MassDOT using message boards to warn drivers. Safety measures were in place, including cones, signs, and attenuator trucks. Tragically, Employee #1 was killed by a drunk driver who entered the work zone, while another worker was injured by the same car.
A worker and a coworker were installing shingles from a pump-jack scaffold at a residential site when the worker suffered a seizure and fell to the ground, resulting in his death.

An employee working in an office lab within a paint room left to use the restroom and did not return. A coworker found the worker unconscious in the restroom, and the worker was taken to a nearby medical facility where he passed away the next day. An investigation determined that the cause of death was a non-work related drug overdose, as confirmed by an autopsy. The worker was being treated for diabetes.

During a tree felling operation, a worker was struck by a tree while talking to a coworker. The worker suffered severe head trauma and was placed on life support before succumbing to his injuries four days later.

A worker and part-owner of a facility was operating a motorized security gate to exit the parking lot. Unfortunately, she became pinned between the gate and an electrical box, resulting in asphyxiation. Emergency services were contacted upon her body being discovered, but she died from the injuries sustained.
A worker became disoriented while at work. Unable to clock out from work, the worker laid down on a work couch and never woke up. The worker was found dead the next day.
A worker fell from a warehouse mezzanine, striking the floor. He was transported to a nearby hospital, where he was treated and died four days later.

The worker was killed in a car accident shortly after leaving work. The investigation showed that the worker crossed into the opposite lane and over corrected, causing his vehicle to drive into a canal. He sustained fatal injuries in the accident.

A worker delivering liquid asphalt at a worksite was found unconscious with a head injury next to a tanker truck. Despite being rushed to the hospital, the worker ultimately passed away the following day from head trauma. The incident appeared to be the result of a fall, but there were no witnesses to confirm the cause.

The worker was affixing a radial band around steel coils on a coil car when one of the coils fell off and struck him. The force of the impact caused severe injuries, including a crushed chest, abdomen, and left arm, as well as partial amputation of his right arm and fractures to his left leg. Tragically, the worker succumbed to his injuries and passed away as a result of the incident.
A worker was applying a lacquer sealer to the floor of a residential home when he collapsed to the floor. The worker died of a heart attack.

A worker assisting with framing work at a construction site in direct sunlight became ill and disoriented while lifting heavy materials for coworkers. Emergency services were called, and the worker passed away at a nearby hospital two hours later. Investigation showed the worker had a high temperature and severe dehydration, leading to cardiac arrest.

While nailing a bottom plate into a header board at a residential construction site, a worker accidentally triggered a nail gun which punctured his right thigh. After being treated at two hospitals, the worker developed thrombosis which led to his death after falling and hitting his head at home.

A worker was bucking a tree that had been felled and was caught in between some other trees. As the worker cut the tree in half, tension was released and a portion of the tree was ejected, striking and killing the worker.

A worker was carrying a 20-foot-long ladder, with a 20 foot extension, up a staircase when the ladder contacted an electrical line and was electrocuted. The electrical line was energized, carrying 13,200 volts of electricity.
A worker was carrying cinder block bricks when he suffered a heart attack and died.

The worker was tragically struck and killed by an industrial tow tractor while crossing the street to access his assigned vehicle at the beginning of his shift. The incident occurred as the tractor driver was searching for a trailer and did not see the worker in the path.

While attempting to charge the battery of a power driven air compressor using a Toro Workman maintenance cart, a worker revved the cart's engine to speed up the charging process. Tragically, the cart lurched forward, pinning the worker between it and a work table lift, causing fatal injuries including a crushed artery and severe lacerations.
A worker was checking email in an office building when chemicals caught fire and the building exploded. The worker was engulfed by flames and smoke. The worker was killed in the explosion.

A worker was cleaning the area around a grease fitting associated with a drive shaft, when his jacket became caught on the collar bolts that were affixed to the rotating shaft.  The worker was pulled into the machinery, suffering multiple contusions to his upper body, which resulted in his death.

A worker was cleaning up sand near a wall of sand bags that were stacked two high. Sand from a bag at the bottom level spilled, causing the bags on top to fall on top of the worker. The worker was trapped under approximately 4,000 pounds of sand bags and died.

A worker was climbing a ladder to bring down materials from a roof.As he was on the ladder the worker stated that he didn't feel well and then fell to the ground. The worker was killed as a result of broken ribs and a collapsed lung. ribs and a collapsed lung.

A worker was climbing a utility pole to perform maintenance.  As he was climbing the pole, he slipped and fell to the ground.  Emergency services were contacted However, the worker died as a result of his injuries.

The worker fell from a height of 26 feet while climbing the end frame of a scaffold to reach the fourth level where he would be working. There was no access ladder provided to reach the platform, and as the worker reached for the guard rail post it became dislodged, causing him to fall to the ground. The worker suffered severe fractures and other internal injuries that ultimately led to his death.

The worker was climbing the tow bar of a truck with an aerial bucket attached, towing a wood chipper while the vehicle was in motion. As the worker fell to the ground, they were tragically run over by the right-side tires of the wood chipper, resulting in their immediate death due to the crushing weight of the machine.

While collecting residential garbage and recyclables, a worker was fatally struck by another vehicle while emptying a trash bin in the rear of a Mack truck. The worker sustained multiple fractures and trauma to his head, neck, and upper torso as a result of the accident.

The worker was conducting electrical work on a vessel and pulled a communication wire from the main distribution power panel. He then fashioned a coil and climbed inside the energized panel for an unknown reason, resulting in him being electrocuted.

A worker was fatally crushed between two log trailers when a truck driver accidentally backed too close to the stationary trailer the worker was standing next to. The worker was waiting to unhook the trailer from the moving vehicle when the tragic accident occurred. The force of the impact pinned the worker's head between the two trailers, resulting in their death.
A worker was cutting a tree limb from an elevated location in a tree when his safety rope snapped.  The worker fell to the ground and died as a result of his injuries.
A worker was cutting hay with farm equipment when he suffered a hypertensive pontine hemorrhage, resulting in his death. The worker was found dead in the cab of the farm equipment.
A worker was descending a 6-foot-ladder when he fell, striking his head on the ground. The worker died as a result of head trauma. There were no witnesses to the incident.

The worker fell from a ladder while descending, hitting his head on a brick-paved driveway below, resulting in a fatal head injury. The incident investigation revealed that the worker was carrying materials while climbing the ladder.

While detailing a car at a car wash, a worker was tragically run over by a customer's vehicle as it exited the car wash area. The worker was struck and dragged 90 feet, resulting in his death due to severe lacerations and fractures.
A worker was directing the operations at a recycling yard when he was struck by a payloader that was backing up. He suffered multiple broken bones and internal injuries, resulting in his death.

A worker was dismounting a tire from a rim, when he unintentionallystruck his face with a spoon bar. He suffered contusions on his face and chin, which resulted in his death. on his face and chin, which resulted in his death.

A worker was disposing of trash into a compacter when he suffered a heart attack.  The worker was found unconscious and emergency services were contacted. He was taken to a nearby hospital where he was determined to be dead.

A worker hired through a temporary employment agency suffered a heart attack while working at a construction site. He was hospitalized and later died as a result of the heart attack. It is unclear whether the heart attack was related to his work duties.
A worker was empting trash cans into the rear of a garbage truck when a motor vehicle struck him from behind. He was killed. The worker suffered blunt force trauma injuries to his hip and ribs.

A worker was erecting a scaffold in an elevator shaft. As he installed the scaffold planking, he fell through an unsecured section of railing and struck the elevator pit floor. The worker died as a result of his injuries.
A worker was exiting a gas station store when he was struck and killed by a commercial vehicle in the parking lot.

A worker was fatally struck in the head by a poplar tree while felling it, causing it to raise about 12 feet in the air before falling on him. The incident occurred when the poplar tree struck a neighboring birch tree. Emergency services were called, but the worker was pronounced dead upon arrival.
A worker was found dead as a result of a gunshot wound. The worker had been in the office the night before for an unknown reason.
A worker was found dead inside the sleeper of the semi-truck he was operating. The cause of death was unknown.

A worker was gathering logs and brush that had accumulated around a stump grinder in operation. The worker tripped and fell head first into the rotating blade of the auger, becoming entangled and suffering multiple injuries.  He died as a result of his injuries.
A worker was hoisting plywood to the roof where he was standing when he fell 22-feet to his death.

A worker was inside an electrical control room, taking photographs of electrical panels. The worker collapsed and died when he suffered an acute sub-arachnoid hemorrhage following a cerebral aneurysm. He was discovered lying facedown in the electrical room.
A worker was inspecting a food processing plant when he experienced a terrible head ache and passed out.  He was taken to a nearby hospital where he later died of a brain aneurism.

A worker inspecting a telecommunication tower attached himself to the tower with a lanyard before boarding the elevator to access it. After completing the inspection, he forgot to unhook the lanyard before boarding the elevator back down. The lanyard pulled him out of the elevator, causing him to be crushed between the elevator and tower, resulting in fatal head, neck, and upper torso injuries.

A worker inspecting a telecommunications tower used the tower's elevator to access it safely. After completing the inspection, the worker forgot to unhook his safety lanyard from the tower before boarding the elevator. As the elevator descended, the lanyard pulled the worker out, causing fatal head, neck, and upper torso injuries. Tragically, the worker died as a result.

During a routine inspection, a worker noticed a safety issue with a crane in operation that was at risk of striking another stationary crane. As he attempted to notify the crane operator, he was tragically pinned between the two cranes, resulting in multiple fractures and internal injuries that ultimately led to his death.
A worker was inspecting welds when he contacted an overhead drop light and was electrocuted.
A worker was installing a small piece of sheet metal on the parapet coping of a roof.  He fell from the roof and was killed as a result of blunt force trauma.

During the installation of a vinyl sign on a billboard, a worker was electrocuted when a steel conduit he was handling came into contact with a 7.2 kV electrical distribution line. The worker fell from an aluminum extension ladder and tragically passed away as a result of the incident.

A worker was installing an air conditioning unit on the roof of a residence when he was struck by lightning.  He fell from the roof approximately 20 feet and struck  the ground. The worker died as a result of his injuries that included electric shock and blunt force trauma.

The worker was installing metal panels on the roof when he unhooked his lifeline and fell 36 feet to the ground, suffering fatal head and body trauma. The foreman onsite witnessed the tragic incident.
A worker was involved in an altercation and was stabbed. The worker went to a nearby medical center, where he later died of his injuries.
A worker was killed as a result of a crushing incident.
A worker was killed when collecting trash from a residential area. .  As he was walking across the street with a trash can in hand, a pickup truck struck and killed the worker.

A worker was kneeling down in front of the right rear tire of a log truck. The driver did not realize the worker was so close to the truck and drove it forward, crushing and killing the worker. worker.

The worker was reported missing after being the last person on site at Hood Canal Bridge. His coworkers discovered the employee gate open and the pedestrian barrier damaged the next morning. Emergency services were called, and the worker was tragically found dead in his truck 340 feet below the bridge, revealing that he had driven off the bridge.
A worker was leaving work when he was stabbed by a homeless person.  The worker died as a result of his injuries.

A worker was lifting an aluminum walk board that was being used as a concrete form. A gust of wind knocked him off balance, and he fell through an existing rusted opening in an original metal roof. He landed on a concrete floor. He sustained a head injury, and he was killed.

A worker was attempting to provide a jump start to a skid steer using a Rent-A-Lift Sky Trak. As he reached into the engine compartment with jumper cables, his coworker accidentally lowered the skid steer, crushing the worker between the engine compartment and the boom. Tragically, the worker died from his injuries.
A worker was located below a scaffold system that was being dismantled when he was struck by a falling plank. The plank his the back of the worker's neck, killing him.

A worker was located on a roof, measuring an area, when he fell through a sky light. He fell approximately 15 feet, suffering a head injury and multiple broken bones. He was taken to a nearby hospital where he was treated for his injuries, however,  he died soon after being admitted. ted.

The worker fell 13 feet from the second story of a barn while removing floorboards, landing face first on a concrete surface. He suffered multiple fractures to his head, ribs, and face, and was pronounced dead at a nearby hospital.
A worker was moving a ladder when it came into contact with an electrical wire from a utility pole. The worker was electrocuted as a result.
A worker was moving stacked grills when one fell on one of his legs.  The worker sustained a fractured leg, which he was hospitalized for treatment.
A worker was moving utility poles from a mill to be loaded onto a trailer.  As the worker was rolling one of the wood utility poles from the mill, he was crushed and killed.

A worker was operating a cable system on an elevated catwalk platform to transfer grain into semi-trailers. The platform, which was about 10.5 feet above the ground, had guardrails on all sides except for an open end with a ladder. The worker fell from the platform while operating the system and tragically passed away due to multiple injuries sustained in the fall.

A worker was operating a Caterpillar D5K2 LGP bulldozer to finish dressing the ground between a parking lot and a retention pond.  For an unknown reason, the worker backed the bulldozer into the retention pond until it was completely submerged, and he drowned.

The incident involved a worker operating a Caterpillar tractor with a shank attached to rip a ditch in the soil. The shank struck an underground natural gas pipeline, causing a spark and igniting a fire. The worker was tragically killed in the flames.

A worker operating a Ford tractor with a bush hog mower attached struck a rock in a mine field, causing the tractor to traverse over a depression in the field. The worker, not wearing a seat belt, was ejected from the tractor and subsequently run over by both the tractor and the bush hog, resulting in fatal injuries to his skull, left arm, and right leg.
A worker was operating a forklift. As the forklift was still moving, the worker jumped to the ground for an unknown reason. The forklift struck the worker and ran over his left side, killing him.

While operating a propane-fueled powered industrial truck at a loading dock, a worker was ejected from the operator seat when the truck pulled away, causing the worker to be crushed by the superstructure of the truck and resulting in his death.
A worker was operating a riding lawn mower around a retention pond, when it rolled over. He fell into the water of the retention pond and became trapped under lawn mower causing him to drown.

The worker was operating an SUV when he parked it and noticed it rolling backwards. When he tried to apply the brake, he accidentally hit the accelerator instead, causing the vehicle to accelerate in reverse. This resulted in the worker being ejected from the vehicle, leading to fatal injuries.

During the demolition of a concrete overpass, an excavator operator's radio receiver fell to the floor of the cab. When he leaned over to retrieve it, the wire got tangled with the joystick control, causing the excavator to lose control and fall off the overpass. The operator was thrown against the windshield and tragically killed in the accident.

A worker was operating an overhead crane with a "C" hook to load split coils onto a transport rack. One of the coils fell towards him and pinned him against the split coils on the transport rack. The worker died as a result of his injuries sustained.
A worker was performing maintenance on a tractor when the mower deck fell on him.  The worker suffered multiple fractures, resulting in his death.

A worker was performing preventative maintenance on a refrigerated box trailer. While walking along the top of the wet trailer, he fell 13.4 feet to the garage floor and struck his head.  As a result, he died two days later.

A worker picking tomatoes complained of heat while sitting in the company bus. He was given an ice pack and fluids, but his symptoms did not improve and he passed away shortly after. It is suspected that he died from heat exhaustion.
A worker was picking up supplies at a hardware store, when he began feeling ill as a result of an earlier head trauma.  The worker died as a result of his injury.
A worker was placing a tire on a trailer when the tire exploded.The pressure release of the tire caused the worker to be ejected onto and adjacent truck, killing him.

A worker was pouring fuel into the tank of a disabled vehicle located on the shoulder of an interstate road, when a tractor trailer truck struck the worker. He suffered multiple injuries that resulted in his death.

While pumping manure into a tanker truck, a worker climbed on top to check for overflow and was overcome by gas fumes, leading to unconsciousness and ultimately death. Despite immediate CPR by co-workers, the worker could not be revived. The investigation concluded that the cause of death was asphyxia from exposure to the manure gas.
A worker was refueling barge pumps when he fell in the river and drowned.

The incident occurred when a worker fell 20 feet from the second floor of a batch house while using an endless manlift to repair a broken tail shaft on a materials elevator conveyor. The worker struck the basement floor and was killed as a result of the fall.

A worker was repairing an elevator when he became pinned between the exterior door and the elevator cart. He was found dead lying on his side atop of the elevator. The incident investigation revealed that the worker died from asphyxiation as a result of being crushed between the elevator parts.

A worker was repairing the brakes on a car. As he was located under the car, which was raised through the use of a car jack, the car fell.  The worker became pinned between the car and the ground, suffering injuries to his chest, and was killed.

A worker was fatally injured while replacing a rear suspension air bag on a tractor trailer. The air bag exploded while the worker was in a pit under the truck, striking him in the head. Emergency services were unable to save him, and he was pronounced dead at midnight.
A worker was riding on a power mower, when he struck a guy-wire. The worker fell from the mower, which ran over his right hand. The blade of the mower amputated his right hand.

A worker was riding on the forks of a forklift when he fell off and was run over by one of the vehicle's tires. The worker died the next morning at 8:23 a.m. as a result of his injuries sustained from the incident.

A worker was run over by a backing truck. The coworker who was operating the truck, did not realize that the worker was located at the rear of the truck.  The worker died as a result of internal injuries.

A worker was fatally crushed while removing the power steering gear box from a 2001 Chevrolet Tahoe. The worker used two hydraulic jacks to lift the vehicle and placed concrete blocks underneath, but they collapsed while he was underneath the vehicle, causing it to crush him.

A worker serving as a spotter at a pipeline construction site was killed when a chain wrench fell from a tool box on an excavator, becoming lodged against the hydraulic hoses. In an attempt to remove the wrench, the worker inadvertently sheared hydraulic hose bolts, causing a leak that led to hydraulic failure. Tragically, the worker was crushed to death by the excavator's bucket as a result.

The worker was shoveling under a Road Runner conveyor machine when he became entangled in the machine's wires and shaft. The machine, which had no guard in place, was running and pulled the worker further in, causing fatal injuries. Despite being pulled in up to his waist, the worker tragically passed away as a result of the incident.
A worker was sleeping in a truck when his vehicle was hit and he was run over. He suffered injuries to his head and torso that resulted in his death.

A worker was sorting materials for shredding. He had just returned to work from a 15 minute break, when he suffered a heart attack and collapsed. The worker died. It was later determined that he had severe coronary artery disease.
A worker was struck and pinned to the bed of his tractor trailer by a 15,242 pound steel coil.  The worker was crushed and killed.

A worker was fatally struck by a forklift while walking in a breezeway between two buildings. The forklift driver had honked the horn, looked both ways, and inspected what was dragging under the forklift before tragically discovering the worker's body.
A worker was struck by a tractor trailer and was killed.

The worker, who was assigned as the standby person, was taking wipe samples inside a confined tank when he fell from a scaffold located 15 to 20 feet above the tank's bottom. The Chemist on duty had asked him to obtain the samples, resulting in the tragic accident that led to the worker's death.

The worker was transferring material to the trailer of a truck when both the trailer and the truck began rolling down hill while he was reconnecting them. The worker was struck by the vehicle and run over, resulting in fatal head and chest injuries.

During tree trimming work from an aerial lift, a hydraulic cylinder on the lift broke, causing the bucket to fall 40 feet to the ground. The worker, who was tied off, was ejected from the bucket and struck the ground. Despite being rushed to Paducah Medical Center, the worker succumbed to his injuries on July 7, 2016.
A worker was under a mobile home installing blocking, when the home shifted. He was crushed and killed by the weight of the mobile home.

A worker was unloading freight from a tractor trailer when a wooden crate/box/pallet, weighing approximately 1,300 pounds, fell on him.  The worker was crushed and killed by the fallen freight. freight.

During a tree cutting operation, a worker's chainsaw became stuck in the trunk of a tree. In an attempt to free it, the tree unexpectedly fell and struck the worker on his shoulder and head, causing fatal injuries. The worker tragically passed away from the incident.
A worker was using a chain saw to cut down a tree when a tree limb fell and struck him on the head.  The Worker was killed as a result of compression to his head and neck.

The worker was using a Ford Powermaster tractor to tow a stuck fork truck when the tractor lost stability and rolled over, pinning the worker's lower body beneath it. Despite calling emergency services, the worker later succumbed to his injuries after being airlifted to a hospital.

A worker was using a grinding machine to perform maintenance on a dump truck gate. During grinding, a rod that was being used to prop the dump truck gate open broke. The gate came loose, striking and killing the worker.

The worker fell from a mobile ladder stand while trying to access a high shelf, resulting in multiple fractures and spinal cord damage. Despite medical treatment, the worker tragically succumbed to his injuries two days after the incident.

A worker operating a Moffett truck-mounted powered industrial truck was unloading palletized roofing supplies from a flat-bed truck. While trying to retrieve another pallet, the truck tipped forward, causing the worker to be ejected and fatally injured. The investigation discovered that the worker was not wearing a seat belt at the time of the incident.

A worker was using a pipe wrench to loosen the shaft on an industrial vacuum machine, when he fell 20 feet to the floor. He suffered an injury to his head and multiple broken bones, which resulted in his death.

The worker was fatally injured while using a plasma cutter to remove the lid of a 55-gallon barrel that had previously contained toluene. An explosion occurred during the cutting process, causing the lid to be ejected and strike the worker in the head, resulting in severe blunt force trauma injuries leading to his death.

The worker was using a tractor with an attachment to shred tree branches when he fell off the running tractor between tree rows. The tractor and shredding attachment then rolled over the worker, resulting in his death.

A worker using an acetylene torch to remove clips from a tanker trailer used to haul water from oil and gas batteries experienced an explosion, causing him to be thrown 50 feet from his position. A worker was walking a property for the purpose of surveying activity, when a motor vehicle struck him.  The worker died from multiple injuries as a result of the vehicle striking him.
A worker collapsed on a college campus and was rushed to a hospital where he later died. Medical evaluation revealed that the worker had suffered a heart attack or stroke.
A worker was working an assembly line when he suffered a stroke and died.

A worker was working at a logging site. While walking near felled tress to trim off excess branches, the worker was struck by a falling tree that was felled. He suffered blunt force trauma chest and head injures that resulted in his death.

A worker was working from a deck that measured 11 feet long by 11 feet wide square deck and was approximately 6.7 feet from the ground.  For an unknown reason, the worker fell from the deck and struck the rocky surface below that resulted in his death.

The worker was using a Genie Personnel lift to install advertising banners on a building when the platform unexpectedly fell, causing the worker to fall to the ground from a height of 9.5 feet. Sadly, the worker passed away three days later after being treated at a nearby hospital. The incident investigation found that only two of the four outriggers were in use and were not properly installed, with them set parallel to the building and not pinned.
A worker was working from a ladder to load a truck with fertilizer. During the loading, the worker fell from the ladder and struck his head, resulting in his death.
A worker was working from a ladder to perform painting duties.  The ladder slid out from under the worker, causing him to fall.  The worker died as a result of his injuries.

A worker was working from a ladder to repair an overhead door when the door's spring shaft fell and stuck the ladder.  The worker was knocked from the ladder and struck  his head on the ground.  He suffered a skull fracture that resulted in his death.

A worker was working from a ladder to replace temperature relay switches. After replacing the relay switch on a loadbank #5,  He began inspecting loadbank #6, which had 13.8 volts of current running through it. The worker was electrocuted.

A worker was working from a ladder to trim a tree at a residential property.  As he cut down one tree and was preparing to start on another, he fell from the ladder and was killed. There were no witnesses to the incident.
A worker was working from a ladder-stand platform to splice a cable.  As the worker descended the ladder, he fell to the ground. He struck his head and was killed.
A worker was working from a scaffold that was being supported by a forklift, to complete a roofing job, when he fell and was killed.

A worker installing siding at a residential construction site fell from a scaffold approximately 13 feet above the ground. The worker struck his head on the pavement below, resulting in a severe concussion that led to his death. The reason for the fall is unknown.

The worker was installing a gutter on a step ladder when he suddenly collapsed and was found by a coworker breathing heavily on the ground. Emergency services were called and he was taken to the hospital where he later died from a possible heart attack four days later.

The employee, a truck driver at a Walmart Distribution Center, was found pinned under the tires of a trailer after a witness heard a scream.
