As the employee raised the boom/basket, the machine fell over backwards when the basket reached a height of approximately 45 feet. The employee was thrown 16 feet and suffered a fatal skull fracture/head injury upon hitting the pavement.

During a physical efficiency test for the position of security officer, an employee completed a 1.5 mile timed run but complained of shortness of breath. Despite using an inhaler, the employee continued to have difficulty breathing and eventually became unresponsive. Attempts to resuscitate the employee using an AED were unsuccessful, and it was later determined that the employee died from cardiac tamponade caused by aortic dissection.

An employee released a binder that was used in securing a fertilizer sprayer to a flat-bed gooseneck style trailer.  When the sprayer shifted, the employee was pinned between the sprayer and the bed of the truck. The employee died from his injuries.

An employee removed a cover from a pit lined with cement walls and stepped onto the partially open cover. The metal cover flipped, causing the employee to fall 12 feet into the pit and strike by the falling cover. The employee, who was not wearing fall protection equipment, fractured his left ankle as a result of the incident.

An employee removed the dump truck from the back of the roll off tow truck. The dump truck rolled forward and pinned the employee against the back end of the bed of the tow truck. The employee was killed from blunt force trauma .
An employee removing dried concrete from the drum of a concrete truck was killed, when the drum was rotated and the employee's head was crushed between the frame and the drum.
An employee repairing a light on the back of a trailer was burned when an explosion occurred. The employee had burns covering 90% of the body and was killed
An employee replacing a gutter down spout, fell from the 7th floor fire escape. The employee was killed from blunt force trauma.
An employee reported to a fire scene to direct traffic.  While at the scene, the employee collapsed.  The employee was taken to the hospital, where he died from a heart attack.

The employee began their shift as a Security Officer at SouthLight Healthcare. While conducting safety and security checks, the employee tried to cross a public roadway and was hit by a northbound vehicle, resulting in their death from blunt force trauma.

An employee responded to a water leak to determine if the leak was potable water or wastewater. On site, the employee was removing traffic control devices and slipped on the icy road, injuring his right knee.

The employee returned from lunch and used a reciprocating saw to cut a 36x36 inch hole in a corrugated steel deck. The employee fell through the hole and landed on the concrete floor, resulting in fatal head trauma injuries.
An employee returning from break collapsed in hallway suffered a heart attack and died.

An employee rigging a telecommunication box to be removed by a mobile crane that was stationed on the side of the road. The mobile crane that was being operated outside of its load chart, tipped over on its side, fatally injuring the employee. The employee was crushed and killed by the crane.

During the yarding of logs to the landing, a portion of an un-bucked stump was struck by the logs, causing it to break into four pieces. One of the pieces struck the choker setter, resulting in a back injury.

An employee set up the rolling roof rigger portable suspension scaffold anchor and mounted the boatswain's chair scaffold.  The employee fell fourteen stories when the roof rigger toppled over and the employee was killed.

An employee fell from a supported scaffold on the southwest corner of a building while being lifted by a JLG Rough Terrain Forklift. The employee's head accidentally made contact with a cable wire while passing underneath it, causing them to lose balance and fall 6 to 8 feet onto a parking block. The employee sustained fractures to their skull and contusions to their heart and lungs, requiring ambulance transport to the hospital for treatment.
An employee sheathing an 8:12 sloped roof  at a 32 foot elevation, fell  off the roof and was killed.
An employee slipped and fell along the exterior of a warehouse while performing delivery services.  The employee was fatally injured from head trauma as a result of the fall.
An employee slipped on the stairs, fell, and tore tendons in his upper legs.
An employee stacking products onto cart collapsed and died.
An employee standing beside his pick-up truck collapsed to the pavement. The employee had sustained a massive heart attack, and had heart failure.

An employee was fatally struck by a tree while standing next to a log being removed from a logging corridor. The incident occurred when the Yarder cables used to pull the tree up the hill came into contact with surrounding trees, causing three of them to fall and fatally striking the employee. The tree that struck the employee was approximately 150 feet tall and 12 inches in diameter.

During a work hike, an employee suddenly felt dizzy and passed out, with their pulse stopping at one point. Despite being defibrillated and regaining a weak pulse, the employee could not be revived. The Coroner attributed the incident to an enlarged heart, worsened by overexertion, ultimately resulting in a fatal heart attack. The event was deemed work-related by the Coroner.
An employee starting a load pump was killed in an explosion.
An employee stepped between a portable storage tank and a running powered industrial truck.  The employee was caught between the two and was killed.

An employee stepped off an elevated work platform onto a ladder.  The employee fell from the ladder when it was kicked out from underneath him and lacerated his head during their fall.  The employee was not hospitalized.
An employee stepped onto a piece of plywood covering a hole within the roof and fell through the opening.  Initial reports did not provide a description of any injuries.
An employee stepped out onto a plank extended into an elevator shaft to perform drywall operations. The employee fell 27 feet to the concrete floor below and was killed.
An employee stepped over a curb and took a few steps on a grassy area.The employee fell down and broke his left femur.  The employee later died from complications. ter died from complications.

An employee struck a 27-inch high fence while parking a van upon arriving at work.  The employee was subsequently run over by the van, sustaining crushing injuries to the head and chest, and was killed. There were no witnesses.

An employee subcontractor was walking across the parking lot. The employee was struck by a jockey truck that was driven by the host employer. The employee suffered broken bones and crushing injuries and was killed.
An employee suddenly stopped driving and parked his car in the middle of the street. The employee was found unresponsive and later died from heart attack.

An employee suffered a seizure possibly due to pesticide exposure around his trailer. It is unclear if he worked at the location or lived there. Emergency services were called and he was taken to the hospital, where he passed away on January 19, 2017.
An employee suffers respiratory failure and dies from cardiovascular incident.  No further description was provided by the initial report.
An employee sustained a cut to the right index finger which became infected.
An employee sustained a heart attack while sitting at a desk and died.

Tragically, an employee was fatally injured when they were crushed between a pipe and a Caterpillar excavator while assisting the operator. The incident occurred as the employee was sliding a pipe cover over a pipe to protect it from debris. The employee sustained severe injuries to the chest and abdomen, leading to their untimely death.

An employee was injured in a trench collapse while looking for a sanitary sewer pipe with a coworker. The excavation had near vertical side walls with no cave-in protection in place. The excavator operator inadvertently struck the employee in the head with the bucket while trying to assist in dislodging him from the collapse, resulting in the employee being fatally injured due to crushing fractures and asphyxiation hazards.

The employee was observed placing his weight against an unsecured lintel while tack welding another lintel on a scaffold. He fell 7 feet and was ultimately crushed by a 600 lb lintel, resulting in his death.
An employee tasked with moving totes with a hand pallet jack was found unresponsive on the floor.  The employee was killed by a heart attack.
An employee that was driving a standup power industrial truck drove it against a rack system and was pinned against the beam of the rack. He died from his injuries.

An employee tried to straighten a 150 lb wooden board while operating a Resaw machine.  The employee was hit in the shoulder when the board flew up from the machine.  The employee suffered a broken left shoulder fracture.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

An employee trimming palm trees at a private residence.  The employee was located in a palm tree approximately 35 feet off the ground cutting palm fronds from the bottom when several palm fronds shifted downward and pinned him between the fronds and the tree trunk, causing a fatal injury.
An employee tripped on a flatbed while walking and fell. The employee sustained a head and neck injury.

While troubleshooting a malfunctioning dust collector, an employee was killed in an explosion caused by static energy igniting dust during a planned blow down. The employee sustained third degree burns to his hands and abdomen.
An employee turned on a band saw while he was looking away and he sliced his finger.  The medical facility could not close up the wound, and the finger to the knuckle was removed.

An employee turned the machine to "limited operations" to unjam it, but left his hand near the escapement fixture which still had pneumatic air pressure. When the fixture discharged, his hand was caught and resulted in a partial finger amputation. The incident occurred due to accessing the interlocked station door with an allen wrench.

An employee attempted to clean material out of the discharge end of a Pin Mixer machine by opening a door that was held closed by a nut. Even though the electric motor was turned off, the mixing shaft in the machine continued to rotate, causing the employee's steel-toed boot to come into contact with a mixing pin and resulting in the amputation of the end of his middle toe on his left foot.
An employee tying rebar suffered cardiac arrest/ heart attack and died.

An employee unloading trusses from a delivery truck using a mobile crane. The employee was guiding a load of trusses picked by the crane from the delivery truck and the crane contacted an energized overhead power line. The employee was killed due to electrocution.

An employee using fall protection but not tied off, was getting a box of nails from a 20 foot high roof.  He fell from the roof. The employee sustained head and internal injuries and was found on the ground. The employee was killed. There were no witnesses to the incident.

An employee walked down a marked pedestrian foot path before entering the Tyson Foods lot.  The employee entered through the gate, turned, and was struck by a semi-truck fender.  The employee was pronounced dead upon arrival at the hospital.

An employee walked in the vicinity of a flat bed trailer while it was being unloaded by a forklift.  Metal conduit fell off the trailer during the unloading process and struck the employee in the head, killing him.
An employee walked into the Cryovac room, rolled her ankle, and fell to the floor.  The employee sustained two broken bones in her left ankle and was hospitalized..

An employee took a cup of lacquer thinner from the workplace and was later found on fire in a field outside. It is suspected that the employee was smoking a cigarette at the time of the incident. The exact cause of the fire is still under investigation by the authorities.

An employee accessed the lacquer thinner area and took a cup of thinner before exiting the building. He was later found on fire in a field nearby. Police suspect the employee was smoking a cigarette at the time of the incident, although the exact cause remains unknown.
An employee walked into the slitter portion of a machine when he became entangled in the roller coil. One of his arms was cut, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

On (date), an employee slipped on a wet floor in the bathroom while emptying equipment used to vacuum water/stripper from the floor. The employee suffered a broken hip as a result of the fall and required surgery to repair the injury. The employee was hospitalized and treated for their injuries following the incident.
An employee walked underneath a Setting Machine while it was in operation and was killed when his head was caught inside the machine.
An employee walking and removing lane dividing reflecting tabs was struck and killed by a passing car. The passing car also struck the company truck.

An employee walking on a level surface was exiting a custodial closet. The employee slipped and fell (fall from same level).  It had been raining, and the concrete was wet and slippery. He sustained a broken femur.
An employee walking on top of scaffolding to tighten water hose bolts, fell about 10 feet, striking head during the fall. The employee was transported a hospital and was declared dead.

An employee was  chasing birds  from under netting. The employee was walking to next point in overshoes (rain), he tripped and fell to the ground fracturing his leg. It had been raining in the morning yet was not raining when the employee fell. The soil was wet.

During a repair of a powered industrial truck, an employee was under a lifting assembly that was being supported by another powered industrial truck. Unfortunately, the forks of the second unit slipped, causing the assembly to fall on the employee's head, resulting in a fatal crushing injury.

An employee was  moving a cow into a pen at the livestock market when he opened a gate and the cow rammed the gate knocking the employee to the ground.  The cow went around the opened gate and trampled the employee causing his death.

During a routine delivery of construction materials, an employee operating a forklift was struck by two metal fence panels that were blown by a gust of wind into the forklift. The employee suffered a fractured right arm and multiple lacerations from the impact. He was promptly hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

An employee was a flagger on a right of way. The employee tripped and contacted the third electric rail that was energized with 600v.  The employee made contact with the third rail with his hand and was electrocuted.

An employee part of a sanitation crew was cleaning a Leek Processing Machine at a facility when his clothing got entangled in the machine's moving components, resulting in a broken arm and asphyxiation. The supervisor was present at the time of the accident, and despite the crew regularly working near moving machines, there were no control of hazardous energy or Lockout/Tagout procedures in place for the crew. The employee's body was later transported by the coroner.

During a test of an off-road vehicle at a state vehicular recreation area, an employee was injured when the driver attempted to drive over a run-off ditch and struck the opposite side. The employee suffered a back injury and was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was about to engage in painting work on an exterior second floor window trims.  The employee fell approximately 12 feet from above ground level and was killed.

An employee was investigating a malfunctioning Cain saw in the Main Shop after being informed by the general manager and another employee about the issue with the specific model and serial number. While underneath the saw, another employee accidentally turned it on, causing the employee to become trapped and ultimately asphyxiated. Despite attempts to rescue him, he was declared deceased at the scene by the medical examiner.

An employee was about to reposition anchorage points.  The employee fell from the top roof, striking a lower roof and ultimately falling to the concrete surface, resulting in a hospitalization. The employee later died from the injuries on March 15, 2017.

An employee fell from a fiberglass extension ladder while trying to access a roof, as the ladder slipped from the cement pavers due to ice and water. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

An employee was accessing product from shelving while working from an elevated forklift. The forklift the employee was standing on was struck by another forklift, causing the employee to lose his balance. The employee fell approximately 10ft,and was killed by fracturing his skull on impact.

An employee was accessing the platform of a landfill tipper.  The employee was standing on the landfill's tipper platform when a tractor trailer was backed up onto the platform. The employee was struck and killed from multiple trauma to the head, chest and legs.

The employee was accessing a steep metal roof to drill a hole for a plumbing vent when they slipped and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. They suffered fractures in their foot and heel and were hospitalized for treatment. The incident occurred while the employee was transitioning from the ladder to the roof.
An employee was accidentally shot in the chest by a coworker and died.

An employee was acting as a designated safety monitor. The employee fell from a flat roof less than fifty feet in length while walking backwards. He walked off the edge of the roof. The employee was killed from fractures and internal injuries.
An employee was acting as a ground guide for a dump truck.  The employee was struck by the dump truck and suffered a compound fracture of the femur.

While acting as a spotter for a forklift operator and truck driver, an employee was asked to assist in pulling the forklift back onto its path with a chain. Tragically, during the process of disconnecting the chains, a piece of equipment rolled off the truck and struck the employee, resulting in a fatal injury.

The employee was adjusting a come-along to move material when a piece of pipe above him suddenly fell, striking him in the head and shoulder area. Despite the quick response of emergency services, the employee tragically lost his life as a result of the impact. This incident highlights the importance of proper safety precautions and equipment when working in hazardous environments.

An employee was adjusting a pipe. He was using a chop saw to cut a pipe and the pipe was wet, which caused his hand to slip into the saw blade. The blade  amputated the first joint of his left index finger. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

An employee was adjusting an adapter plate. The employee struck his hand against the asphalt when the wheel lift device from the tow truck went into motion, resulting in a partial amputation of the employee's right index finger.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

The employee was injured while adjusting boxes on a conveyor belt when a T Cart struck his left leg. The employee suffered a broken left leg in two places as a result of the incident. The T Cart was used to transport paper and cardboard throughout the plant, with an inside safety bar to secure the items being transported.

An employee was adjusting grade stake at the side of the roadbed. The employee was caught under the right tread of the bulldozer. He received multiple internal injuries from being crushed under bulldozer tread and was killed.

An employee fell from a scaffold platform while adjusting gutters on the roof, resulting in severe injuries and ultimately death. The platform did not have guard rails installed, and the employee was not wearing a personal fall arrest system. The incident was heard by co-workers who found the employee on the asphalt driveway with a severe head injury.

An employee sustained a crushing injury to his left arm while adjusting stoppers on an oven loader. The injury occurred when the employee's arm became caught between the loader and the stopper while trying to remove a jammed loaf of bread dough. The employee's left arm swelled considerably as a result of the incident.

An employee was adjusting the batter flow for the weight when the locking bolt failed to hold the weight wheel in place. Instead, the employee used a piece of cardboard to secure the wheel. Unfortunately, the piston of the machine came down unexpectedly, amputating the tip of the employee's finger. Despite the severity of the injury, the employee did not require hospitalization.

During maintenance work on a 30KW generator, an employee's left index finger came into contact with a moving fan blade, resulting in amputation. The accident occurred as the employee was adjusting the governor of the generator and placed his hand on the unguarded fan shroud. The injured employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injury.

An employee was adjusting the pitch of a tiller by going in between the tiller and tractor. The employee was caught in the running blades of the tiller and pulled in, receiving amputations. He was killed.

An employee sustained crushing injuries to the chest and pelvic area while adjusting a proximity switch flag for the bead set stop. He was caught between the inner bead can and equipment cabinet causing the equipment to cycle. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

During the manufacturing of hot tubs using the RotoMold System, an employee was fatally injured when the upper mold section, weighing 1,200 pounds, fell onto them after becoming dislodged from the hoist hook. The employee was emptying plastic material into the bottom mold when the incident occurred, resulting in blunt force trauma to the chest and ultimately leading to their death.

An employee was aligning a belt on a pulley system of a saw.  As he turned the belt manually, his right thumb got caught between the belt and pulley. He unsuccessfully worked to free his thumb, resulting in an evulsion at the tip of the digit that required amputation to the bone.

During the process of aligning a new 750 volt transformer on a concrete pad, an employee accidentally caused an arc flash by reducing the distance between an existing 480 volt 3 phase metal cabinet and a bus bar. The employee received burns to 60% of his upper body and ultimately succumbed to his injuries.

An employee was aligning some copper tubing into machine.  The employee's hand was at the pinch point when the Schumag Number 2130  hydraulic clamp closed.  The employee amputated his left thumb at its first joint and crushed the remaining fingers on their left hand, for which he was hospitalized.

An employee was alone in a maintenance area next to an air handling unit. The employee was found unresponsive after several attempts to contact the employee throughout the day. He was pronounced dead on the scene by first responders.

The employee was fatally electrocuted while walking and holding onto a live 480 volt SO Cord, which he had partially disassembled using tools. The coroner determined that the employee was reaching for a metal stair railing with his left hand while holding onto the energized cord with his right hand, resulting in his death. Burn marks were found on his hands.

An employee was applying a sealer to a roof using a wood extension pole with a metal frame paint roller when the wooden extension pole of 6 feet contacted an electrical wire near the work zone.  The employee was electrocuted and killed.

An employee was applying a waterproof membrane over the existing metal roof on a one story warehouse building. The employee stepped onto an unprotected skylight and fell 30 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained severe head injuries, broken bones and died from the injuries.

During a wall siding operation, an employee tripped over a covered skylight and fell approximately 30 feet onto a concrete floor, resulting in blunt force trauma to the head and body. Tragically, the employee was killed as a result of the fall.
An employee was applying bolts to U-channel post for a traffic control warning sign when they were struck by a motor vehicle.  The employee was killed as a result of the injuries.

While applying primer to sheetrock for insulation, an employee was working on the 14th level of a 16-level scaffold. The scaffold collapsed due to the weight of approximately 31,783 pounds of stone blocks added to the levels, resulting in the death of one worker who was crushed under the debris. Six insulation employees were working in the area at the time of the incident, with three on the scaffold and three underneath it.

During the application of rubber seam compound on a roof, an employee accidentally stepped on a plastic skylight, causing it to break. The employee fell 16 feet 8 inches through the skylight and landed on the concrete floor below, resulting in a fatal head injury.

An employee was applying shingles to the addition of a  single family home under construction. The employee was on an extension ladder and fell approximately 10 feet 6 inches to the concrete below. The employee struck his head and was killed.

An employee was arranging some equipment and materials on a flatbed truck. The employee's feet became tangled in their fall protection and they lost their balance, falling approximately 4 feet to the ground.  The employee suffered a broken leg when they hit the ground.

An employee was asked to bring skid steer to work site from laydown yard. The employee was crushed between the loader arm and front bucket or cab. No details of the accident were provided in the narrative.
An employee was assembling a strut unit when the spring popped out of the tool striking the employee in the face. The employee sustained a fractured facial bone, broken nose and laceration to face.

After receiving training, an employee was using a pneumatic crimper to assemble mechanical parts. When a screw bushing got stuck in the machine, the employee attempted to remove it without turning off the equipment, resulting in a severe injury to his right index finger. He received medical treatment after being hospitalized.

The employee was assembling pallet racking and fell five feet from an elevated level to the concrete floor below. The employee was hospitalized and later died five days later from complications of the accident and other health conditions.

An employee was assigned as the oiler for a Manitowoc model 888 crane. As steel was being moved, the employee was caught by a moving part of the crane's superstructure. The employee was killed from a fatal head injury.

An employee left his regular cleaning duties at a crushing plant machine to go to a nearby McDonalds, where he called emergency services. He was taken to the hospital and later died from multiple internal injuries, including rib fractures, heart hemorrhages, and organ lacerations. The exact cause of these injuries could not be determined, but they are likely related to a crushing injury.

A maintenance worker on a sawmill complex was tasked with repairing a commercial lawn mower on a cloudy and humid day. Alone at the time of the incident, the employee left his work area and walked into the path of a front-end loader, resulting in fatal crushing injuries. The employee was not wearing high-visibility clothing and the loader's top lights were not on, contributing to the accident.

During an assessment of a high pH boiler water additive system, an employee was accidentally exposed to caustic additive when it drained from a disconnected tube, causing burns to his upper legs and abdomen. The employee was promptly transported to a nearby medical facility by onsite medical staff and later transferred to another hospital for further treatment.

While changing the brakes and transmission fluid on a 2005 GMC Yukon, an employee accidentally left the vehicle in park on a loading dock slope. In an attempt to release the gear, the employee was run over by the rolling vehicle, suffering multiple injuries and tragically losing their life.

The employee was setting up metal framing studs on an adjustable work platform when he fell approximately 8 feet 5 inches. Witnesses suggested he may have fainted as they heard a drill fall and saw the employee tilt over before falling. The coroner's autopsy report revealed the employee suffered head trauma but ultimately died of natural causes.
An employee was assigned to irrigate crops. At approximately 9:00 a.m., the employee was found unresponsive sitting inside personal vehicle.

During a clean-up effort at work, an employee was struck by a forklift operated by a coworker while picking up scrap material. The employee sustained a broken leg and had to be hospitalized for treatment. It was found that the forklift's backup alarm and strobe light were functioning at the time of the incident.

During the process of disassembling a meat extrusion machine for cleaning, the machine was accidentally energized and the Chub Cutter was activated. This resulted in one of the employee's pinky fingers being amputated. The employee was taken to the hospital for immediate treatment of the injury.

During a workplace accident, an employee fell approximately 15 to 20 feet to a concrete floor below after stepping on a weak roof area while carrying a metal panel. The employee sustained head and neck trauma, resulting in his death. The incident investigation showed that the coworker was leading the employee, who was unable to see where he was walking.

While assisting a coworker with moving a long piece of bar stock through a narrow warehouse door using a forklift, the employee's right middle finger got caught between the floor and the bar stock during a transfer between forklifts. Unfortunately, the tip of her finger was amputated in the accident, and she had to be hospitalized for her injuries.

An employee was assisting a coworker to move metal truck racks by hand. As they were looking for markings to pair the racks with the trucks, one of the racks slipped and pinned the employee's right pinky finger between the racks.  The employee amputated his finger.

During the process of opening a wood crate containing glass panes, the crate tipped over and spilled its contents, causing the employee to sustain a fractured leg and multiple cuts and bruises on their arms. The incident occurred as the employee was assisting a coworker in opening the crate using a pry bar on a sloped surface.

During a maintenance job on a residential HVAC system, an employee was supervising a new coworker who used a telescopic ladder to access the attic opening. While the employee climbed the ladder to check on his coworker, the ladder slipped, causing the employee to fall 8.92 feet to the second story landing. The employee sustained several injuries and was hospitalized for 5 days.

An employee was helping a coworker move a heavy load of steel sheets using a forklift. While trying to clear a table in the way, the employee walked under the raised load and the load fell, crushing the employee to death. The accident was caused by a malfunctioning sling that slipped from a hook, leading to the tragic incident.

During an attempt to remove a bolt from a brake chamber, an employee's finger was amputated when a coworker used a pressurized blow gun set at 175 psi. The investigation found that the blow gun with a tip was not the appropriate tool for the task.

During troubleshooting of an Amada CNC machine, a coolant leak was discovered due to metal chips blocking the drainage. While assisting his coworker in removing the metal chips, an employee's right hand became pinned against the machine's frame when the CNC turret unexpectedly indexed forward, resulting in a degloving injury. It was later found that safety measures were not properly followed, as the machine was not locked out during maintenance and precautions were not taken to prevent injury during the inspection.

During a tool change-out on the MO 74 Hydraulic Press, an employee's finger was crushed when the press froze and closed unexpectedly. The employee was pointing out a potential issue when the accident occurred, resulting in hospitalization and treatment for the injured finger.
An employee was assisting a coworker with a forklift.  The coworker didn't see the employee and ran over his foot.  The employee suffered a broken leg and foot for which he was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting a coworker with setting up a hook tender.  The employee was struck by the stump that was being used as an anchor point and the stump flew up, releasing the tension on the skyline.  The employee was killed when he was struck by the stump and the skyline.

An employee was assisting a coworker with the operation of a scissor lift. As the employee was using a remote control to maneuver the scissor lift, he looked away briefly and ran over his left foot with the vehicle. He sustained a fractured tibia, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

During a forklift operation to move granite slabs weighing 6,500 pounds, an employee was crushed to death when the slabs fractured and fell while he was removing wire slings from the hook. The forklift operator had eased up the tension on the slings, causing the tragic accident to occur in the warehouse.
An employee was assisting a welding operation when flammable vapors ignited. The employee was burned and killed.

An employee was assisting a working crew. The crew was conducting a hot tap on a live gas line. The gas line was pressurized at approximately 5,500 kPa (kilopascals) (800 psi). An explosion occurred, and the employee sustained injuries from flying debris over his entire body. He was killed.
An employee was assisting and spotting for dump truck deliveries. The employee was backed over by motor grader and was killed. ed.

The employee was assisting coworkers in removing an obstruction in a pipe containing water at 215 degrees Fahrenheit. The obstruction loosened while they were scooping it out, causing the water to splash the employee and causing significant burns which ultimately lead to his death.

While troubleshooting a malfunction in a cooker machine at a rendering facility, an employee closed a gate and hit a chute with a hammer to check for blockages. When he opened the hatch, he was sprayed with hot meat meal, resulting in second degree burns covering 11% of his body. The employee was hospitalized for treatment.

While helping coworkers unload pallets of sod from a box truck, an employee witnessed a Bobcat forklift tipping forward due to the weight of the pallets. He climbed onto the back of the forklift to help stabilize it. During the second attempt, some sod pieces fell off the pallet, causing the forklift to drop suddenly to the ground. As a result, the employee was thrown off and hit his head on asphalt, leading to a concussion.

An employee was helping coworkers on a roof with moving garbage and tools. The employee left due to heat exhaustion around noon, sat in an air conditioned truck, and then went to get supplies. At 1:00 p.m., the employee fell ill, gasping for air and turning blue. Despite CPR from the boss and Emergency Services responding, the employee was pronounced dead at 2:00 p.m.

An employee assisting his employer in transferring furniture between trucks jumped from one truck to another while the employer was repositioning it, resulting in the employee being crushed between the two trucks. The employee sustained a fractured hip and was hospitalized for treatment.

While assisting his supervisor in cleaning and replacing spray nozzles on a mist tank, the employee's hair became entangled in the spray nozzle rollers. The supervisor returned to find the employee's scalp removed from his eyebrows back towards his ears. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injury.
An employee was assisting in assembling a BOP.  Gas fumes ignited resulting in burns to the employee.

An employee was assisting in pulling an electrical line to be raised and hung on a power pole.	While workers were pulling the electrical line, the line came loose from a snag and flung up into an overhead transmission line that was energized.  The employee was electrocuted.
The employee was cleaning up after a day of strawberry picking when he accidentally placed his finger between the truck bed and the lift gate, resulting in the amputation of his left index finger.

An employee assisting in the demolition of a concrete canopy with a Bobcat tractor and concrete breaking tool attached had a large chunk of concrete fall and crush his legs. He was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

While assisting with the disassembly of a crane, an employee was standing on top of the boom connecting slings when the crane operator began to lower the boom. The employee fell approximately 9.5 feet to the ground when the boom suddenly dropped, resulting in a fractured cervical spine and hospitalization for treatment.

During the installation of concrete piping, an employee's right hand was amputated when an excavator came into contact with the piping and the piece of wood he was holding. The employee was rushed to the hospital for treatment of his severe injury, specifically the amputation of his right index finger.

An employee was assisting in the loading of a compressor onto a forklift, when its back tire ran over his right foot. He sustained a fractured right foot, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

An employee was assisting in the loading of a transformer on a flat bed truck. As the employee stood below the transformer that was being raised by a sky lift, he was struck in the head. He sustained a laceration to the head, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.
An employee was assisting in the maintenance of plant equipment.The employee suffered a respiratory illness when chlorine dioxide vapors were released. dioxide vapors were released.

During the placement of concrete road barriers, an employee's left pinky toe was crushed by a portion of the barrier. The employee had to be hospitalized and unfortunately, the toe had to be amputated as a result of the injury.

An employee fell from a chipping conveyor while assisting in its relocation, resulting in a skull fracture and concussion. The employee was adjusting the rigging when the conveyor shifted, causing the fall of approximately 7.7 feet onto a concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for the injuries sustained in the incident.

During the removal of counter-weights from a Demag AC 500-1 mobile crane, an employee got caught between the assembly tray and the superstructure of the crane. Tragically, the employee was crushed and killed during the disassembly process.

An employee contracted to sanitize food at a host employer facility had his right middle finger amputated after it got caught in the fryer's chain and sprocket mechanisms. The incident occurred while the employee was cleaning the fryer which was still running and energized. Following the injury, the employee was hospitalized and received treatment.

During the servicing of a dryer, an employee sustained burns to his abdomen, back, arms, and face when steam was released unexpectedly. He was hospitalized for 17 days for treatment before being released.

An employee was assisting in the unloading of an armored truck. As a forklift was placing its forks at the bed of the truck, one of the employee's index fingers became caught between the truck frame and the forklift. The employee's finger was amputated.

During a pipe laying project at a construction site, an employee went into an open trench to level gravel. Tragically, the trench walls collapsed, burying the employee and causing him to suffer compound fractures to his femur. He had to be hospitalized as a result of the incident.

During the process of placing a decommissioned metal dip tank into a recycling dumpster, the tank began to topple over. In an attempt to steady the tank, the employee's left ring finger was caught on the tank's 2" lip, resulting in the amputation of the finger tip pad.

An employee was assisting the employer in installing siding to a residential facility.The employee fell approximately 8 feet from a ladder. The employee struck his head on the ground and was killed. . The employee struck his head on the ground and was killed.

An employee assisting with sill plate placement on a new residential construction site jumped off the foundation wall at the owner's request, resulting in a fall to the basement level. The employee sustained severe injuries including skull and facial fractures, leading to his death eight days later on 09/08/2015.

The employee was helping truck mechanics fix a leaking tire on a semi-truck when the side wall suddenly ruptured, sending compressed air towards the employee. He was blown off his feet and thrown backwards, hitting his head on the floor. Unfortunately, the employee suffered a fatal injury from the incident.

An employee was assisting two coworkers on a snow science study in a remote area.  While returning to a ski lodge, the employee triggered an avalanche and was caught in the pathway of cascading snow and debris.  The employee sustained fatal trauma from the avalanche and was killed.
An employee was assisting with a tandem crane lift.  The employee was struck when the load suddenly shifted.  The load crushed the employees torso and he was killed.
An employee was assisting with a tow.  The employee was struck by a motor vehicle and was killed.

The employee was assisting in lifting patients without the use of mechanical lifting devices. After helping a patient who had passed out on the toilet and another who had fallen on the floor, the employee experienced significant lower back pain.

During the installation of a beam for a jib crane, an employee was assisting by moving a cart while their coworker extended the mast to lift the beam. The beam got caught on something, prompting a coworker to try and dislodge it. Unfortunately, the sling slipped off the fork and the beam fell, striking the employee and resulting in five broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was assisting with the transfer of crane counterweights when the crane fell on the employee, catching him between the crane and an adjacent trailer.  The employee was killed when his midsection sustained multiple injuries when crushed between the two vehicles.

An employee at an Air Force base was using a hoist on an elevated platform to bring up a metal box. Unfortunately, the hoist wire broke while he was holding the remote control, causing him to fall approximately 19 to 20 feet to the ground. As a result, he sustained multiple fractures, including broken feet, ankles, tailbone, and injuries to his right arm and elbow.
An employee was at doorway greeting entering customer. She lost balance and fell. The employee suffered fractured hip for which she was hospitalized.

While helping a coworker dismantle falsework at a construction site, an employee was asked to install a temporary support. As the employee was getting the necessary equipment, the falsework collapsed, causing pieces of timber to strike the employee's leg. The employee was taken to Regional Medical Center of San Jose where they were treated for a fractured left leg.
An employee was attaching a deck to an elevated home when the deck collapsed while the employee was underneath.  The employee was killed

During the process of attaching a hose to connect a vacuum truck to a tank, a pressurization event occurred causing equipment failure. The force of the event led to the external valve assembly detaching and striking the employee in the chest, resulting in a fatal injury.

An employee was attaching a temporary single phase electrical distribution line. While attempting to roll the power distribution line in order to pin the bells of the line, the employees body contacted the exposed line and was electrocuted and killed.
An employee was attaching crane cable to metal for lifting. An angle beam broke from the wall causing the employee to fall. The employee was killed.
An employee was attaching one end of a section of  a replacement piping in a pipeline. The contents from the pipeline ignited and the employee was killed.

An employee was working on attaching steel angles to a greenhouse wall from an elevated pallet-mounted produce tub with a forklift. The worker moved to one side of the platform, causing it to fall 7 feet to the concrete floor, resulting in a head injury and ultimately death.

The employee fell approximately 29 ft to the base of the chimney after stepping onto an unsecured wood scaffold plank without securing his fall protection lanyard. The employee was attempting to grab a piece of metal bracing while working in the chimney at a power plant. Sadly, the employee was killed due to injuries sustained in the fall.

During an attempt to free a stuck dump truck, an employee was crushed when a coworker accidentally ran over him while he was untying the tow strap from the front axle of the truck. The incident occurred as the coworker placed the truck in gear without realizing the employee was underneath.

During an attempt to move a Caterpillar wheeled excavator out of a maintenance garage bay, an employee tragically caught his head between the garage door structure and the excavator. Witnesses believe he was trying to prevent the vehicle's outside mirror from hitting the door, but ended up being pinned between the cab and the door, resulting in fatal head injuries.

An employee was injured while attempting to clear a jammed component from the Mini Pillow Machine when their fingers got caught between the machine plate and a side access point. The employee suffered amputations of two fingers on their left hand and was hospitalized for their injuries.

An employee was attempting to clear a snowblower's vertical auger and fractured several fingers.  There were no specifics provided as to which hand or the number of fingers that were injured in the initial report.

An employee was attempting to close and lock the vehicle yard gate.  A bucket truck vehicle ran over the employee, killing him. The employee was found on the ground and vehicle at rest against a second vehicle.

The employee was electrocuted while attempting to cut foam that had expanded out of the mold prematurely, causing the machine doors to remain open. The employee came into contact with energized connections on the wooden hand paddle of the hot wire cutter, causing them to fall to a lower level outside of the block mold machine.

An employee was injured while attempting to dismantle the boom from a crane at a marina. The boom was resting on a barge and the crane was positioned on a launch ramp. The employee got under the boom to remove a pin, causing the unlevel boom to fall onto his leg. The employee admitted to not realizing the rapid decrease in tide level and failing to secure the boom before dismantling. The crane involved was an FMC Linkbelt manufactured in 1979.

An employee was attempting to drive a JLG Lull (PIV) onto a low boy trailer. JLG Lull went off trailer and rolled over to the ground. The employee's head struck against the forklift and suffered laceration to the head. The employee later died from blood clots.

The employee was working on a broken machine that was still turned on, when the machine mistakenly sensed his head as a pipe and activated the ram, resulting in a fatal blow to his head and upper body. The employee sustained a skull fracture and tragically lost his life while attempting to fix the beller machine.

An employee wearing climbing gear was attempting to un-stick a belay device on the Owing-Spalding rappel on Grand Teton Mountain. While working on the device, the employee either unhooked or had the positioning device break, causing a fall of 120 vertical feet. The employee then tumbled over the edge of Valhalla Canyon on the east face, falling approximately another 2280 feet down the mountain side, resulting in fatal injuries.
An employee was attempting to get a Bobcat skid steer loader back on the ramps of a flatbed.  The employee was subsequently struck by the Bobcat, suffered multiple internal injuries and was killed.

An employee was attempting to hook up a tractor switcher, to a trailer. The employee was caught between the trailer and the tractor. The employee received crushing injuries to his chest and was killed.
An employee was attempting to move a fallen log when it fell and crushed him.  The worker suffered blunt force trauma injuries, which he died from.

On June 2, 2017, an employee was tragically killed when a heavy metal injection mold used for manufacturing plastic parts fell off a shelf and struck him. The employee suffered critical injuries to his head and chest, ultimately leading to his death. The Medical Examiner confirmed that the cause of death was blunt force injury to the head.

An employee was attempting to move the handle of a pallet jack which was being transported by a Lull. The employee slipped and one of the wheels of the Lull ran over his leg. The employee fractured his leg, foot and hip for which he was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to place cribbing under a trailer.  A chain was attached to the rails of a trailer in an attempt to lift the trailer and attached to a truck. The employee was underneath the lifted trailer when the side rail broke and fractured the employee's head.

While attempting to pull a steel mat back into place for tying, an employee double wrapped tie wire around the steel and used a 2 by 4 for leverage. The employee was tied off with a lanyard and positioning hook, both attached to the same location on the vertical bar. When the 2 by 4 snapped, the employee lost balance and fell backwards, causing the wire ties to break and the employee to fall approximately 21 feet, resulting in fatal head and internal injuries.

An employee standing on a work platform attached to a forklift was attempting to pull a heavy mesh tarp onto a shade house frame. The forklift operator backed up, causing the platform to slide off the forks and eject the employee. The employee suffered fatal head trauma as a result.

An employee was attempting to remove a log that was jammed on the energized Edger Unscrambler Conveyor. The log fell back onto the conveyor, trapping the employee's right hand between the log and the conveyor, resulting in partial amputation of the ring finger.

An employee attempting to repair a pump on a manure handling system entered a 6x6 foot pit 10 feet below grade without proper ventilation. The employee lost consciousness and drowned in the dairy cow waste at the bottom of the pit. Tragically, the employee did not survive the accident.

During an attempt to retrieve a part from the merchandise rack, an employee climbed a galvanized steel rack which ultimately collapsed, pinning the employee between two other racks. Resulting in fatal injuries to the employee's chest, upper body, and neck.

An employee was attempting to roll a coil of aluminum. The aluminum coil, which weighed 500 pounds, fell onto the operator's work table and then onto the floor. The employee's three fingertips of the right hand were amputated.

An employee was attempting to rotate a steel girder beam to weld end tabs. While rotating the beam, the beam struck and pinned the employee. The employee suffered lacerated live, head and neck trauma. The employee was killed.

The employee fell from a fiberglass extension ladder while attempting to secure a plastic tarp to the roof of a greenhouse by nailing wood furring strips to the wall. They sustained internal injuries and heart failure, leading to their death. The ladder placement was a contributing factor to the incident.

The employee was crushed and killed while attempting to separate two semi-trailers that had slid into each other. The employee had positioned themselves under the trailers as the driver tried to nudge them apart. However, the driver missed the mark and continued backing up, causing the employee to be caught between the truck and the landing gear bracing of one of the trailers.

An employee's finger was partially amputated while attempting to reposition the air die in a press machine. An employee was attempting to test the voltage at a bay door (number 4) switch when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to the hands and face.

The employee was attempting to unlatch the trailer gate when a coworker backed a front end loader into the trailer, crushing and pinning the employee against the trailer. An employee was attending a meeting and suffered a heart attack and died.  Emergency services were contacted.  No further information was provided on the initial report.
An employee was attending to customers when an assailant walked into the store with a shotgun and shot the employee in the head, killing him.

An employee was backing a roller compactor near the edge of a hill when it became unstable and toppled over.  The employee was ejected from the roller compactor and the canopy of the compactor landed on his head. The employee was killed due to head trauma.

An employee was backing a tractor with a bin trailer. He lost control and went off the edge of the road. The trailer and tractor flipped. The employee was found with the tractor wheels up on top of him.
An employee was backing up into a warehouse rack and was caught between the rack and stand-up forklift.  The employee suffered trauma to their chest.
An employee was balancing a granite counter top, so a base board could be placed behind it. The employee loss his balance and breaks his left ankle, when struck by the granite counter top.
An employee was behind a counter eating a snack.   The employee was shot twice and killed during a robbery.

He was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

During a training session on a Rousselle 40 ton press, an employee stuck his hand into the machine to move material. The supervisor, unaware of the employee's hand in the press, cycled it and crushed the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

An employee was bending metal strips of approximately 7 inches X 1 inch on a press brake. The employee's index finger on the left hand was caught between the metal strip and the frame of the machine. Approximately 1/8th of an inch of the employee's tip of the left index finger was amputated.
An employee was bending over to pick something up, when he was  struck by a skid steer loader. The employee was killed from crushing injuries.

An employee was beneath a load on a forklift when a square tubing fell off the forks to the ground and bounced, striking the employee behind his left leg. He was hospitalized and received treatment for his injury, resulting in the amputation of his leg.
An employee was beside a truck trailer when a log dislodged, fell out of the trailer, and struck the employee's head.  The employee was killed.
An employee was bitten by a cat, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

An employee was blending soy beans from one silo to another. Afterwards, the employee cleared a jam in a grain shoot generated by the soy beans, resulting in him being engulfed and killed by the soy beans.

During the boiling of noodles with an Imperial noodle boiler, a plastic floor drain cover broke, causing the boiler to shift and splash hot water onto the employee's foot. The employee suffered a burn on their left ankle joint as a result of the incident.

An employee was bucking a felled tree when the tree trunk struck the employee, causing a fatal skull fracture.

An employee was building pallets by nailing the pallets together.The employer states that when the employee was nailing, the nail bounced off the head of another nail and the employee received an eye injury. njury.

An employee was caring for adults with disabilities when he was attacked by one of his patients. The employee suffered multiple injuries that resulted in his death.

An employee was carrying door frames to the roof of a building. As he was walking, on the roof, he lost his footing and fell to the ground. The roof was wet from rain and the employee sustained a fracture to his wrist. He was hospitalized and received treatment.

While carrying tools up to the second floor, an employee felt tired and stopped to rest on a stack of sheet rock. Despite attempts by a co-worker to assist and get water, the employee passed out and ultimately died from cardiac arrest.

The employee was found caught in a rotating clutch assembly by a coworker at 2:22 PM. He had been attempting to start the oil rig when his shirt got caught in the machine, resulting in his death. His torn shirt was found next to his body under the machine.

An employee was caught in-between powered industrial truck 's body and mast and was killed.

An employee was caulking while positioned on a baker scaffold.  The employee fell from the scaffold approximately 5 to 6 feet to the concrete floor, suffered a head injury and was killed.

An employee was changing a  cooling fan belt of a Toyota forklift (model number: 02-5PO35). During work, the vehicle fell off the lift it was elevated on and crushed the employee's upper torso. The employee was killed as a result of his injuries.

During a die change for manufacturing, an employee accidentally activated a crane with his right hand while using his left finger to check the collar on the die. As a result, the suspended part of the die lowered onto his left index finger, causing a partial amputation. Fortunately, the employee did not require hospitalization.
An employee was changing a light bulb in a swimming pool.  The employee was electrocuted when they contacted a live circuit that was supposed to be off.

During a routine maintenance task, an employee's hand was crushed between an elevator and a well head when removing debris underneath the elevator. An employee was changing a seal on a power swivel.  The rigging chain on the tong broke, striking the employee in the side of his head. The employee suffered a fractured skull and was killed.

An employee was changing out a machine.  The employee lifted the door and realized that he missed a step in the procedure and let the door go before it was locked in the "up" position.  The door came down on the employee's hand and amputated the tip of their ring finger.

An employee was changing out suspension mounts on a shaker head. However, the shaker head was not properly secured, causing it to fall and crush his right foot. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injury.

During a routine maintenance task, an employee's left index finger was caught and fractured by the outer sleeve of a bell jar tester as the inner section was being lowered for pad replacement. The employee required hospitalization for treatment.

The employee was fatally injured while working on changing the rear brakes of a company utility truck when the vehicle fell from the jack and stand, crushing him. Despite being rushed to the hospital, the employee succumbed to his injuries and passed away due to asphyxiation from a crushed chest on June 12, 2016.
An employee was changing the rollers on a bulldozer.  The employee was struck by the bulldozer and he was killed.

An employee changing a tire on a forklift experienced a workplace accident when the load shifted, causing the supporting jack stand to fold. The forklift fell on the employee, resulting in a severe head laceration and crushed chest. Emergency medical attention was required for the injured employee trapped under the heavy machinery.

The employee was tragically killed while attempting to gain control of a rolling dump truck, weighing 26,000 lbs. He fell from the running board and was crushed under the rear truck tire, suffering blunt force trauma to his body and head. The incident occurred as he chased after the runaway vehicle in an effort to prevent any further damage or harm.
An employee was chasing his cowboy hat that the wind had blown into interstate traffic. The employee was struck and killed by car trailer.

During railroad spur line tamping and reconstruction operations, an employee was checking the rail line's level when a flat storage building's wall collapsed, engulfing the employee in grain. The force of the grain pushed the employee under the tamper, resulting in their death from asphyxiation.
An employee was checking a roof for damage from a wind storm.The employee fell from the roof and sustained a severe head injury and was killed. ry and was killed.

An employee was checking air tank for leaks. The employee had not removed 125 psi air pressure from tank and was struck in their head by the pipe plug when it blew off from the tank.

An employee was checking an argon purge inside of a process vessel. The employee was overcome by an oxygen deficient atmosphere, and fell 10-feet to the platform below. The employee suffered from possible spinal injury from the fall, and asphyxiation and was killed.

An employee was checking for an air leak inside the cabinet of a bagging machine. The employee heard someone call "hey" and turned to see who it was and felt something hit his finger. The employee thought it was an air line. The employee's tip of his left hand ring finger was amputated.

A tragic incident occurred at the facility involving a 14-foot box truck rental with Ford E350 chassis. The employee conducting an initial inspection started the engine and stepped out of the vehicle, which unexpectedly went into reverse and struck the employee, resulting in fatal crushing injuries. The truck came to a stop 30 yards away after running over the employee's body.

During a routine check-in of a semi-trailer truck, an employee was noting truck numbers on the right side when the driver suddenly returned and drove off. The employee's head and body were caught under the right rear wheels and were run over as a result.
An employee was checking inventory in the back of a freezer truck. The employee suffered a heart attack unrelated to his job and died of natural causes.
An employee was checking on walnut orchard. For some unknown reasons, the employee drowned.
An employee was checking roof felt before installing battens.  The employee fell from the roof and was killed.

An employee was checking the belts on the HVAC motor/pulley.  The employee touched the belt while it was still turning and it pulled his finger into the pulley.  The employee amputated the tip of their middle finger on his left hand.
An employee was checking the contents inside the semi-trailer. The employee was struck and run over by a 18 wheeler semi-trailer. The employee suffered blunt force trauma and was killed.

An employee was checking the vineyard prior to crews beginning harvesting work. The employee suffered a heart attack and died.

The employee was boosting the battery of a tractor and was standing between the tires checking the voltage on the starter. In a tragic turn of events, he started the tractor causing it to move forward and roll over him, resulting in his death.
An employee was checking tire pressure and/or tread depth on a truck.  A load of trusses fell and crushed the employee, resulting in fatal injuries.

An employee was cleaning a batch mixer. The employee reached under the machine and suffered an amputated finger from the mixing blades.
An employee was cleaning a beer tap system at the Bavarian Aid Society, when he collapsed and died.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt of excess product, when his left hand became caught in between the conveyor belt and a tension roller. The employee sustained a fracture of his left wrist and multiple lacerations, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when the belt became stuck and caught the employee between the conveyor winding apparatus and the conveyor tower.  The employee was killed as a result of internal injuries caused by the conveyor belt winder.

The employee was cleaning a kitchen hood with degreaser and other cleaning agents, and experienced dizziness and shortness of breath at the end of his shift. Despite the ambulance being called, the worker died on the way to the hospital. The employer was not present at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning a machine in preparation for a production run. The employee stuck his hand in a machine while it was running and amputated his right ring finger on the mixing blade.

During the cleaning of a metal roof, an employee fell through an inadequately covered and unmarked opening for a new air conditioning unit. The employee landed on the concrete floor, sustaining injuries to his head and back. He was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

An employee was cleaning a product jam and had his hand caught in a pinch point at the rollers.  The employee suffered several lacerations and bone fractures.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.
