While cleaning an aircraft, an employee fell approximately 25 feet from a elevated box truck platform onto the ground below. The fall resulted in serious injuries including a torn aorta, multiple broken ribs, and facial fractures and dislocations.

While cleaning and patching an exterior concrete wall, an employee parked a JLG boom lift inside a fence next to a public road where it had been left by the rental company. After climbing down from the lift and attempting to raise it for security purposes, the boom lift made contact with overhead 12000 V power lines, resulting in the employee being electrocuted. Emergency Services responded to the accident scene.
An employee was cleaning around a skylight. The employee lost jis balance and fell through the skylight. The employee suffered from broken bones and punctured lungs, for which he was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning blast debris and blasting steel grits off the deck of a Safespan Systems suspended platform.  A tow boat with two empty barges lost control and struck the suspended platform the employee was standing on.  The employee was killed when he was decapitated.

During the cleaning of coating tracks in coding machine #8, an employee noticed a stuck sheet and attempted to remove it. After stopping the machine and accidentally spilling paint, the employee cleaned up the spill and ran several sheets through to ensure the machine was clean. However, one of the sheets came out with paint, indicating the need for further cleaning. Despite the machine still running, the employee reached into the machine and suffered partial amputation of their left index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was cleaning equipment. The employee reached under guard to remove debris without deenergizing the machine. The machine cycled, amputating the employees left index finger.
An employee was cleaning filters in a deli. The employee was standing on the fryer and slipped into hot grease.  The employee received burns to his legs and later died.

During a routine gutter cleaning task, an employee fell through a skylight on the roof of a building, dropping approximately 23 feet onto the concrete below. The skylight, measuring about 20' by 8' and 1/16th of an inch thick, was located at the peak of the roof. The employee suffered blunt force head injuries as a result of the fall, as confirmed by the coroner's report.

During the cleaning of a railcar that previously carried latex, an employee lost consciousness due to an oxygen-deficient atmosphere. First responders attempted to revive the employee but were unsuccessful. Another employee also lost consciousness when entering the railcar and had to be taken to the hospital. A third employee fell from a ladder inside the railcar, lost consciousness, but managed to self-rescue before being transported to the hospital for treatment.
An employee was cleaning off the tailgate after delivering new back fill gravel. A skid steer backed into and crushed the employee against the tailgate of the dump truck and the employee died.
An employee was cleaning or preparing to clean a bathroom. The employee passed out potentially overcome by unknown cleaning chemical vapor. The employee was killed.

The employee was cleaning a blender rotary valve in a cocoa processing reactor machine without following lockout/tagout procedures. The machine was still powered on when the operator started it, causing the employee's right index finger to be amputated when it came into contact with the moving parts.
An employee was cleaning out a cluster machine mixer and stuck his hand inside it while it was running. The employee amputated the tip of a finger when he struck the blade inside the mixer.
An employee was cleaning out a grease trap, when he fell head first into the trap. The employee was engulfed in the liquid grease and drowned.

An employee was cleaning out a silo. As the employee pushed the sweep auger with his knees, he slipped and fell onto the sweep auger. He sustained broken ribs, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.
An employee was cleaning out a surveying monument, when a passenger vehicle traveling east bound struck the employee killing him. The driver of the passenger vehicle did not see the employee in time.
An employee was cleaning out debris around roof drains when the employee collapsed and died.

A 17-year-old employee with two weeks of experience on the job was cleaning scrap metal beneath an automated index table for an Amada laser cutting machine. A coworker trained the employee on how to clean out the scrap metal with a rake and broom, while continuing to run the machine. The coworker accidentally indexed the table, causing it to lower onto the employee and pin him beneath it. Despite the coworker's efforts to stop the machine, the employee was unable to breathe and suffered from

An employee was cleaning out the back of a pick-up truck bed. The employee landed incorrectly when they attempted to climb out of the truck bed and fell to the ground.  The employee fractured their leg from their fall.

An employee was fatally injured while attempting to unjam the Lamb Hammermill after material became stuck in the conveyor belt. The employee used a chainfall to raise the access door in order to remove the jammed material, but the door disengaged from the chainfall and fell on the employee's head, causing his death. This procedure is typically performed monthly when the Hammermill becomes jammed.

An employee was cleaning outside of Boiler Unit Number 1 at a power plant.  The employee was knocked to the ground and struck by flying debris when an explosion occurred inside the facility. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

During a routine cleaning job, an employee's left arm got caught in a rotating shaft of a conveyor while trying to remove material wedged in it. The employee suffered severe fractures and crushing injuries, leading to hospitalization for treatment.

An employee was cleaning primers out of the priming bowl in a barricade, when an explosion occurred. The employee sustained multiple burns and abrasions to his forearms, chest, face, and hands, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

The employee was cleaning processing equipment for chicken breasts without proper lockout and tagging. Her right shirt sleeve got caught, resulting in her hand and wrist being pulled into the machine. She suffered fractures and lacerations to her right wrist, requiring hospitalization and treatment.
An employee was cleaning sand from a hopper. The employee's fingers were caught-in the gate and the tips of the middle and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was cleaning a Kice Aspirator when he reached into an open hole and amputated his left middle finger and the tip of his left ring finger. Despite being trained to only clean the visible area and call maintenance for blocked fan blades, the employee attempted to clean the blades himself. Thankfully, the employee did not require hospitalization following the incident.
An employee was cleaning the chain and sprocket of a motor, when the rag she was using got caught by a pinch point. The employee's right index finger was pinched as well, resulting in its amputation.

The incident involved an employee cleaning a dough sheeting/moulding machine, which was plugged in but in an off position. The machine unexpectedly turned on while the employee was cleaning it, causing their right index finger to get caught in the rollers. This resulted in degloving and breaking of the finger due to the lack of protection guards on the in-running side of the rolls.
An employee was cleaning the inside of a cement mixer. The mechanism inside the mixer started up. The employer was caught between an arm support and some paddles. He was crushed and killed. killed.

While cleaning the paint machine, an employee noticed paint dripping from the doctor blade onto a turning roller. In an attempt to clean the blade with a rag, the employee's hand got caught in the rollers' nip point, resulting in the amputation of three fingers. The employee received medical treatment after being hospitalized.

While cleaning the platform next to the conveyor belt, an employee accidentally picked up a handheld pneumatic chipper that was located on the floor. The employee, wearing gloves, had their right hand pulled into the pinch point at the top of the moving conveyor belt, resulting in lacerations, fractures, and immobility in the affected area. The injured employee was hospitalized and received treatment for the injuries sustained.

An employee was cleaning the pour hole to remove molten metal build upfrom a die machine. The machine cycled, and one of the employee's middle fingers became caught between the ram and die.  He sustained an amputation of his middle finger, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

An employee was cleaning the rollers of a slitter machine during its operation. As the employee was cleaning the rollers, his right hand became pinned between the rollers. His right pinky finger was amputated and he sustained multiple hand fractures.
An employee was cleaning the roof of debris and walked back to the ladder when it started to rain.  The employee slipped off the ladder and broke his right tibia.

An employee was cleaning trash from under the mechanical dock ramp. The mechanical dock ramp fell, crushing the employee. There was no indication that the employee had used the support bar provided by the manufacture. The employee suffered head and chest injuries and was killed.

The employee was tragically killed when his hair and hairnet became entangled in a seed sorting conveyor machine, pulling him into the machine and pinning him in a position that obstructed his breathing. The employee died from asphyxiation as a result of the incident.
An employee was cleaning underneath a boat and drowned.

An employee was cleaning underneath a loom. The employee reached in with their right hand into a cabinet/gearbox to remove jute while the loom was off.  A coworker started the loom and caught the employee's hand in the gearbox/cabinet.  The employee suffered a broken arm.
An employee was cleaning up a job site after finishing an electrical repair job. The employee had a seizure or stoke apparently due to a coronary related illness.

An employee was cleaning up a work site below a new masonry construction of a commercial building.  The employee was struck in the head when a masonry brick/block fell to the exterior of the building from the third floor.  The employee was killed with multiple skull fractures.

The incident occurred when an employee fell 11 ft from a second-story breezeway bridge while collecting scrap lumber handed down by another employee on the roof. The fall resulted in blunt force injuries to the employee's skull, leading to their death. The lack of protection at the edge of the bridge contributed to the tragic accident.

An employee was cleaning up the kitchen area before walking into the freezer.  The employee was trapped in the freezer overnight for approximately 13 hours.   The employee's husband reported her missing at 7:30 a.m. on March 22, 2016, and the employee was discovered at 9:00 a.m.
An employee was cleaning vegetation debris from a roof when he stepped on a plastic skylight and fell 20 feet below to a concrete floor. The employee was killed.

An employee was cleaning wood shaving and dust from a planer with a blow gun while it was running.  The employee mangled their left hand and amputated two fingers when the blow gun was caught by the planer , which pulled the employee's hand into its blades.

An employee cleaning the top of a "Mag Eject" frame with an air hose was pinned against the loading edge of the frame by the moving magazine shuttle, resulting in blunt force trauma. The machine was not properly locked-out and the employee was standing in the direction of the shuttle's travel when the incident occurred.

An employee sustained severe lacerations to his left index finger while clearing a jam from a bagger machine. He was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries. The incident investigation determined that proper lockout/tagout procedures were not followed before removing the jam.
An employee was clearing a jam of cardboard in a compactor. The machine activated when the employee was clearing the jam.  The employee was crushed and killed.

During the clearing of a jam in the knotching head section of Cleat Line Number 41, an employee turned off the cleat line, removed the safety guard, and attempted to dislodge the blockage with a metal bar. Unfortunately, the bar hit the rotating head, catching the employee's left hand between the bar and the frame. This resulted in a partial amputation of the thumb and fractures to the index and pinky fingers on the left hand.
An employee was clearing a jam to a conveyor belt system.  The employee caught their left hand between two rollers on an overhead conveyor belt system and pulled some skin back from their hand.
An employee was clearing a jam within the stamping machine.  The employee's finger was pinched by the stamping machine when it cycled and amputated their fingertip.

During a routine maintenance task, an employee's hand got caught in a packaging machine as he was trying to clear a strip of plastic from it. As a result, both the tips of his index and ring fingers on his left hand were amputated.

While clearing aluminum chips from a screw conveyor that had caused the machine to stop, an employee's left shirt sleeve got caught on the pin of the conveyor after he restarted it. This resulted in his arm being pulled into the conveyor, causing skin removal, tendon damage, dislocation/breakage of bones, and lacerations. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

An employee was clearing an assembly line of buckets. While clearing the machine, a bucket that was covering the activation eye was removed, and the machine restarted. The employee's upper right arm and shoulder were crushed by the extrusion machine.

An employee was clearing brush that had been cut by a coworker and reached over the chainsaw as it was being operated.  The employee reached over the moving saw chain and suffered a right wrist laceration when caught by the saw blade.
An employee was clearing brush when he was struck by a falling tree that another employee had cut down.  The worker was struck in the head by a tree and he was killed.
An employee was clearing debris from equipment (Sandvik QE440).  The employee's left arm was caught in a conveyor system. The employee was asphyxiated and killed.
An employee was clearing ice from inside an ice making machine. The ice machine engaged and crushed the employee.  The employee was killed from asphyxiation.

An employee clearing jammed nails from an Injection Molded Plastic Collator Machine had her right arm caught in the orientation wheel when the machine started unexpectedly. The employee suffered lacerations and a fracture, requiring surgery.

An employee was clearing some wood from the conveyor belt.  The employee's glove was caught by the conveyor belt and pulled his hand into the rollers.  The employee amputated the finger pad from their right hand little finger.  The employee was not hospitalized.

The employee was using a 10 foot ladder to inspect an 8 foot platform when they fell, landing on the concrete floor. EMS responded and took the employee to Saint Francis Medical Center for treatment of a head laceration and fractured clavicle.
An employee was climbing a fence and fell onto the pavement. The employee sustained head and back injuries.

An employee was climbing a fixed ladder attached to a welded frame scaffold. The employee fell from a fall height of approximately 27 feet suffering fatal, crushing injuries to the head and body upon impact of the concrete street.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to access a roof. He fell to the ground and sustained a head injury and broken leg. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

The employee was climbing a fixed metal ladder when he lost his grip and fell 16 feet to the concrete floor below. He sustained a broken wrist and injuries to his back. He was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.
An employee was climbing a hill when a tree fell and crushed him.
An employee was climbing a ladder and the ladder slipped out from under him. The employee fell onto the concrete floor and was killed from head trauma.

An employee fell from a ladder while climbing from one flat roof to another to service the HVAC system. The fall occurred when the employee swung his bag of tools up, causing the ladder feet to slip. The employee suffered a fractured L4 vertebrae and required hospitalization and treatment.

An employee was climbing a ladder onto the 14ft empty food grade tank to open a hatch to provide additional ventilation and light to the inside of the tank. The employee fell and was killed on-site. on-site. on-site.

During a cleaning activity, an employee fell from a ladder that slipped on concrete while he was attempting to access the roof of a structure. The fall resulted in a fractured elbow, leading to hospitalization and surgery to insert a metal plate for stabilization.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a thermostat. The employee feel from a Keller 97 Series 6' Fiberglass Stepladder onto the concrete floor.  The employee suffered fatal head injuries.
An employee was climbing a ladder when he fell and struck his head. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injury.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it became unstable and the employee fell off, fracturing their vertebra and ribs. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.
An employee was climbing a ladder while carrying roofing materials.The employee fell 16 feet to a concrete pad below and was killed. as killed.
An employee was climbing a ladder.  For unknown reasons, the employee lost his balance and fell.  The employee landed on the sidewalk, received blunt force head trauma and was killed.
An employee was climbing a ladder. The employee fell from ladder. The employee suffered from head injuries and was killed.
An employee was climbing a tree and was electrocuted while performing tree trimming activities.

The employee was trimming tree limbs on the property while wearing safety gear and carrying a chainsaw. In the process, he accidentally made contact with a high tension wire, resulting in electrocution and his death.

An employee was climbing a vertical ladder to access a scaffold platform. The employee fell 60 feet to a lower platform walkway and was not tied off.  The employee sustained a concussion and broken bones. The employee was killed.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder. The employee fell from the ladder, hit the concrete floor and suffered head trauma. He was killed.
An employee was climbing an adjustable extension ladder when it slid out from under him. The employee fell approximately 8 feet, fracturing both his heels when he struck the ground.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder with a packet of roofing shingles. The employee tripped or slipped and fell 18 feet to a concrete slab. The employee was killed.
An employee was climbing down a fixed ladder after fixing a roof leak. The employee fell from the ladder and broke his ankle. The employee was not hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a ladder.  The employee slipped and fell from the ladder, striking their head to the ground. The employee was killed.

An employee was climbing down a ladder. The ladder slipped from under him causing him to fall from the ladder into an elevator shaft. The employee received a fracture to head. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

An employee fell from an 8-foot ladder while climbing down, landing on his left side and hitting the left side of his head. A co-worker called for help, and the foreman called emergency services. The employee was taken to the hospital with injuries including a head cut, concussion, and broken ribs.
An employee was climbing on a deep fat fryer to retrieve oil filters, slipped and fell into the hot oil.  The employee received burns to his legs.

An employee was climbing on the pipe jacket. When he climbed down the pipe jacket, the employee stepped back into a floor hole and fell to the floor. The employee struck his head and shoulder on the floor and was killed.

An employee was climbing onto a drilling rig skid. The employee grabbed a hydraulic cylinder to assist climbing onto the drilling rig skid. The employee was struck by the hydraulic cylinder and sustained amputation of the right leg.

The employee was injured while attempting to unjam a hopper on a Balcan Lamp Recycling Machine. He fell from an 8-foot step ladder that he had improperly leaned against the machine, resulting in a fracture to his lower left leg. The investigation found that the employee had not used the ladder as intended, leading to the accident.
An employee was climbing or descending from a homemade wooden straight ladder. The ladder slipped and the employee fell to the ground, striking his head and was killed.

An employee was climbing out of a scissor lift basket. The employee climbed out of the scissor lift before tying off to an anchor point. He fell 22-ft 10-in. through a 76-in. by 48-in. hole in the decking. The employee was hospitalized and treated for unspecified injuries.

An employee was climbing scaffolding. As the employee navigated walk boards to access the roof of the building, the top rail of the scaffold came loose. The employee fell 12-14 feet, suffering a neck injury and broken ribs.
An employee was climbing stairs, when the employee collapsed of an apparent heart attack.

The employee was working overhead on a frame scaffold when he climbed down the built-in ladder and stepped on a wooden uncleated plank, causing it to slip out from under him. This resulted in the employee falling to the ground and hitting the support rails of the scaffold. As a result, the employee suffered fractured ribs and had to be hospitalized.

The employee was fatally injured after falling 40 feet from a tubular welded frame scaffold while trying to reach an elevated work platform by climbing the frames and cross bracing. The impact with the concrete slab below resulted in severe trauma and suspected multiple fractures to all parts of the worker's body. Tragically, the employee did not survive the fall.

An employee was climbing the front mast's ladder to take some measurements. At some point the employee fell down from the mast to the deck. The employee died from his injuries. The employee sustained internal injuries from the pipes.

An employee was climbing two tier section of scaffolding.  The employee climbed the two tier scaffolding without safety glasses on and was standing up on the upper section. He was poked in the eye by metal wire protruding from ceiling. The employee suffered left eye injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing up a metal ladder while holding a small chainsaw with his right hand. The employee proceeded to cut a tree branch but felt backwards to the ground. The employee hit his head upon impact with the ground and lost conscious. He was killed.

During the process of closing the cover of a washer, a small cloud of chlorine dioxide was accidentally released, leading to an employee inhaling the vapor. The affected employee started coughing and experiencing difficulty in breathing, prompting an evaluation by medical professionals. As a precaution, thirteen other employees were also taken to a local hospital for evaluation for exposure to chlorine dioxide vapors.

While collecting a dumpster from a commercial customer, an employee was tragically struck and killed by a private motor vehicle. The employee had rolled the dumpster to the back of the garbage truck and was in the process of lifting and emptying it when the incident occurred. The employee was standing on the roadway at the time of the accident.
An employee was collecting garbage, suffered a heat stroke, and died.
An employee was coming down using an attic stairwell ladder when he slipped and fell. The employee suffered from head injuries and was killed.

While communicating with welders and a crane operator at the bottom of a wood framed stair well, an employee fell 57 feet after one side of the guardrail detached from the post. The employee hit horizontal supports on the way down and suffered multiple injuries including fractured ribs, hip, knee, and a hernia in the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized for treatment.

An employee was compacting soil underneath a headwall footing as soil was being backfilled on the other side of a 4,000 lb. headwall. The cement wall collapsed on the employee who sustained multiple blunt force trauma injuries and was killed.
An employee was compacting trash that was in the back of a garbage truck.  He was caught by the compactor and his left side and head were crushed by the compactor.

During a Preventive Maintenance Inspection/Servicing on a Dematic Conveyor Unit, an employee's hand became caught in the pulley/belt mechanism, resulting in multiple lacerations and a broken finger. The employee was hospitalized due to the severity of the injuries sustained.

During maintenance work in a hand dug well, an employee slipped from a ladder and fell approximately 40 feet into 15 feet deep water. Multiple coworkers attempted to assist, but the employee ultimately had to wait for Anne Arundel County EMS to rescue them using a rope. The employee sustained abrasions, cuts, and lacerations to their back, wrist, and hand but refused medical treatment.

During boat assembly, an employee's toe was crushed when a boat cover placed on the motor box lid caused it to close due to excessive weight. The employee's right big toe required partial amputation as a result, leading to hospitalization and treatment for the injury.

During a pressure test of a pneumatic hopper carrying hydraulic fracturing sand, an employee was struck by the metal hatch cover and fell off the trailer, resulting in fatal blunt force injuries to the head and chest.
An employee was conducting a storm water check inspection using an all terrain vehicle. The employee was found by a coworker under the all terrain vehicle and the employee was killed.

While conducting a walkthrough of a unit assigned for cabinet installation, an employee fell four feet onto a concrete subfloor after tripping over a board on the floor. The poorly lit area made it difficult to identify the board's purpose, leading to the employee inadvertently exposing themselves and others to a potential hazard. The employee sustained injuries to their right knee, left shoulder, arm, neck, and back, requiring hospitalization and treatment.

During repair work on a spin dryer, an employee slipped and fell into the auger/screw conveyor system, resulting in a fractured leg and lacerated heel. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of their injuries.

During repairs on the West Whiting overhead crane, an employee was using a personal fall arrest system with a lifeline attached to the building's structure. After completing the repairs, the employee remained on the bridge while the crane was moved by the operator. Unfortunately, the employee was dragged off the crane and fell approximately 34-ft to the ground below when the lanyard's hook broke. Tragically, the employee succumbed to multiple injuries to the head and torso at the hospital.
An employee was conducting timber falling operations when he was  crushed by a hemlock log.

An employee was connecting a cement mixer to a truck for towing. As he was standing between the truck and the cement mixer trailer, he was struck by the truck. The employee sustained a broken leg as a result, which he was hospitalized for treatment.

During a routine job task, an employee was connecting a hoisting hook to a materials trailer when the hook slipped off and struck the employee in the face. The impact resulted in severe blunt force trauma and facial fractures, tragically leading to the employee's death.

An employee was connecting a drawbar to the hitch of a tractor.  The employee put his finger into the screw hole to align the drawbar and a coworker pulled on the bar.  The employee amputated his right index finger.  The employee was not hospitalized.

An employee was connecting a dumpster to the back of the garbage truck. The dumpster was not properly secured to the back of the garbage truck. The dumpster pinned the employee up against a concrete wall. The employee sustained crushing injuries to his chest area and was killed.
An employee was connecting a stove to an electrical circuit. The employee received an electric shock and died.

An employee was assisting a driver in connecting a trailer to a 5th wheel plate using hand signals and a flashlight, kneeling underneath a table of casing for a better view. The driver directed him to kneel in that spot for safety. However, the employee moved from his position and was fatally pinned between the trailer bed and the table of casing, resulting in asphyxiation.

An employee was connecting a wire cable to the block of a drilling rig. The employee connecting a rope cable from a winch on a pickup truck to the block of a drilling rig was entangled. The employee was caught in between the cord and the winch and was killed..
An employee was constructing a fire line when he was struck by a falling tree. The employee's head was crushed by a tree branch.
An employee was counting inventory on the fourth tier of a warehouse rack.  The employee fell 24 feet to the ground and was killed when the wire rack flipped.
An employee was covering a floor hole. He dropped bundle of shingles on the temporary floor hole and fell to lower level. The employee was hospitalized and treated for unspecified injuries.
An employee was covering a hole when he fell through the hole and landed on the floor 14 feet below.  The employee received contusions, fractures and lacerations.

During a work task of covering a wooden formwork panel with a tarpaulin on a flatbed trailer, an employee lost their balance while standing up and fell approximately 7 feet to the ground. The employee suffered fractured ribs and a left shoulder separation, and was admitted to Eden Medical Center for treatment. They were released on March 29, 2017.

An employee was creating a 2 inch by 1 inch angle part from steel stock using an Amada Press Brake.  The employee was using a 1/4 barrier guard to form the stock and caught the tip of their right index finger with the press brake ram.
An employee was crossing a private road and while in the crosswalk he was struck by moving vehicle. The employee was killed from head trauma.
An employee was crossing in front of a semi-truck when it moved forward, struck and killed the employee.
An employee was crossing the roadway to get salt and shovel to clear snow.  The employee was struck and killed by an automobile.
An employee was crushed by a trailer and truck during disconnect. The employee was killed from crushing injuries.
An employee was crushed when a 3,200 pound HVAC unit tipped over from a lift truck.
An employee was cut by a chain saw and sustains bone loss.
An employee was cutting a 2 by 6 wood piece with a circular saw. The employee amputated his left arm index finger.

During the process of cutting a black locust tree with a chainsaw, an employee was struck by a falling dead limb which injured his shoulder. In a state of panic, the employee ran into the path of the falling tree, resulting in being pinned to the ground and tragically losing his life due to internal injuries and multiple broken bones.

An employee was cutting a frame horn off a vehicle. During cutting, thesaw kicked back and struck the employee in the face. The impact of the saw striking the employee's face resulted in a fractured jaw, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

An employee was cutting a gasket channel in a pipe on a rolling machine.  The employee's glove was caught in the machine which pulled his hand into the machine. The employee's little finger from their left hand  was amputated but he was not hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a lawn.  A tree limb fell and struck the employee, and killed him.

An employee was cutting a piece of dura block rubber with a chop saw.  The employee was removing a piece from the saw blade and accidentally turned the saw on.  The employee caught their finger with the blade and lacerated it.

During a routine task of cutting scrap aluminum with a chop saw, an employee suffered a severe injury when their left index finger accidentally came into contact with the moving blade. The employee had briefly looked away after making a cut and failed to notice the proximity of their finger to the blade. As a result, the finger was severely cut and required amputation at the first knuckle.

A trench collapse occurred while an employee was cutting an old water main to install a new one, resulting in a fractured hip and hospitalization. The incident was due to lack of shoring or proper sloping/benching efforts, exacerbated by close proximity to road and rail traffic.

An employee was cutting a rafter tail using saw horses at a work table and a Makita worm drive powered saw. The employee finished a cut and lowered the saw before it stopped running which contacted the employee's leg. The employee's leg was cut.

An employee was cutting a section of sheathing with a cutting saw circular in order to create an opening for a staircase. The employee was not wearing fall protection and fell 9 feet 3 inches to the basement floor below.  The employee received a fractured eye socket and was hospitalized.

During the process of cutting a steel pipe with a Stihl Gas-Powered Cut-off saw, the employee was struck in the face due to a kickback caused by the pipe pinching the saw blade. The employee suffered a laceration in the face and neck, along with muscle damage, which required surgery. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

During a steel cutting task with an oxy-acetylene torch, an employee put the torch down on a metal gang box after making a first cut. When they resumed cutting on the other side, an explosion occurred, causing the lid of the gang box to forcefully break their right arm.
An employee was cutting a tree branch down and it struck him in the face and head, killing him.

An employee was cutting a tree branch that was not hoisted while standing on a ladder. The branch fell onto the ladder and ricocheted the employee where he fell head first onto the root of the tree below him. The employee sustained a head injury and is killed.
An employee was cutting a tree branch. The tree branch bounced against the chainsaw and the employee's left forearm was struck by the chainsaw. The employee was killed by the injury.
An employee was cutting a tree down when it fell on top of him and crushed the employee.

An employee was cutting a tree from a basket truck. While the employee was cutting a tree, he decided to tie it to the basket of the truck. As the tree fell, its weight pulled the employee from the bucket. The employee fell approximately 40 to 50 feet and was killed.
An employee was cutting a tree when it fell into a neighboring tree, causing that tree's top to fall, striking the employee. The employee was killed from his injuries.
An employee was cutting a wall opening using as saw for HVAC duct. He fell off an A frame ladder and fractured his wrist. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

An employee was cutting an 18-inch oak tree limb.  The employee was knocked off of the tree by lifelines getting caught by the falling limb being cut away. The climber fell and struck his face into the trunk of the tree and was asphyxiated after hanging in place for over 2 hours.
An employee was cutting an 8 inch waterline inside an 8 foot trench.  As the employee cut the pipe, the rescuesaw kicked back and cut his neck.

An employee was cutting an aluminum I-beam on the Helipad of an  offshore oil rig.  The employee cut the last I-beam in place while tied off to the beam and the beam fell into the water with the employee and the employee drowned.

An employee was cutting an electrical cable using a box cutter.  The employee amputated a portion of his left thumb when the  box cutter slipped and cut into the employee's thumb approximately 1 inch below his fingertip.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.
An employee was cutting beef feet with a meat saw when then employee cut and partially amputated his right thumb.

An employee was cutting boards using a chop saw.  The employee reached under the chop saw's guard and accidentally triggered the pedal.  The employee amputated two fingers from his left hand. The employee was not hospitalized.
An employee was cutting branches.  The employee fell 15 feet to the ground and was killed by multiple blunt force trauma.
An employee was cutting bread to make croutons for salads. The employee felt dizzy, fainted and fell, hitting his head against the floor. The employee sustained a skull fracture and was killed.

An employee was cutting down 32 inch diameter Poplar tree. The tree reportedly kicked back after striking a second tree, nearby. The employee was struck by the falling tree and suffered chest and head trauma. The employee was killed.
An employee was cutting down a large tree. The tree came off the block, striking the employee in the face. The employee was killed.

An employee was cutting down a large tree. The tree trunk splintered and fell. The employee was killed and it is unknown if worker fell to the ground or was caught between a cut and existing tree trunk.
An employee was cutting down a palm tree. A tree limb fell and struck the employee in the head, killing him.

The employee was cutting down a tree when it fell on him, leading to severe injuries including collapsed lungs, cracked sternum, broken back, broken neck, and Quadriplegia. An employee was felling a tree when a tree branch from a nearby tree went around the tree being felled, broke off a branch from the second tree which fell and struck  the employee. The employee's upper body was struck by the falling tree branch. The employee was killed.

An employee was felling a tree with a diameter of 91 inches at the base of the trunk.  The employee fell approximately 28 feet to the paved asphalt and struck his head on the ground.  The employee was killed from blunt force trauma to the head and neck.
An employee was felling a tree.  The employee was swept out of the tree and struck a log and the employee was killed.

An employee was felling an ash tree with a chain saw.The tree barber chaired and struck the employee on the back pinning him face down on the ground.  The employee was killed by the falling tree. the falling tree.

An employee utilizing a towable man lift to cut down trees had a portion of the tree fall sideways, striking the man lift and causing it to overturn. The employee was thrown out of the bucket and fell 38 feet to the ground, resulting in fatal internal injuries.
An employee was felling trees.  The employee had felled several trees when one tree up-rooted and struck the employee in the head.  The employee was killed due to blunt force trauma to the head.

An employee was filling a drum with a chemical located on a pumping unit on an oil well site. The employee was struck by a counterweight of the pumping unit and pinned between it and the frame of the unit.  The employee sustained crushing injuries to the torso and was killed.
An employee was filling a dump truck tire with air when the tire ruptured. The employee was concussed by the tire rupture and was killed.

An employee was filling a pipe with fluid. The employee was struck by a tool that fell from above and resulted in amputating several fingers from the employee's left hand.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries
An employee was filling an order while on an order picker.  He fell 15 feet from the picker to a concrete floor. The employee sustained a fatal head injury.
An employee was finishing concrete with a bull float and he became overheated. The employee died from heat exposure.

The employee was finishing unbolting and opening a side manway when they were found unconscious at the bottom of an aerial lift. Coworkers called 911 and began CPR with an AED, but the employee was pronounced dead at the hospital. The cause of death was determined to be hypertensive heart disease.

The incident involved an employee who was installing PVC membrane on a roof without being connected to the roof anchor. The employee slipped and fell approximately 16-18 feet to the ground, resulting in a shoulder injury, fractured vertebrae, and a broken pelvis. The employee had to be hospitalized for treatment.

An employee was finishing work for the evening and was assisting a coworker to cover a telecommunication trench with trench plates.  The employee placed a hand underneath the trench plate and fractured his left ring fingertip. The employee was not hospitalized.

An employee was fixing a clock in the bus. The employee caught her right hand index finger between the fan belt and pulley, amputating it to the first knuckle.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for her injuries.
An employee was fixing a loose timing belt and the machine was activated. The employee had his hand in the machine and amputated the tip of the right middle finger inside the machine.
An employee was fixing and adjusting a machine. The employee's finger got caught into the machine and was amputated.

The incident involved an employee working on a steep roof without fall protection, leading to a fall through an unprotected skylight onto a concrete floor. The employee suffered severe injuries, including multiple broken bones and swelling of the brain, ultimately resulting in their death on January 20, 2016.

The incident involved an employee who was flagging along a road to assist a crew in removing and replacing a telecommunications pole. Unfortunately, the employee was struck and killed by a vehicle driven by an elderly individual. The site did not have proper signage, cones, or channeling devices, and only one person was utilized for flagging purposes, leading to confusion for both East and West bound traffic.

During the process of folding and securing lunch tables in a school auditorium, an employee was struck in the right leg by a falling table. The employee suffered fractures to her leg, leading to hospitalization and three days of treatment.
An employee was forging a piece of material with a punch press machine. The employees left finger was pinched and severed by tongs resulting in the amputation of the left index finger.

A man was discovered deceased at his father-in-law's residence following his workday. The man had been working on a truck earlier in the day, using an acetylene torch to heat up a ball joint which caused the production of smoke. The autopsy determined that the man's cause of death was related to inhaling the fumes, resulting in cardiac dysrhythmia leading to hemorrhaging and swelling in the lungs and airways.
An employee was found dead lying on the ground in a parking lot with his truck cab door open.  There were no witnesses.
An employee was found dead of unknown causes in his apartment by law enforcement.
An employee was found deceased under the rear tire of an enclosed semi-truck trailer. No specific details on the cause of death were available.
An employee was found in his work truck after he had moved boxes of flooring from a house. He was found leaning against the window unresponsive and there was a smell of fumes in the cabin.

An employee was found drowned in the water at the bottom of an excavation site. The Medical Examiner's preliminary findings attribute the cause of death to asphyxia from drowning, but could not definitively link any specific factors to the incident. A toxicology report was ordered to further investigate the circumstances surrounding the employee's death.
An employee was found nonresponsive inside the cab of a front end loader. The cause of the death is currently unknown.
An employee was found unresponsive at his home. The employee died from atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
An employee was found unresponsive in a break room with the door locked from the inside.  No visible causes were apparent.
An employee was found unresponsive in the bottom of a testing vessel/containment box containing liquid nitrogen. The employee died.

An employee was found unresponsive next to his work vehicle and was transported to Memorial hospital in Yakima after receiving CPR. He was later airlifted to Harborview due to the severity of his injuries, where he passed away the following day. The incident was not reported by the employer.

An employee was found unresponsive on the warehouse floor while in the process of assembling an order. The employee was discovered by a co-worker with no signs of injury, resting on the end of a stair. The coroner concluded the death was due to natural causes after toxicology testing, confirming it was not work-related.
An employee was found unresponsive upstairs in the pump house. The employee was found slumped over on the dry concrete floor. No other details were given about the employee's death.
An employee was framing a house. He went to move a steel "I" beam and it tipped over the landing on his leg and broke one of his ankles. The employee was hospitalized and treated for a broken ankle.
An employee was framing a residential house. The employee was struck by lightning while installing decking on second story residential home. The employee was killed.
An employee was framing a two-story roof and fell to the ground. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to the head and he was killed.
An employee was framing a wall from a frame ladder. The employee slipped and fell 8 feet to the ground. The employee suffered fractured leg but was not hospitalized.

During a construction project, an employee was framing a wall horizontally before tipping it up. While working above the opening for the basement stairs, the employee stepped on a window cutout and fell to the cement floor below. The employee tragically suffered fatal blunt force trauma to the head/neck area as a result of the fall.

An employee was framing an exterior wall on the second floor deck when they accidentally walked backwards into a window opening that aligned with the stairwell opening. As a result, the employee fell 11 feet to the concrete floor below, suffering fatal head trauma.
An employee was gathering the meat that was to be cut and packed.  The employee was using a meat saw band and partially amputated his index finger.

An employee was getting a disable vehicle onto the bed of his tow truck. As the employee was getting a disabled vehicle onto the bed of the tow truck he was operating, he was struck by a hit and run vehicle traveling on the interstate. The employee was killed in the accident.
An employee was getting a new battery for his handheld drill and fell 13 feet through a fiberglass skylight to the concrete surface below.  The employee sustained a fractured right elbow.
An employee was getting a roll of shrink wrap off of a coworker's forklift when their toes were run over by the forklift, fracturing them.
An employee was getting food items from the walk-in refrigerator when he slipped on a puddle of water on the refrigerator floor.  The employee was hospitalized for a broken leg and hip.
An employee was getting out of his car, collapsed and died from a massive heart attack.

A worker ignored safety protocols and reached past an open guard to clean a plastic extrusion machine, resulting in his right hand getting caught in the in-running nip points of two Chill Rollers. The employee sustained severe injuries and was hospitalized for swelling and bruising. The incident occurred on Extrusion Line #13 Grain Chill Roller.

An employee preparing to start work climbed an extension ladder to the roof of a single-story home. The employee fell from the edge of the roof, approximately 9 feet 5 inches high, with a slope of 4:12, onto concrete, suffering fatal head trauma.

An employee was given instructions to unwind an electrical whipout to a light fixture from around a sprinkler pipe in the 9-ft 6-in ceiling. The power had not been turned off to the fixture, and the wires were live. The employee contacted the live wires carrying 277 volts and was electrocuted.
An employee was gluing cabinet doors in a pinch machine. The employees left index finger was amputated by rollers. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.
An employee was going to pick up debris when he was stung by bees that just flew in. The employee died from the bee stings.

An employee attempted to remove a bleeder valve from a skid when high pressure shot out, causing the employee to be blown back. The employee suffered injuries to his leg, a broken arm, and skull fractures on both sides of his face. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

An employee was going up to remove a blue protective lining. The swing stage scaffold collapsed when a wire rope suspending the scaffold broke. The employee fell to the ground and suffered from blunt trauma to the head. The employee was killed.
An employee was grinding a clamp off of a vent hose and fumes from hydrocarbons ignited. The employee sustained burns to between 5% and 10% of the body.
An employee was grinding a tree stump when he was struck by a 59 foot falling tree. The employee sustained head trauma and was killed.
An employee was grinding metal with a coping grinder. The employee's finger was amputated.
An employee was guiding a cable on to a spool.  The employee was pulled into the spool from wearing loose clothing. The employee was crushed and killed.
An employee was guiding a dump truck that was backing up into a barricaded construction zone.  The employee tripped, fell into the path of the dump truck, and was crushed and killed on-site.

An employee fell from a flatbed trailer while guiding a forklift operator to load guardrail posts, resulting in the guard posts falling on him and causing a fracture in his lower back and collapsed rib cage. He was taken to Corona Regional Medical Center and later transferred to Riverside Community Hospital for surgery and five days of hospitalization.

An employee was guiding a gasoline tamper from a Case brand 580 Super L loader backhoe bucket as it was lowered into an excavation.  The backhoe fell into the excavation as the backhoe bucket was lowered and fell on top of the employee; crushing the employee. crushing the employee.

The employee was guiding a generator being moved from a trailer to a concrete pad mount when two out of four synthetic web slings broke. The 5 ton generator was flipped over by the crane and landed on the employee, resulting in multiple fatal injuries.

An employee was guiding a generator to a concrete pad mount as the generator was being moved from a trailer. A crane was picking up a 5 ton generator when 2 of 4 synthetic web-slings broke, flipping the generator being lifted over onto the employee. The employee was killed from multiple injuries.

During the process of guiding a truck onto a car lift at an automobile repair shop, the employee was tragically pinned between the front of the truck and a piece of shop equipment when the truck's brakes failed. Despite efforts to stop the vehicle, the employee sustained fatal head trauma and passed away due to the severity of his injury.

An employee was guiding the forklift driver that was carrying a metal grate into the building.  The employee was struck by the 3 foot by 15 foot metal grate and fractured his lower left leg.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

During the movement of a steel work platform by forklift, an employee walking alongside it got entangled with nearby pallets causing the platform to fall and strike the employee. The employee sustained dislocated arms and multiple contusions, requiring hospitalization and treatment.

An employee was hand digging in a trench. A portion of the trench broke loose, pinning the employee against the trench wall. The employee was hospitalized and treated for a fractured right leg and knee.

During a construction project, an employee was standing on a platform in an elevator shaft, handing blocks to his coworkers. Suddenly, a piece of wood kicked out and struck him, causing him to fall 11 feet to the ground below. Unfortunately, the employee sustained a broken arm and had to be hospitalized as a result of the incident.

During a mail handling task, an employee's left ring finger got caught between the OTR container and a bar while working with the FACS Number 1 machine. Unfortunately, the accident resulted in the amputation of the employee's left ring finger. The employee was promptly hospitalized and received treatment for their injuries.

During a work task involving handling steel pipes with an overhead bridge crane, an employee's finger got caught between the pipes when the load shifted. As a result, the employee's small finger on his right hand was amputated. Fortunately, the employee did not require hospitalization following the incident.

An employee was harvesting nectarines while walking. He passed out.  His coworkers started CPR until EMS arrived and transported the employee to a local hospital. The employee died from a heart attack
An employee was having a discussion from a Genie lift and there was an explosion. The employee suffered burns and was killed.
An employee was helping a customer load a purchase into the trunk of a car, when the trunk fell and hit him.  The employee passed away at home the next day.

An employee was helping a forklift operator load granite slabs onto an A frame rack. The employee was attempting to unhook the support straps when the granite slabs fell over onto him. The employee was crushed and killed when 9 granite slabs that weigh approximately 8,400 lbs fell on top of him.

An employee was helping a parent carry a stroller upstairs.  The employee missed a step and fell due to the weight of the stroller.  The employee injured her right wrist, ankle and shoulder.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for her injuries.

During a metalworking task, an employee's left index finger was crushed and amputated when it was caught between a Piranha ironworker and a metal sheet. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for the injury.

During a cleanup operation following a wind storm, an employee was loading fallen tree branches onto a 1973 Ford Dump Truck. The dump bed of the truck became stuck in the up position while dumping debris, causing the employee to exit the vehicle to investigate. Tragically, the dump bed suddenly came down with force, crushing the employee between the bed and the truck. The employee suffered fatal injuries to the head and chest as a result.

An employee was helping load a 41 foot 3,000 pound potato conveyor/table onto a semi trailer. The employee was securing equipment to the trailer when it fell crushing the employee's abdomen. The worker was killed from abdominal crushing injury.

An employee was helping place a beam which was part of a Ferris wheel to the ground with the help of a forklift. The forklift boom which was extended touching a 13,200 volts overhead power line at the height of 25 feet 6 inches, electrocuting the employee.

While documenting the construction of a small house trailer for a television show, an employee fell backward through the doorway and down a job-made stairway inside a warehouse. The employee suffered serious injuries including a subdural hematoma, fractures of the femur, right wrist, and right shoulder joint. Despite compliant railings on the stairs and no environmental factors at play, the employee required airlifting to a hospital for treatment.
An employee was helping set roof trusses packs onto the roof structure.The employee fell while performing signaling operation for crane operation  and was injured.

An employee was helping to build a turf roller and the employee had his hand on the paper while the shaft was spinning. The employee was wearing gloves and got his hand caught between the shaft and the sand paper. The employee's left thumb was amputated as a result.

An employee was helping to carry 0.5-inch plywood approximately 100 feet to cover pedestrian sidewalks recently poured. The employee started feeling ill and sat down to rest. The employee suffered an apparent heart attack and died.

An employee was helping to remove 16 foot 2 by 4 from a shelf in the yard with a forklift. While straddling the forks of a forklift loaded with wood 2 by 4. The employee's left pinky finger was amputated. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.
An employee was hiking with Fireline in full PPE & tools. The employee began experiencing fatigue and became hot. The employee collapsed from heat exhaustion.
An employee was hit by a truck, run over, and killed.

While hitching up a tandem trailer rig, an employee failed to engage the parking brake in the truck and the working surface had a slight incline. As the employee hitched the second trailer, both trailers rolled backwards approximately 8 feet. The trailers jackknifed into each other, resulting in the employee being crushed and killed.
An employee was hitting the rafter when the roof collapsed. The employee was struck and killed by roof structure.
The employee was using a mini excavator to hoist a tree trunk over a guardrail when he accidentally pressed the lever with his leg, causing the excavator arm to crush him against the cab.
An employee was hoisting tools and material down from the roof. The employee was not wearing PPE and fell approximately 40 feet. The employee was killed from blunt force trauma to the body and head.
An employee was holding a high voltage wire that was cut. The employee touched ground and was electrocuted. The employee received flash burn to head and upper torso and was killed.

An employee was holding a hose that was being replaced by a coworker.  The employee was sprayed with chlorine liquid as a coworker unscrewed a transfer hose.  The employee suffered chemical burns from the chlorine liquid.
An employee was holding a line/tether and walking alongside a vehicle transporting a floating walkway. The employee was struck by the vehicle and was killed from crushing injuries.

During a maintenance task, an employee's glove became caught in a strip of sandpaper wrapped around a shaft with a keyway, leading to the amputation of his right ring finger. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

An employee was holding a tag line for the 12,690 pound wire reel that was being lifted by a crane. During lifting, wire reel fell from the spreader bar and struck the employee below his waist. He sustained a compound fracture to his left lower leg, a crushed right ankle, and multiple lacerations.

The employee was using an air nozzle to clean a machine while it was in operation. In a moment of carelessness, he opened the machine and his thumb got caught between the die and the ram, resulting in a crushing injury. Unfortunately, the severity of the injury necessitated the amputation of his thumb.
An employee was holding plastic when he was struck by skid-steer. The employee sustained  a broken foot and was not hospitalized.
An employee was holding some steel roof sheets. He had just finish passing a roof sheet to a coworker and the roof collapsed. He fell through the opening. The employee was killed instantly.

An employee holding a "SLOW" sign for construction traffic was struck and killed by a speeding vehicle being pursued by police. The driver entered the work zone at a high speed, lost control, and hit the employee. Tragically, the employee did not survive the impact.

The employee was hooking a disabled vehicle to the tow truck when a driver veered off the highway and struck both the car and the tow truck. The impact caused the car on the tow truck to pin the employee between the car and the headboard, resulting in the employee's death at the scene.
An employee was hooking a water pump to a sling. The crane boom or load line contacted an overhead power line. The employee was electrocuted.
An employee was hooking an overhead lanyard to a harness, when the harness slipped off the airplane wing. The employee fell and sustained injuries to his knees, hip and back.

An employee was hooking chains to mud pump from a gin pole truck that was backing into position. The gin pole truck struck and caught the employee in between the truck and mud pump.  The employees sternum was fractured, killing the employee.

An employee was hooking up a low-boy trailer to a flat-bed tow truck. The employee was caught and crushed between the front medal edge of trailer and flat-bed roller. The employee sustained blunt force trauma injuries and died.

An employee was hooking up a trailer.  A dump truck backed into him and the employee was crushed against another truck. The employee sustained multiple crushing injuries resulting in his death. his death.
The employee was attempting to remove turkey debris from a conveyer belt while it was running. His hand got caught in the belt, causing a large laceration to his left hand and three broken fingers.

During routine cleaning of a conveyor belt system, an employee lost their balance and fell towards the conveyor belt. Unfortunately, their gloved hand got caught in the belt, resulting in multiple fractures to their right arm. The employee was promptly taken to the hospital for treatment and recovery.

During a routine cleaning of a conveyor belt, an employee slipped and fell forward, getting his hand and arm caught in the moving belt. The employee sustained multiple fractures in his right arm and had to be hospitalized for treatment.

The employee was fatally injured when a forklift kicked into gear while they were positioning a toolbox on a pickup truck. The employee was impaled by the forklift and sustained a massive crush injury to the chest area. The accident occurred as the employee was trying to push the toolbox off the forks onto the truck.

An employee was killed when a stack of barrel racks being pulled by an industrial fork truck inside a sea container fell on top of him. The employee was forced to jump from his elevated position inside the container as the stack was pulled beyond the opening edge, causing the racks to collapse on him. The employee suffered fatal blunt force injuries as a result of the incident.

An employee was in a locked jail cell control room, opening and closing cell doors as needed.  The employee was found slumped over the console control panel by a fellow officer.  The cause of death is pending further investigation.
An employee was in a palm tree trimming fronds at a height of approximate 38 feet. The employee was trapped beneath the fronds of the tree and died.

An employee was in a scissor lift bucket 25 to 30 feet above the ground. A crane hit the extended scissor lift and the lift tipped over. The employee stayed inside the scissor lift basket as it fell. The basket hit a workstation desk and the employee was ejected from basket.

An employee was in a tree attempting to cut down three ash trees when the tree broke.  The employee fell approximately 50 feet and landed on a retaining wall. The employee was crushed when the tree fell on top of him.
An employee was in a tree cutting branches. The employee fell off the tree to the ground and fractured his head. The employee died of his injuries 13 days later.

An employee was in a trench cleaning up his tools and equipment.The trench collapsed trapping him against the opposite side, resulting in death due to crushing injury to the chest area. resulting in death due to crushing injury to the chest area.area.

An employee was in a trench installing a 48 inch drain tile.  A damaged section of drain tile was being removed, when the wall of the excavation collapsed on the employee. The employee was crushed and killed when the excavation collapsed.
An employee was in a trench that was approximately 12 feet deep.One side of the trench collapsed onto the employee. Employee was killed due to trench collapse. was killed due to trench collapse.

An employee was in a trench using a Stihl TS 700 Cut-off saw to cut a pipe for a sewer line. The saw kicked back and the employee lost control of the saw. The employee was struck in the neck by the blade of the saw. The employee's jugular vein was lacerated and he was killed. killed.
An employee was in a truck bed off loading bread. The employee fell from the back of the truck and sustained a broken leg.

During an excavation project next to a home's basement wall, a portion of the foundation wall collapsed on an employee laying out drain tile. The employee was struck, pinned, and despite managing to free himself, collapsed shortly after sustaining multiple fractures, puncture lacerations, and hemorrhaging. Tragically, the employee did not survive the incident.

The employee was fatally run over by a pickup truck while working in front of a bucket truck handling tree clippings. The incident occurred on a two-lane highway where the south lane was not closed, resulting in the accident.
An employee was in his work truck, parked, unconscious with the air conditioner left on. The employee had suffered a heart attack and was dead.

An employee was in the attic working in an HVAC unit.  The employee lost his balance and fell in between two trusts through the attic floor to the lower level. The employee sustained a fractured back.

The employee fell down a flight of stairs in an apartment building while inspecting maintenance work in the basement. The fall resulted in traumatic cranial bleeding, facial fractures, and a scapular fracture. Despite being taken to Mercy Hospital, the employee passed away due to blunt force trauma to the head.

An employee was in the company's parking lot preparing to leave work. The employee collapsed in the parking lot and fractured his skull while at his vehicle.The employee was killed by head trauma. head trauma.

An employee applying flashing to a hotel under construction was tragically killed when a 75 lb. steel roof roller fell from the roof and struck him in the head. The roller was being used by roofing company employees to smooth roof membrane on the parapet, but the handle became loose and detached due to improper insertion and locking. The rust and friction holding the handle extension in place gave way under pressure, causing the fatal accident.
During the process of coupling two railroad tank cars, an employee was caught between the moving couplings and crushed by the force of the moving tank car, resulting in his death on impact.

An employee was in the process of dismantling a controlled work zone. The employee was struck by a motor vehicle that entered the work zone driven by an impaired driver. The employee was killed. Three other employees were also injured. Two of the three injured employees were hospitalized.

The employee was moving a wheelbarrow filled with water for cement mixing when he was hit by a motor vehicle intruding into the lane closure area. Sadly, he suffered fatal blunt force injuries from the impact.

The employee fell approximately 20 feet to a concrete surface below while installing roof trusses at a residential construction site. He suffered serious injuries including fractures to the skull and spine, and ultimately passed away on January 13, 2017 as a result of the fall.

During the process of loading a refrigerated semi-trailer, an employee was inside when it was prematurely pulled away from the loading bay. The employee fell to the ground along with an electric pallet jack. Tragically, the pallet jack crushed the employee's head and upper torso, resulting in a fatal injury.

During the process of positioning a non-bariatric patient on an Angel Slider, an employee unknowingly pulled the slider while one side was crumpled up. This resulted in the employee jerking her shoulder and sustaining injuries including a partially torn right bicep and tendon, herniated L5 and L4 discs, and sciatic pain in both legs.

During the demolition of the 9th floor for a new stairwell, an employee was fatally injured when a 12 foot long 2x6 floor joist fell from the 13th floor and struck him in the head. The employee suffered severe head trauma including skull fractures, brain damage, broken vertebrae in his neck, and multiple contusions, resulting in his death.

The employee was securing his extension ladder to a structure when it slipped from the roof, causing him to fall 12 feet onto the asphalt driveway. He suffered a shattered heel and compound leg fracture, leading to a hospitalization for treatment. Emergency services were called to the site to transport him to a local hospital.
An employee was in the second stop of his work night shift when he was found laying face up behind the truck. It appeared the employee was struck, run over, and killed by a truck.

An employee fell from a ladder while ascending to his work area, landing on the concrete floor below and suffering head trauma. He was hospitalized as a result of the fall. The incident occurred as he missed a ladder rung while climbing from the first floor to the second floor.

An employee was inflating a truck tire with low air pressure. The tire ruptured, or, possibly, it came off the rim. The employee was struck in the head, either by the tire or by a wheel part. He was killed.

The employee was inflating tires in cages to the designated pressure when a tire's side wall blew out, releasing compressed air with great force. The employee, who was rolling the tire to the staging area, was struck in the chest by the force of the air. Tragically, the employee was killed from multiple blunt force trauma.

An employee was inserting a bracket into a press brake for forming.  The employee attempted to adjust the position of the bracket with his hand and accidentally activated the press with the foot pedal.  The die came down on his ring and index fingers at the fingernail and severed both.

During a drum pumping operation, an employee accidentally contacted the rotating impeller of the pump with his right pinkie finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The incident occurred when the employee's hand slid down the drum pump after inserting it into the bung hole of a drum.

While operating a lathe, an employee forgot to disengage the spindle from its motor and the power switch was still on. When the employee accidentally dropped the wrench used for tightening the chuck, it hit the start lever for the spindle, causing it to turn and throw a heavy metal cylinder into the employee's abdomen, resulting in contusion and strain injuries. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for the injuries.
An employee was inserting a match fuze into a fireworks charge. The fireworks exploded and both of the employee's hands were amputated.

An employee was arranging empty pallets inside a company trailer using a manual pallet jack when two heavy wood pallets fell off and struck the employee's forehead, resulting in their death. The pallets, each weighing approximately 61.7 lbs, had been brought by a forklift operator and placed at the trailer entrance.

During the unloading of vehicle lifts from a trailer/container, an employee was pinned between the trailer wall and a package of three vehicle lifts weighing approximately 6000 lbs. The package shifted and fell onto the employee when the weld on the bottom side broke. Coworkers responded quickly, pushing the package off the employee and starting CPR before he was transported to the hospital. Unfortunately, the employee passed away three days later on October 15, 2016.

An employee was inside an existing garage standing on an elevated unguarded storage area looking for materials.  The employee stepped onto a 3/8 inch thick board that was hanging over the edge of the platform and fell approximately 8 feet to the cement floor, killing the employee
An employee was inside of a piece of equipment, cleaning it, when the machine activated and the employee was killed.

An employee was involved in a workplace incident where he became pinned and crushed against a gate after attempting to stop a company van from rolling. The employee hit his head and lost consciousness during the struggle, potentially striking a fountain as well. It is suspected that the van was left running and began rolling on its own.

An employee was inspecting a belt in a truck engine while the engine was turned on.  The employee caught four fingers on the left hand and amputated them. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

An employee inspecting a loose belt on a rock crusher was tragically killed when they were caught underneath a wheel loader at a construction site. The site supervisor and the employee did not hear the back-up alarm of the wheel loader until it was within 5 feet of them. Despite attempting to run away, the employee was unable to escape in time.

An employee was inspecting a scroll (auger) used to move beet pulp. The employee fell into a pulp dryer and was later found buried under a substantial pile of dried pulp. The employee was asphyxiated.
An employee was inspecting a water heater located in an attic. Descending on a metal ladder from the attic, the ladder gave way causing the employee to fall 8 ft., landing on his back.
An employee was inspecting the plumbing under a residential home and was electrocuted from a plug-in lamp that was used.

An employee was installing 2-ft by 6-ft lumber on the cement wall while working from elevated work platform. The employee fell from tie-beam 19.6 feet to the ground striking the concrete slab. The employee suffered from serious head trauma and was killed.

An employee was installing a barge rafter.	The right side of single-pole scaffold pulled away from the house and collapsed causing the employee to fall approximately 10 feet to the ground.  The employee suffered from fractured leg and was hospitalized.

An employee installing a computer system may have been exposed to Legionella and died from Legionnaires' Disease Pneumonia. Two other employees who worked in the same area of the facility were also reviewed but did not show signs of illness. The employee's illness was determined to be not work-related.

The employee was installing a conveyor motor cover without locking out the conveyor, resulting in their right hand being caught and crushed by a chain and sprocket. Four fingers on the right hand were crushed, leading to the amputation of the first digit of the index finger at the hospital. The employee was hospitalized as a result of the incident.

An employee was installing a die cutting blade with a machine operator, who left the employee to complete the task. Upon the operator's return, they were unaware of the employee reaching into the machine's opening. When the operator turned on the machine, the employee was crushed and killed by the die cutting blade.

Tragically, an employee was killed when he was crushed by a die cutting machine after reaching into the opening of the machine without the machine operator's knowledge. The operator had left the employee momentarily after installing the blade, and upon returning, accidentally turned on the machine. This devastating incident serves as a reminder of the importance of always ensuring proper communication and safety procedures are followed when working with heavy machinery.
An employee was installing a hardiebaker board when he fell from the mobile scaffold to the ground.  The employee was killed onsite.
