An employee was on top of a walk-in cooler and fell through the ceiling. The employee sustained head trauma and was killed in the fall.

During a demolition operation, an employee was tragically killed when precast concrete planks collapsed on him as he was standing inside the building. The employee's chest was crushed by the falling concrete, resulting in his death. The incident occurred while the employee was working alongside three coworkers performing roof tear off operations.

An employee was attempting to remove a jam from a fiber line 31 double picker machine when his right hand got caught in the spinning drum, despite the equipment being locked out. The employee's middle and ring fingers were amputated just below the nail on his right hand as a result of the incident.

An employee was opening a ground mounted 7.2 kv electrical transformer box.The employee slipped and contacted live parts with his hand. The employee was shocked and killed by the live electrical parts.

An employee was opening a high pressure (130 psi) filter containing Phenol at 160 degrees Fahrenheit. The employee opened filter 3259S when he was supposed to open filter 3259 which had been locked out.  The employee received chemical and thermal  burns to the body.

While opening a perimeter gate to allow a contract landscape company onto the premises, an employee's foot became trapped between the gate and the pavement, resulting in a laceration on his right ankle. The gate, made of black metal, was controlled manually through pulling or pushing motions, and became jammed halfway through the process, causing the employee to lose his balance and injure himself. He was hospitalized and received treatment for his injury.
An employee was opening a truck door when the truck's articulated arm made contact with a 13.5 kv distribution line. The employee was killed by electrocution.

While ventilating a high pressure natural gas pipeline, an employee was struck by a spinning vent stack that was knocked loose by the force of the gas. The employee suffered multiple fractures to his arm, scapula, and ribs, as well as a punctured lung, concussion, and damage to his liver and kidneys. He was hospitalized for treatment of his injuries.

While opening the main waterline valve of an irrigation line made of PVC, an employee was struck by the valve and hydrant when the pipe broke under the pressure of the water, causing multiple fractures to his face and skull. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

An employee was operating 90-Ton Pacific Trim Press.  The employee caught the right thumb tip between the point of operation and partially amputated it from his finger. The employee was not hospitalized.

An employee operating a Komatsu forklift on a paved road made a sharp turn on a slope, causing the forklift to tip over. The employee was crushed between the forklift's ROPS and the pavement, resulting in a fatal accident.

During the operation of a 1,500 ton hydraulic press, a piece of metal fragment was ejected and hit an employee in the leg, causing a cut. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injury. The investigation revealed that the stop block of the press had failed during operation, leading to the accident.

The employee was operating a 4-wheel drive ATV at a ranch when he was found face down on the dirt roadway with the ATV on top of him. It is believed that he fell or tipped over from the ATV, resulting in traumatic asphyxia, as per the coroner's initial report. The incident occurred while the employee was returning from depositing spent vegetables at the pig enclosure.

An employee was operating a 66 ton hydraulic brake press to bend side panels. While shaping the metal part, the employee's right hand came into contact with the dies of the press. Two fingers were crushed, resulting in their amputation. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injury.

An employee was operating a 700 John Deer Bulldozer for grading the land.  The employee was ejected from the Bulldozer when he hit a stump while grading the land. The employee was killed in a fall after being ejected from the Bulldozer.

An employee operating a 72-inch zero turn lawn mower on a steep incline overturned, resulting in the employee falling to the ground. The mower struck him, causing fractures to his left leg and ribs, as well as damage to his spleen. Despite having rollover-protection, the employee was not wearing a seat belt at the time of the incident. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

An employee operating a battery powered stand-up reach truck collided with a stationary storage rack, crushing his left ankle and foot. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

During operation of a Bliss power press, an employee's right index finger was crushed when the machine malfunctioned and repeated the press cycle. The employee had to undergo hospitalization and treatment, including the amputation of her right index finger up to the first knuckle. An investigation discovered that a broken spring was the cause of the malfunction, preventing the mechanical linkage from engaging properly and causing the power press ram to continue uncontrollably.

Tragically, an employee operating a Bomag construction roller on a range road veered off course while going around a turn, causing the equipment to overturn and trap the employee underneath. The employee suffered a fractured hip and injuries to internal organs, ultimately resulting in their death.

An employee was operating a BOMAG model BW 124 PDH-3 soil compactor on a decline.  The employee was ejected from the equipment and crushed when it tipped over on top of him.  The employee was killed from his injuries.

An employee was operating a bone-in saw to cut meat. During cutting, his left hand slipped and his left index finger contacted the saw blade, resulting in its amputation. The employee was taken to a local medical facility for treatment and was released the same day.

While using a Bridgeport Series 2 milling machine to ream out holes in stainless steel pieces, an employee's left arm was pulled into the unguarded rotating chuck and reaming tool, resulting in a broken forearm. The incident occurred as the employee lowered the reaming tool into a hole on the mill table. The employee was hospitalized and received necessary medical treatment.

An employee operating a bulldozer was crushed and killed after falling out of the operator's cabin while the bulldozer was moving sharply downhill. The employee suffered blunt force trauma to the hips and legs. It is suspected that the employee was killed by heavy equipment nearby due to not wearing a seatbelt.

An employee was operating a bulldozer to level a ground surface. The employee fell off bulldozer, and was struck by the bulldozer. The bulldozer kept on going and the employee died of internal injuries.

An employee was operating a bus duringhis regularly scheduled shift. The bus operator had completed the firsthalf of his shift and was on break resting in his personal vehicle whenhe sustained a fatal heart attack.

During the operation to move loose coke debris with a Caterpillar D6T dozer, an employee backed the dozer into a water-filled area near drainage lines. The employee tragically drowned in the 11 foot deep space where the water had accumulated and did not drain out.

The employee operating a Caterpillar telehandler forklift on a steep dirt slope ramp with a plate compactor attached lost control, went into a trench, and was ejected from the cab, resulting in fatal injuries from being pinned between the forklift and a dirt wall.

An employee was operating a cheese slicer. As she cut the end of a cheese block that was very thin, the blade came into contact with her right thumb. The employee sustained a laceration to her right thumb.

An employee was operating a CNC Plate Drill.  The employee went to shut the hydraulic pump off at the machine.  The employee was found unresponsive lying on his back. The Coroner's Report indicated a heart related event.

An employee was operating a come along to help guide a tree being felled. The tree being felled struck another tree that was uprooted and struck the employee. He was hospitalized for treatment of his injuries that included fractures to his shoulder and ribs, as well as a punctured lung.

During operation of a commercial air compressor, an employee was tragically killed when the tank exploded due to over pressurization. Despite the employee's attempts to disconnect the motor, the tank failed, causing severe blunt force trauma. The incident highlights the importance of proper training and safety procedures when working with heavy machinery.

An employee operating a concrete delivery truck was setting up to deliver concrete into a pump truck when the incident occurred. An investigation found that the back controls of the mixer were activated just before the truck rolled back, pinning the employee between the two trucks. Tragically, the employee was crushed and killed in the accident.

The employee operating the cold header machine reached between the guide and payoff to check wire tension when his right index finger became caught in the machine, resulting in a partial amputation at the first digit.

An employee was operating a crane as it attempted to lift a 120 pound girder. As the load was swung beyond the mast cap, the crane tipped over and pinned the employee underneath as he attempted to exit the cab.  The employee was killed.

An employee was operating a crane to lift a beam. The beam broke loose and fell 4 stories and crushed the operator's compartment. The employee was crushed and killed from the steel beam. artment. The employee was crushed and killed from the steel beam.

An employee operating a crop scrap shear experienced a jam on the chute. After trying to dislodge it, the employee was found unresponsive in a fetal position on the floor. Despite being rushed to the hospital, the employee was pronounced dead. The cause of death was determined to be a congenital heart defect affecting the aortic and pulmonary arteries.

While using a Crown electric standup-/rider pallet truck to move a pallet in Warehouse Aisle 4/5, an employee accidentally backed up too far and got pinned between the guard of the pallet truck and the steel shelf. The employee suffered two broken ribs and a lacerated liver and had to be hospitalized as a result of the incident.

An employee was operating a custom-made vise (Mechanical Racking Machine) when the two pieces of metal that comprise the vise came together on her right middle and ring fingers, crushing them. The employee amputated the fingertip from both fingers.

During a production run, an employee's finger tip was amputated while repositioning a stuck steel sheet in a cut-to-length press. The machine was accidentally activated while the employee was adjusting the material, causing his finger to get caught between the material and the fixture.

During a production run, an employee operating a cut-to-length press got his finger amputated when the material got stuck in the machine. The employee repositioned the material with his hand unknowingly activating the machine to feed it, causing his finger to get caught between the material and fixture.
An employee was operating a dewalt 12" sliding compound miter saw.The employee's glove got caught in the blade pulling it in to the saw, causing a laceration.

An employee was operating a dough processing and cutting machine. The employee reached under a guard to clear out an extraneous piece of stuck dough with a finger. The left middle fingertip was amputated by a cutting blade at the point of operation of the machine.

An employee driving a farm tractor with a trailer veered off a dirt access road along a canal, causing the tractor to fall into the 13-foot deep canal. The tractor rolled over, trapping the employee inside the cab, leading to their tragic drowning.

During operation of forging hammer #85, a piece of material became lodged in the machine's top die. In an attempt to dislodge it, a piece of metal was discharged from the machine, striking an employee in the facial area. Tragically, the employee was killed as a result of the impact.
An employee was operating a fork lift and drove it off of the loading dock.  The employee was crushed when the fork lift turned over on them.

An employee operating a forklift left the forks raised to assist in moving a 1,000 lbs I Beam. While he was assisting at the end of the I Beam, it shifted and pinned his left leg against the front forks of the forklift. The employee suffered a deep laceration to his left leg and had to be hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift (Raymond EAS R40TT-M). The employee was backing up and exited the machine before it had come to a complete stop crushing the ankle between the forklift and the raised dock plate. The employee sustained a broken ankle.
An employee was operating a forklift and lost control of it.  The fork lift tipped over onto its side and the employee was killed from blunt force neck trauma.

An employee was operating a forklift to pull stock and misjudged a turn and attempted to stop the forklift with their foot. The employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and the rack bumper. The employee's left foot and ankle was crushed.

During operation of a full can de-palletizer, the equipment jammed on a broken pallet, which was cleared by the employee. However, when the machine restarted, the employee's right ring finger was caught between the metal chain and sprocket, resulting in the amputation of her finger just below the nail bed.

An employee was operating a Hendrick Panel Saw machine. As he removed plastic material that had become stuck in the saw, the glove on his left hand became caught in the running blade of the machine. The employee's left middle finger sustained a partial amputation.

An employee operating a high lift forklift lost control of the vehicle and was pinned between the forklift and a metal racking system. He suffered severe chest injuries, including a punctured lung, and was hospitalized for treatment.

During operation of a Hobart Power Drive Unit with a vegetable slicer attachment, an employee reached into the feed hopper to adjust potatoes while the machine was running. This led to the employee unintentionally touching the spinning slicer blade, resulting in the loss of the tip of her left index finger.

During the integration of a draft link to a tractor, an employee operating a hoist had their fingers caught in a pinch point while trying to reorient a link ball without securing the suspended load. As a result, the employee's left ring finger was amputated and their left middle finger was lacerated. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery to reattach the left ring finger.

An employee was operating a horizontal milling machine. The employee stopped the operation to inspect the part. He opened the door and reached inside the machine. The spindle was spinning and the employee's sleeve got caught in the spindle which severely lacerated the his right arm.
An employee was operating a Hydraulic piling rig. The swivel hook auxiliary winch broke off and struck the employee from above. The employee was killed.

An employee was operating a Hyster Fork Lift to manipulate a forging die under a press hammer.  The employee was struck in the forehead by a knockout tool that was ejected when the press hammer lowered. The employee was killed by his injuries.

While operating a Hyster stand-up narrow aisle reach truck in a warehouse, an employee turned left to avoid a pallet jack and hit a pallet of products, getting trapped between the first shelf of the rack and the truck as it spun and collided with the storage rack. Despite safety measures, the employee was fatally crushed in the accident.
An employee was operating a jackhammer chipping at the fireplace hearth.  The employee was crushed and killed when the 17 feet high facade fell onto the employee.
An employee was operating a Jet Drill Press. The employee reached across the drill and caught their right middle finger on the drill bit.  The employee amputated their middle finger.
An employee was operating a JLG aerial lift in order to unload it. The employee was pinned in between the railing platform (of the aerial lift) and an overhead ledge (beam).  The employee was killed.

An employee was operating a John Deere 450J open cab bulldozer. The employee was  thrown out of the cab while dropping off into a open area. The right track of the bulldozer ran over the employee resulting in the employee's death.

The employee was operating a John Deere 540D log skidder on a rural 1700 acre tract of land with another employee. They were using a Hydro-Ax machine to fell trees and multiple log skidders to move the logs. The employee stopped the skidder, left it running without setting the safety brake, and was crushed when the machine moved and ran over them.

The employee was operating a John Deere Gator utility vehicle on a jobsite, attempting to retrieve keys from another worker when he collided with a metal gate. The impact resulted in the employee being impaled by the gate, leading to severe injuries including broken ribs, collapsed lung, and multiple internal lacerations. Despite medical intervention, the employee tragically succumbed to his injuries.
An employee was operating a Kabota RTV side-by-side when it rolled over and crushed him. The employee was killed.

An employee operating a Kitamura CNC machine without coolant had his baseball cap come loose while handling repair parts. Attempting to secure the hat, he dropped the parts into the still-operating machine. Without stopping the equipment, he reached in to retrieve the parts and was pulled into the moving parts, resulting in injuries to his ribs and shoulder. He was hospitalized for treatment.

During operation of the KS cake dryer, a jam occurred and the employee opened the panel door while the machine was still running. Using a pair of pliers to clear the jam, the employee's left index finger was caught between the pliers and the machine blades, resulting in the tip being amputated.
An employee was operating a lathe. A metal shaving string struck the employee on the upper legs, causing lacerations to both legs. The employee was hospitalized for his injuries.
An employee was operating a lawn mower.  The employee drove the mower down the embankment.  The mower overturned and caught fire, causing severe burns and resulting in the his death.
An employee was operating a lawn-mower when an automobile jumped the curb and struck the employee. The employee sustained multiple fractures in the accident and was killed.
An employee was operating a lift and was pinned between the rail and the lift as he exited the lift. The employee sustained a fractured left toe.

An employee operating a lift truck fell while attempting to pick merchandise from an elevated rack. Despite being trained and certified in safe operation, the employee did not wear fall protection at the time of the accident. The employee fell a distance of 15 feet and 3 inches, resulting in fatal injuries due to a pre-existing heart condition.

During the operation of a lift, an employee's left foot got pinned between the lift and a metal bumper rail on the floor after parking it at a charging station. This led to the employee fracturing a toe on his left foot, requiring hospitalization and treatment.

An employee was operating a locomotive and coupling port cars. The employee was caught-in-between the couplers (knuckles) of the cars and sustained laceration, puncture, and fracture to the chest, neck, and shoulder areas, resulting in death.

During log skidding operations, an employee operating a skidder on a makeshift log bridge slipped into a pond and was trapped underwater for around 20 minutes. The employee went into cardiac arrest while stuck in the cab before being rescued by emergency services, revived, and taken to a hospital. Despite efforts, the employee later succumbed to the incident.

The employee was operating a Peddinghaus machine when they became trapped between a material handling conveyor and a steel I-beam, resulting in extensive blunt force trauma to the lower back and ultimately causing their death.

An employee operating a pecan cracking machine got a stick jammed in the mechanism. Instead of unplugging the machine, the employee reached into it, resulting in two fingers getting caught and fractured by the crushing wheels. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.
An employee was operating a machine. His foot got caught and his toe was amputated by the machine. The employee was not hospitalized.

While operating a Marshall Town Punch Press, an employee's hand got caught in the machine when trying to remove a stuck item, resulting in the amputation of their index and middle fingers. The employee was rushed to Loma Linda University Medical Center for treatment and further medical care.

The employee was operating a meat saw when they felt a bone get caught in the blade. Bone material then kicked up into their face, causing them to react by pulling the meat through at an angle and exposing their right index finger to the blade. As a result, the employee's right index fingertip was amputated by the saw blade.

An employee was operating a mechanical excavator, when its bucket struck a gasoline pipeline.  An explosion occurred, resulting in a forest fire.  The employeesuffered burns, respiratory damage, abrasions and other trauma that led to his death. ns and other trauma that led to his death.

An employee was operating a mechanical power press. As he was sending parts through the press, which was set to run at single-stroke, the machine switched to continuous mode. The employee was unaware of the frequency change, and amputated two fingers on his right hand while removing a part.
An employee was operating a mechanical power press. The press was actuated while the employee's right hand was in the point of operation. The employee's right ring and middle fingers were amputated.

During the operation of a milling machine, an employee's left thumb was amputated when his glove became caught in the spindle of the machine. The employee was hospitalized and received medical treatment for his injury.

The employee operating a mini excavator rolled off a ledge from a height of 20 to 30 feet, resulting in him being ejected from the vehicle. He suffered severe head injuries and evisceration of abdominal contents, ultimately leading to his death at the scene. The employee was working alone at the time of the incident and was found outside the excavator after the accident.

An employee was operating a motor vehicle on a county park road.  The employee was found slumped over the steering wheel of the park truck that had come to rest against a tree.  The transmission was in gear and the rear tires were spinning.  The employee suffered a heart attack and died.

While unloading metal scrap onto a truck with a New Holland "skid steer" and forklift attachment, an employee left the operator's cab with the forks fully raised. The employee tried to adjust the material while the skid steer was still in gear, leading to a tragic accident where the employee was pinned between the operator's cab and the truck. Despite efforts to free the employee and being conscious initially, they sadly passed away in the ambulance shortly after the incident.

The incident involved an employee operating a New Holland tractor with a grass cutting attachment near walnut trees. While driving on a dirt road next to a drainage ditch, the tractor went over the edge and rolled into the ditch, crushing the employee underneath and resulting in their death.

An employee was operating a pallet jack (powered industrial truck). As the vehicle was still in motion, the employee stepped off its platform, pinning her ankle against an angle iron and the pallet jack platform. The employee sustained a compound fracture to her right ankle.

An employee was operating a plodder machine with a rotating auger that was used to recycle bars of soap. During operation, the employee placed his hand under the machine's guard to remove a plastic dust cover. His hand contacted the rotating auger, amputating the tip of his right middle finger.
An employee was operating a POLARIS 400 cart. The employee was ejected from the cart when it was struck by a forklift. The employee suffered several fractures and a pinched nerve.

An employee was operating a portable table saw to cut a 4 inch by 4 inch post. The saw did not have a guard affixed. As the employee was cutting the post, one of his hands contacted the blade and amputated the tip of his pinky finger. He was hospitalized and received treatment of his injury.

An employee was operating a press brake bending some metal.  The employee had his hand in the press and hit the pedal, actuating the machine.  The press came down and crushed four fingers.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

During an operation of a press, an employee failed to remove the safety block from the machine before activation. The pressure from the press launched the safety block, which struck the employee resulting in fatal injuries including a lacerated neck and bruised chest. Tragically, the employee was killed in the incident.
An employee was operating a press. As he used his hand to remove material from the press, his left middle finger became caught by the die and his finger was amputated.

An employee was operating a printing press. The employee crawled under some stairs to access a feed roller to scrape off some scarp adhesive from the rollers.  The employee reached in while the press was still running and had their right arm pulled in to their shoulder, crushing it.
An employee was operating a punch press machine. During operation, his left thumb was crushed by the moving parts.

An employee was operating a radial arm saw.  The employee pulled the saw across his hand when operating it.  The employee amputated his index finger from his left hand and received multiple lacerations to his hand. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

The employee, who had been working as a temporary worker for less than two weeks, was operating a certified Raymond electric driving double pallet jack in Aisle 560 when he lost control and hit a restroom kiosk. He sustained a compound fracture of his right leg after hitting a guardrail rated for 10,000 pounds while traveling at 4 miles per hour. The employee was taken to the hospital by ambulance and admitted for more than 24 hours. Post-incident inspection revealed the pallet jack was

An untrained and unauthorized employee operated a Raymond Man Lift in the warehouse, making erratic movements before raising the lift and falling off, landing face down on the concrete floor. The employee sustained fractures to their face and a concussion, requiring hospitalization and treatment for their injuries.
An employee was operating a Raymond Stand Up Reach PIT. The employee was crushed between PIT and warehouse rack.

The employee, operating a ride-on zero-turn lawnmower, tragically rolled over into a ditch and was pinned underneath for 4.5 hours before being discovered. Medical personnel determined that the cause of death was asphyxiation and/or drowning. The model and serial number of the lawnmower involved was 992278 and 051129, respectively.

During a demonstration of a roll bender machine, an employee's glove became caught in the feed area of the machine. Despite pulling back his hand, the employee's left index finger was crushed, resulting in the tip being amputated. The incident occurred on a model number 3418G roll bender with serial number 2511181.

During troubleshooting of a roll former machine, an employee's right hand was pulled into the rollers as he got too close while observing them. He sustained crushing injuries, including bruising, internal bleeding, and swelling, and had to be hospitalized for treatment. The incident investigation revealed that the machine area was not properly guarded due to malfunctioning interlocked gates.

While operating a SAKAI SV540T Soil Roller on a berm next to a 23-foot embankment, an employee accidentally drove the back wheel of the roller over the edge. The berm, which was created using dumped dirt and leveled with a bull dozer, was meant to prevent equipment from going over the embankment. Despite emergency services being called, the employee was pronounced dead at the scene.
An employee was operating a scissor lift and  backed the scissor lift off the edge of the 14th floor. The employee was killed from blunt force trauma to the entire body.

During operation, an employee operating a shear machine removed the guard and accidentally crushed several fingers when coming into contact with the hold downs. The specific fingers and hand were not initially identified in the report. The injured employee was hospitalized and received treatment for the injuries sustained.

During a routine task, an employee operating a sit-down forklift accidentally caused it to tip over while navigating a turn with the clamps raised. In an attempt to escape, the employee was struck in the head by the mast of the forklift as it fell on its side, resulting in a fatal crushed skull injury.

An employee operating a skid loader accidentally broke through ice covering an abandoned manure pit and was submerged for approximately 20 minutes before being rescued by emergency personnel. Despite efforts to save him, the victim was later pronounced dead at Hennepin County Medical Center.

During operation of a skid sprayer on the golf course, an employee was blinded by a white light while attempting to cross over a bridge. The employee steered left, causing the machine to go through the guard rail and into the water below, landing on the employee's ankle. The injured employee was transported to the hospital for medical treatment.

An employee was operating a skid steer loader, pulling on a building scheduled to be dismantled when the strap holding the loader to the building snapped. This caused a 55 foot wide by 100 foot long section of the building to collapse. Thankfully, no injuries occurred as a result of the incident.

During operation of a slitter, an employee suffered an amputation while trying to remove a jammed part. The initial accident report did not specify which body part was amputated. The injured employee was taken to the hospital for treatment.

While operating a Soft Gel TS-SG10 Encapsulation Machine in the encapsulation room, an employee noticed liquid spreading out from the machine. As they tried to investigate, their small finger got caught between a rotating roller and a fixed side of the machine, resulting in the amputation of the tip of their pinky finger on their left hand.

During a routine operation of a stand up forklift, an employee attempted to prevent the forklift from hitting a rack by using his hand as a stop. Unfortunately, the employee ended up fracturing his left hand and required surgery to repair the damage. The employee was subsequently hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.

An employee operating a stand-up forklift lost control while backing it into a parking space, leading them to jump off to avoid injury. Unfortunately, the employee broke several bones in their foot upon landing and had to be hospitalized for treatment.

The employee was operating a stand-up forklift with his foot hanging off the edge when he backed into a parked forklift, crushing his foot in between the two vehicles. This resulted in a fractured left foot and the employee was hospitalized as a result of the incident.

During operation of a stand-up forklift, an employee's hand got caught between a handrail and the forklift after momentarily losing control when one of the steering wheels hit a hole. As a result, the employee's fingertips of two fingers were amputated.

An employee was operating a stand-up lift. The employee put the lift in reverse and the brake did not engage as it was suppose to.  The employee sustained a heel fracture when he was caught between the lift and wall.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.
An employee was operating a standup truck. The stand up truck struck a dock leveler and the employee was ejected from the truck. The employee sustained fractured ribs.
An employee was operating a standup vehicle. The employee's leg was caught between the vehicle and a dolly and the employee sustained a laceration to the leg.

While operating a steel sheet metal production machine in automated mode, an employee's right hand became caught in the nip point of two rotating horizontal rollers used for pulling steel sheet from a coil. The employee suffered a degloving injury to his right hand and was hospitalized for two days after surgery at the University of Wisconsin Medical Center.
An employee was operating a table saw.  The employee's finger was pulled into the saw blade by material being cut and amputated their right hand ring finger.

An employee was operating a table saw. After using the saw to cut a piece of dry wall, the employee used his left hand to remove some debris, when his hand contacted the saw blade. The employee's left index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was operating a track hoe feeding a concrete crusher.  The employee was crushed when he climbed into the crusher's feed hopper and fell into the crushing chamber while it was operating.
An employee was operating a tractor along a farm road. The employee drove the tractor into a drainage canal and drowned.

The employee was operating a transloader to dispense material from a railroad car and attempting to adjust the volume by stepping onto the running conveyor belt. Unfortunately, he was drawn into the head of the transloader and crushed, resulting in his death. It was discovered during the investigation that the safety bar sensor had been bypassed, allowing the machine to continue running despite the employee's presence on it.
An employee was operating a tug pulling three dollies each loaded with one can.  The employee fell of the tug, was run over by the first dolly, and killed.

An employee operating a vertical broach machine attempted to retrieve a part before the machine completed its cycle. As a result, the employee's finger was caught by the passing broach tool and was amputated. The incident occurred because the machine was designed to cycle three times before completion, but the employee reached in after only two cycles.

An employee was operating a vertical mill when the employee's index finger was caught between the tooling and work piece. The employee had the tip of their index finger amputated and was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was operating a Walker zero-turn riding mower. He tried to drive the mower under a 5-millimeter (0.1875-inch) steel alloy chain. The chain pinned his neck against the plastic box that contained the grass clippings. He sustained neck injuries, and he was asphyxiated.
An employee was operating a wood logging crane when he suffered a heart attack and died.

During the operation of a Z Spray fertilizer spreader, an employee's glove got caught in the agitator pin of the lower assembly while trying to push damp fertilizer material into the hopper. The employee sustained abrasions and superficial lacerations to the fingers, requiring stitches.

An employee was operating an aerial lift prepping a surface to be painted.  The employee drove the aerial lift off an uneven surface causing it to tip over.  The employee was ejected from aerial lift. The employee suffered head trauma and later died from his injuries.

While operating an aerial lift, an employee was moving from one side of the building to another to address a leaking pipe. The employee, facing the controls, accidentally struck an angle iron covered by a tarp with his back, resulting in a fatal injury.

An employee operating an Altec bucket truck for elevated repairs slipped and fell approximately 7 feet to the ground after unhooking his d-ring and exiting the bucket during a rainstorm. The employee suffered fractures to his elbow and a transverse process in his spine.

During operation of an assembly press machine, an employee's glove got caught on the turn table, pulling his left index finger into the air cylinder and resulting in its amputation. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injury.

The incident involved an employee operating an automated box making machine which malfunctioned and became jammed. In an attempt to reach the jam, the employee bypassed a guard and used his left hand, resulting in a partial amputation of his left middle finger when the machine was inadvertently activated.

An employee was operating an automated gang saw or flat bed saw. The employee loaded a new part and reached into the point of operation to clean out debris. The clamp came down, caught his hand, and partially amputated the little finger on his left hand.

An employee operating an Edgar chipper machine entered the conveyor belt to retrieve a fallen board when his shirt got caught in a roller bed conveyor drive shaft, pulling him in. The employee suffered an amputation at the left arm elbow, multiple contusions on his right side, and broke several ribs on his right side. He was hospitalized as a result of the incident.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. The employee was caught between the electric pallet jack handle and a building column. The employee sustained contusions and compression injuries to the chest.

An employee was operating an electrical capstan.  The employee caught one of his fingers between the 5/16 wire cable and the spool, resulting in amputating the fingertip.  The employee was not hospitalized.
An employee was operating an excavator during site clearing.  the employee became stuck between the cab and the arm of the machine. The employee was crushed and killed due to his injuries.

An employee was operating the compactor and spraying water on the fill dirt in the foundation area. Later, the employee was found dead and buried by the fill dirt outside of the foundation area.

While operating hydraulic tongs on the rig floor, an employee was hit by a 5.5 inch well casing that detached from the elevators when being lifted. The employee suffered from broken bones and internal bleeding in the head and neck area, resulting in their death.
An employee was operating the industrial magnetic based drill.  The employee's safety vest vest was caught-in the drill mechanism. The employee became tangled, choked and he was killed.

An employee was operating the ROCO machine. The employee walked into the working area of the machine without locking it out and became trapped in the machine. The employee was crushed and killed when a hydraulic table came down on his torso.
An employee was operating the up-ender machine.  The employee became caught-in between the frame and the lifting forks of the up-ender machine and was crushed and killed.

While operating the Weber Bag Machine #10 in manufacturing dog food bags, an employee crawled underneath the machine to clean up a glue spill. The incident occurred while an employee was outside a vehicle attaching a trailer. Unable to slide the tandems forward, the employee used a hammer from the cab to retract the locking pin. In the process, the employee was crushed between the trailer and tire, resulting in a fatal injury.
An employee was overcome by carbon monoxide and was hospitalized.  No further details were provided in the initial report.

During the loading of concrete jersey barriers onto a low boy trailer, an employee directed a loader operator to straighten out a barrier on the trailer. During packing on line 11, an employee dropped his pen and bent down to pick it up near the running conveyor. Unfortunately, his arm got caught in the conveyor, resulting in a fractured arm.

An employee was painting a valve located approximately 4 inches from floor. The poly tubing came undone and water from the seal-leg dropped, dropping pressure and releasing chlorine gas. The employee inhaled chlorine gas and was hospitalized.
An employee was painting a wall while standing on a ladder. The employee fell to the ground, fractured his femur, and was hospitalized.
An employee was painting and fell off a ladder to the ground. The employee was killed from a skull fracture.
An employee was painting from a ladder . The employee fell and was killed from head injuries.
An employee was painting from an unguarded scaffold. The employee fell 12 feet and suffered a head injury. The employee was killed.

An employee voluntarily painted interior doors in a well-ventilated garage while wearing a respirator. He suffered cardiac arrest while working alone and was found unresponsive by a co-worker. Despite being transported to a local hospital, he was pronounced dead from cardiac arrest.

An employee was painting on a platform/scaffold approximately 13 feet above the ground.   The platform was created using the landing of the stairs and a ladder.  The employee fell from the platform and was killed.

An employee was painting the exterior of a two story residential home while working from an extension ladder.   The employee, the owner of the company, fell from the ladder and died from blunt force trauma.

During a routine task of painting window trim, an employee fell from a 24-ft ladder that shifted while placed under the eave of a building. Despite safety precautions, the employee tragically died from a broken neck and head fracture(s) due to the fall.

During a cargo ship pipe discharge operation, an employee fell approximately 40 feet from the hold to the lower surface. During dismantling of cantilever scaffolding, two steel cables snapped causing scaffold collapse. An employee fell into canal below and drowned due to lack of tie-off to anchor point with harness and lanyard. Tragic incident during dismantling process.

An employee was part of the crew rigging a large control unit from an upper work platform.  The employee fell 20-25 ft. from the platform to the surface below suffering head injuries. The employee was killed.

An employee with documented chemical sensitivity experienced symptoms of overexposure to xylene during a meeting in a conference room adjacent to a facility laboratory where the ventilation hood fan failed. An employee was participating in a meeting when he suddenly collapsed and lost conscience. The employee was taken to a nearby hospital, where he was admitted and treated for cardiac arrest.

While patrolling a hot lot at an intermodal yard, an employee driving a pickup truck collided with a parked empty cargo container trailer. An employee was patrolling his location. The employee fell from dock approximately 43 inches above a lower level, and struck his head. The injury resulted in comatose state. The employee later died of injuries.

During a tool change on a CNC machine, an employee forgot which step of the process they were on and their finger was caught in a pinch point between the tool and the product being worked on. As a result, the tip of the employee's middle finger was amputated.

An employee was performing an inspection ofan amusement ride track system.  The employee's right thumb tip was pinched between a track rail and was amputated.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.

A tragic incident occurred at a multi-unit residential building where an employee, while performing carpentry work, fell from the roof after not wearing fall protection. The employee landed on a concrete sidewalk and tragically lost their life as a result of the fall.

An employee was performing carpentry work involving building walls. The employee was exiting the second story down the ladder to use restroom, when he fell from the ladder or ladder landing (10 foot 4 inches). The employee sustained a fractured skull and was killed. was killed.
An employee was performing cleanup of a work area.  The employee fell through a floor opening/shaft.  The employee struck rocks on the ground, received head trauma and broken bones and was killed.
An employee was performing crossing guard activities when an 18 wheeler struck and killed her.
An employee was performing demolition work on a wall.  The  employee was killed when a large section of the wall collapsed and crushed the temporary platform the employee was working.

An employee at a nightclub complained of feeling ill while working as a disc jockey. During annual maintenance of a residential heating and air conditioning system with a dehumidifier in the crawl space, an employee was found by the homeowner at approximately 6:00 PM. An employee was performing general sweeping, cleaning and de-junking of the work area.  A metal floor opening cover was removed.  The employee fell thru the unguarded floor opening approximately 29 feet to a lower floor.  The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm and a minor head injury.

An employee performing groundsman duties in excessive outdoor heat collapsed and became unconscious on the job site. Emergency responders were called, and the employee was hospitalized but ultimately passed away from heat stroke.

An employee was exposed to Legionaries Disease while performing routine work activities, likely from contaminated water mists in the air. During a housekeeping task, an employee was struck by a falling upper concrete wall that had become unstable due to wall flashing removal. During a routine grass mowing task at a cemetery, an employee was operating a riding lawn mower near a flowering crab tree in the horseshoe section. An employee was performing lay-out activities near an open hole where an extrusion machine was to be erected later in the day.  The employee fell approximately 21 feet and was killed from injuries to his head from the fall.

An employee was performing logging operations.  He was cutting down a tree which fell and struck him. He was killed.

An employee was performing paving near railroad tracks. The employee stood up during a break and subsequently fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized.

During punch list duties on the 2nd floor of an apartment, an employee fell through an opening in the floor to the 1st floor, resulting in fatal injuries to their head, neck, and torso. An employee was performing repairs on a stackable dryer unit and he was electrocuted.

During repairs on a scrap conveyor system, an employee's right index finger became caught in the sprocket and chain motor pulley, leading to a partial amputation. The injured employee was rushed to the hospital for treatment of his injury.

An employee was performing road construction work. While sealing cracks in the pavement, the employee was struck by a motor vehicle driven by a private citizen who entered the work zone. The employee was killed due to contusions, lacerations, and broken bones resulting from the incident.
An employee was performing roofing work.The employee fell from the roof and hit the ground. The employee was killed. mployee fell from the roof and hit the ground. The employee was killed.

During a supervision session, an employee's right hand finger got caught in between two guide paper rollers of a paper converter machine, causing it to be amputated. An employee was performing their janitorial duties at client's location.  The employee was found sitting in the lobby with his cell phone next to his side. The employee had prior heart surgery and was under the care of a cardiologist.  The employee suffered a heart attack and died.

While performing tree trimming in an aerial lift mounted GMC 7500 truck, an employee was ejected from the bucket and fell 50 feet onto asphalt after the lift arm pushed down on a limb, causing it to break. An employee was performing trim work around windows. The employee was cleaning up the roof from working on the windows when he fell. The employee sustained blunt force trauma and was killed. was killed.

An employee was performing work from the basket of an aerial lift.  The lift was extended to a height of 20 feet when he fell from the basket.  Employee #1 struck his head on the ground and was killed.

An employee was picking oranges. As he moved a ladder to another position on the orange tree he was working, it came into contact with a 50 KV utility line. The employee received an electric shock, sustaining burns on his hands and feet, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

An employee picking parts was found slumped over a tub of parts, prompting a coworker to call emergency medical services. The employee suffered severe injuries to his chest and abdomen, ultimately leading to his death.

An employee bypassed a safety guard to retrieve a plastic bottle that had fallen from a conveyor belt. The employee was hospitalized for treatment. The incident occurred on a Bottle Unscrambler Machine, Model Number AU-6C and Serial Number 3656.
An employee was picking up traffic control devices on a bridge. The employee jumped from the bridge unaware of the long drop to the ground. The employee suffered a broken arm.
An employee was picking up trash beside an interstate highway. The employee's cowboy blew into oncoming traffic. The employee chased the hat and was struck and killed by car trailer.

The employee was tragically killed while picking up tree limbs when a 150 foot tree uprooted and struck them on the head. The impact caused the employee to be thrown onto the ground, where their head struck a sharp rock. Despite wearing a hard hat, the injuries sustained were fatal.

The incident involved an employee who was placing a cabinet on the conveyor of a case clamp machine. An employee was placing a spindle onto its support bracket when his right index finger was crushed between the bar and plate. The tip of the finger was amputated, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

During the construction of a modular home component, an employee slipped while reaching to caulk the top plate of a wall and fell to the ground between the catwalk and setback. An employee was placing dough into the roller machine to make noodles. As the employee was placing the dough, the employee's finger tips got caught in the rollers. The employee's right index and middle fingers were amputated.

An employee was placing metal into a punch press when it slid from the equipment and struck her ankle. The employee sustained a broken ankle, which she was hospitalized and received treatment.

An employee fell 39 feet 6 inches through a floor opening to a concrete floor while trying to cover the opening with metal decking sheets. Despite being awake and breathing when emergency responders arrived, the employee later died as a result of the fall.

While placing pieces onto a die, an employee accidentally activated a punch press with her right hand, crushing her left hand and leading to the amputation of three fingers. An employee was placing rake angles underneath the roof system. The employee fell 19 feet to the ground after climbing out of scissor lift. He struck the back of his head against the pavement and was killed.

An employee was placing tar paper on the outside wall of a structure. The employee was mounting a 6 foot stepladder when he lost his balance and fell on to the concrete floor.  He sustained contusions to his face and head.

An employee was placing wet concrete when the floor collapsed because it was not properly braced.  The employee fell and was struck by debris. The employee was injured and hospitalized for their injuries.

An employee was placing wood flooring in residential establishments and applying aluminum oxide to treat the flooring. The employee inhaled aluminum oxide, sustained lung damage, and was killed due to asphyxiation.
An employee was planning some conduit routing when he tripped over an unprotected edge and fell to the floor, striking his head as he fell.  The employee had a head injury and multiple body injuries.

An employee was planting apple trees.  The employee had a headache, and went to rest for the headache to pass.  The employer took the employee to the hospital as soon as other symptoms were noticed.  The employee suffered brain aneurysm and died.

An employee planting broccoli sprouts complained of nausea and threw up, then later reported chest pains and nausea in his car. Despite not feeling well, he refused medical help and eventually passed away, likely due to a heart attack. The death was determined to be from natural causes.
An employee was plastering the inside wall of a new silo. The scaffold platform failed and the employee fell. The employee was killed due to fall.

An employee was plugging the electrical cord into the genset to get the generator started. As  he was standing on the back of the truck, the employee fell and hit his head on the asphalt. The employee was killed in the fall.

The employee was polishing granite beside a white cabinet with a Hercules VS Wet Rear Exhaust Air Polisher. The polisher was connected to a water hose without proper drainage. The employee fell and was found by the production manager, and unfortunately, was killed in the incident.

An employee was polishing the metal shaft on a U.S. Industrial lathe, when a part of his clothing became caught. The employee's left arm was pulled into the lathe's rotating parts. He sustained a fracture to his left arm, which he was hospitalized and received treatment.

An employee collapsed and died of a heart attack while pooling concrete with two coworkers. He had sat down to rest on a truck bumper after indicating he wasn't feeling well. His coworkers attempted CPR and called 911, but he was pronounced dead at the hospital.

While trying to unlock the padlock on a semi-trailer, an employee was tragically pinned between the Ford F350 and the semi-trailer when the truck rolled backward. An employee was positioning a piece of wood in a Copecrafter wood shaper instrument, which is used to clamp pieces of wood into position prior to cutting. While his finger was in the clamp, the pneumatic clamp activated, partially amputating the tip of one of his fingers.

An employee was positioning an aerial lift to remove existing gutters from structure. While operating the aerial lift, the employee was killed due to asphyxiation when he was crushed between the lift basket and the roof soffit.

While positioning asphalt sheet feed material into rollers, an employee accidentally hit the power button with his hand causing him to get caught in the unguarded machine. Due to lack of support from coworkers, the employee sustained ligament damage and strains on wrist tendons and hand.

An employee was pouring concrete. While pouring concrete, he was  placing concrete that had a failure in the concrete pump and the end section fell on the employee. The employee was killed from blunt force injuries to his upper back.

During a procedure where hot aluminum was being poured into a flask to create a mold, the metal violently erupted and splashed onto the employee's face and neck. During a metal casting process, three employees were splashed with molten steel that "burped" from the mold, despite wearing protective equipment. An employee was power washing garbage trucks. During work, some of the chemical concentrate used in the power washer came into contact with the employee's boots. The chemical leeched through his boots, causing the employee to sustain chemical burns to his feet and calves.

An employee was power washing the exterior of a residential home and fell into the pool; drowning themselves.   No other specifics were provided in the initial report fics were provided in the initial report

An employee was preparing a sewer stub for a manhole installation. During work, sheathing that had been used as shoring was removed, causing the soil around the sewer pipe to collapse. The employee's right leg became trapped and was fractured, requiring hospitalization for treatment.

While preparing chemicals to clean a 1,000 gallon tank at a host farm site, an employee inadvertently created chlorine gas by mixing an acid-based cleaner and a chlorine-based cleaner. An employee was preparing Delmag manufactured pile driving equipment for operation. The employee was struck and killed by a plywood block cushion installed between the hammer and concrete pile.

An employee was preparing powdered metal samples. While operating a hydraulic stripper press, the employee's right pinky was caught in the press resulting in amputation of the finger to the second knuckle.

During the preparation of a car carrier deck, an employee slipped and fell backward onto the bottom deck. While preparing a 3,000 pound inner steel form for septic tank production, an employee used a 10 ton gantry crane with a smaller swivel hook without a safety latch. While working underneath the form to apply tape and form oil, the form fell and crushed the employee, resulting in their death.

During a maintenance task on the roll grinding machine, an employee failed to disconnect the pneumatic line to the tensioner while changing the tensioning wheel. An employee was preparing to check valves in the treater shack. The treater shack caught fire and the employee was burned to death.
An employee was preparing to close out for the end of the day, when he collapsed and died.

An employee preparing to connect a residential drop cable to a transformer made contact with the secondary bushings, resulting in an electric shock. The employee was preparing to begin window cleaning using a Sky Genie Rope Descent System on a four-story building when they fell over the parapet wall, struck a metal awning, and landed 70 feet below to the ground. While preparing to work on a well system, an employee positioned the truck to access the well head. The employee suffered electrical burns to the right hand and forearm and tragically lost their life due to the accident.

A 65-year-old male truck driver was killed after being pinned between his semi-truck and a parked trailer at a facility. An employee was preparing to install reinforcing steel on a concrete form. The employee fell off a 12 foot tall wooden concrete form and is killed.

An employee was sharpening his chain saw when a 27 foot log struck the employee.  The log caused multiple blunt force trauma and the employee died.

An employee was sharpening the blades on a Toro 580-D ground master mower.  The 57 inch mower deck came down and pinned the employee under the deck and against the fender of the trailer the mower was sitting on. The employee was killed.
An employee was shot and killed by a home owner during a service call to repair a furnace.

An employee was shoveling dirt away from the base of a bridge abutment.  The adjacent trench wall collapsed on top of the employee, covering him with soil and rock.  The employee was killed from blunt force trauma to their torso.
An employee was shoveling dirt into a pile at the bottom of a trench.  The employee was pushed into a concrete retaining wall when an earthen wall burst.  The employee was killed from head trauma.

An employee was shoveling rock and breaking concrete in one of the bays, when another contractor plumbed a pillar which pulled on a K joist attached to the wall with nails.  The joist fell off the wall and struck the employee and he was killed.

An employee was shoveling snow off the roof of a building. After completing removal of the snow, the employee jumped from the roof and fractured a vertebrae. He was hospitalized and treated for his injury.

An employee working in a pistachio orchard began to experience cramps and was placed in a truck with air conditioning by his foreman. After mumbling and showing signs of distress, the foreman rushed the employee to a nearby clinic. Sadly, the employee was later transferred to Madera Community Hospital where he passed away from a subarachnoid hemorrhage.

An employee was sitting at her desk working. The employee stopped responding to a conversation with her co-worker in an adjacent office.  When that co-worker entered the office to see what was wrong, the employee was slumped over her desk and unresponsive.
An employee was sitting at their desk and was found unconscious.
An employee was sitting down in a chair when they lost their balance and fell backward. The employee suffered a right femur fracture.  The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.
An employee was sitting down on a bench. He fainted and fell on the  platform floor on the 207th Street Terminal (A Line). The employee died from cardiac arrest.

An employee was sitting down on a metal bleacher step in front of Line No. 1 CD Filter. There were eight manhatches along Line No 1 CD Filter pressure vessel. The third door, which measured 24-in. diameter, from the right side blew out. The employee was struck and was found on the floor below.

While an employee was sitting in a chair near a freight trailer being loaded with palleted and crated freight for an exhibitor's booth, a forklift operator accidentally dropped a load that struck the employee's ankle. The impact resulted in a fracture, and the employee had to be hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was sitting on a ladder.  The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete ground below, and was killed as a result of multiple skull fractures.

An employee sitting on a step near the unscrambler platform had their hand caught in an unguarded chain sprocket assembly while trying to stand up. The employee sustained injuries to four fingers on their right hand, resulting in the amputation of the middle finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was sitting on the back of a gator vehicle. The vehicle moved and the employee fell onto the floor and sustained a concussion.

The employee fell approximately 14 feet after sitting on a metal trellis joist without proper fall protection. Despite wearing a harness, the employee was not connected to anything, resulting in a fatal accident as he hit a railing or wall before landing on the concrete pool deck below.
An employee was sitting outside of the facility in a patio chair on break. The employee was shot three times in the head and neck and was killed

An employee was skiing and conducting border maintenance. While making a right turn in heavy snow her right ski had a pre-release causing her to continue forward into a tree.  Blunt force trauma from the collision with the tree caused a liver laceration and hospitalization.

The employee was skiing on their lunch break at a ski resort when a snowboarder lost control and caused them to swerve off the slope and land on rocks. Despite wearing a helmet and not appearing to have head trauma, the employee was killed as a result of being impaled on the rocks.
An employee was sleeping in a trailer. The employee was found unresponsive and the coroner stated that the employee did from cardiovascular disease.

The employee was using a meat cutting band saw to slice pork tenderloin and did not turn off the machine between cuts. Their left hand slipped off the meat and came into contact with the cutting blade, resulting in the amputation of their left ring finger tip. This incident may have been prevented if the employee had followed the employer's rules for operating the band saw.

During operation of the mandrel mold press, an employee's right index finger was crushed when the equipment was unintentionally activated. The employee suffered an amputation between the 1st and 2nd knuckle of the right index finger, as well as full depth burns on multiple parts of the right hand. The press's upper die plate contained two 300 degree heating elements.

An employee was sorting pistachios inside an air-conditioned building. The employee suddenly fainted, suffering from dehydration and heat illness. He was not drinking the provided water. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was sorting potatoes for processing.  The employee began to feel ill and went into the break room to relax.  The employee was overcome with weakness and dizziness and was hospitalized.

The employee was injured while sorting pan decking on stacked structural steel when a piece of decking caught his glove, causing him to lose his balance and fall 13 feet 2 inches onto concrete below. He suffered a concussion, fractured nose, and femur bone as a result of the fall.

An employee was speaking to a co-worker in training. The unguarded foot pedal was engaged, causing a platform to rise, catching the employee's fingertips. The employee's left index and middle fingertips were amputated. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was speaking to his supervisor. While speaking with his supervisor, he uttered a groan and began to collapse. The employee died from natural causes, hypertrophic atherosclerotic heart disease.
An employee was splicing a cable 20 feet above ground level while on a ladder.  The employee fell  from the ladder and struck their head on the ground and was killed.

An employee was using a tractor-mounted plastic tarp roller to spool drip tape, twine, and hose material from a row of berries when his foot became caught in the materials being spooled. The employee was pulled against the spool, causing him to strike his head and torso on the ground multiple times. The employee was fatally wedged between the spool rim and the ground, and was pronounced dead at the scene.

Tragically, an employee lost his life at a gas well hydraulic fracturing site while spotting a truck backing up to a sand silo. The employee was pinned between the truck's bumper and a support beam on the silo, sustaining fatal crushing injuries to his left side at the hip.
An employee was spotting the truck backing up. The employee was ran over by truck and killed.

An employee was spotting/directing a six-wheel, dump body truck, operating in reverse. The dump truck struck and crushed the employee as it was backing up and rolled over his body. Employee #1 was pronounced dead and  sustained multiple traumatic injuries.

An employee fell to his death while spray painting the stairwell walls on the fourth floor of a four-story apartment building. The employee lost his balance while standing on the outside edge of the stair tread and fell to the bottom of the third floor landing, striking his forehead. Despite being transported to the hospital, he was pronounced dead shortly after arrival.

An employee was spraying epoxy varnish on the field coils of a direct current electric motor. The employee had finished spraying epoxy varnish on the electric motor and fell on to an energized field coil lug on the motor. The employee was killed from electrical contact.

During a fireproofing job, an employee fell from a tubular welded scaffold while attempting to untangle a spray hose caught in an HVAC bracket. The fall caused the employee to sustain soreness, bruises, and pain in his back, neck, and legs.

An employee was killed while spraying herbicide on an irrigation pipe on a steep earthen dam while riding an ATV. The ATV, heavily loaded with cargo, overturned onto the employee while ascending a steep berm. It is suspected that the wet grass from prior rain may have contributed to the accident. There were no witnesses to the incident.

During the course of applying silicone on a church roof, an employee fell accidentally from a height of 40 ft, where he wasn't wearing any protective equipment. The employee hit a wooden roof, a cement bench, and ultimately the ground while sliding down the roof. The employee succumbed to his injuries, including broken ribs, internal injuries, and a fractured skull.
An employee was spraying wall texture in a bathroom and collapsed. The employee was found unresponsive by co-workers.

During a routine maintenance task, an employee was spraying water onto a conveyor belt when their rain suit became entangled in the rotating shaft of the conveyor. Tragically, the employee was caught between the gearbox and motor, resulting in fatal asphyxiation due to neck compression.
An employee was spraying weeds from a 6 by 6 ATV.  The employee lost control and was caught underneath the ATV when it rolled over.  The employee was killed.
An employee was spreading sawdust for bedding with a skid steer.  The employee backed in a manure pit, fell, and was killed. killed.

An employee was squatting at a job site near the shaft.  The employee reach out to steady themselves as the employee stood. However, they grabbed onto a running shaft and the employee suffered finger trauma as well as amputating a fingertip.

The employee was stacking lumber onto a conveyor in the Green Chain area when his coat became caught between the chain and sprocket. In an attempt to retrieve a fallen board, he was pulled into the sprocket and chain, resulting in his death as his head became trapped between the sprocket and mounting brace.

While preparing masonry bricks for hoisting at a construction site, an employee was struck on the head by a metal pulley that detached from an outrigger approximately 21 feet high. Despite emergency services being contacted, the employee tragically passed away 13 days later from blunt force trauma and brain swelling.

An employee was stacking steel tables that weighed approximately 1,300 lbs used to support extruded aluminum products for storage using a fork lift truck.  The employee was struck by a table as it slid off of the forklift and struck him in the left leg, fracturing his femur.
An employee was stacking trusses.  He was caught and pulled into the finish press roller. Both of his arms were crushed and he was killed.

An employee was staging material to be removed from the mezzanine hoist area and fell 11.2 feet through an opening where a removable gate was left open.   The employee suffered a fractured left femur, sternum, and several ribs along with a spinal compression and was hospitalized.

An employee was staging plumbing tools and materials on a roof.  The employee stepped on an unprotected/unguarded semi-translucent corrugated fiberglass sky light panel and fell 16.5 feet to the concrete slab.  The employee suffered crushing injuries to their body and head and was killed onsite.

The employee was fatally injured after falling more than 27 feet below ground level while staging water heaters in an apartment building. The coworker, who was assisting in transporting the water heaters, heard a scream and discovered the employee on the ground with a trash box used for transporting the water heaters. The employee sustained massive head injuries and did not survive the fall.

An employee fell approximately 23.7 feet to the ground below while standing at the edge of a roof, providing hand signals to a forklift operator below. The employee lost his balance and tragically lost his life as a result of the fall.
An employee was standing behind a crane when its operator struck some overhead power lines with the boom.  The employee was electrocuted and killed.

An employee was standing behind a dump truck when the Bobcat operator backed up pinning the employee between the two vehicles. The employee sustained blunt force trauma in the chest area and was killed.
An employee was standing behind a tractor trailer that was in reverse-gear. The trailer crushed the employee against the loading dock and he was killed.

An employee was standing beside the unguarded self-cleaning tail-pulley on the belt conveyor at a recycling center.  The employee was caught in the nip point on the unguarded tail-pulley on the conveyor.  The employee was crushed and died.

Tragically, an employee was crushed between a brick wall and a cement mixing drum when a coworker used a front end loader to lift and remove the drum from the area. The operator accidentally pressed the drum against the wall with the fork attachment, resulting in the employee being fatally pinned between the two objects.

An employee was standing between the load on a forklift and the wall of a building. The emergency brake on the forklift failed and the employee got caught in between the load of the forklift and the wall of the building. The employee killed when he was crushed.
An employee was standing by a conveyor machine. He was run over by concrete truck. The employee was hospitalized and treated for fractured leg.
An employee was standing by the digger truck about to assist with pole replacement.   The employee came into contact with a power source and was electrocuted.

An employee was standing by to assist while excavation occurred. Before leaving for the day, the employee got into the excavation to get a shovel out and the side of the excavation caved in. The employee was crushed and killed.

An employee was standing close to the rear end drive differential tires for the drum de-barker. The employee was caught in between the frame and tires of the rear end drive differential tires. The employee sustained injuries to the abdomen and head  and was killed

An employee was standing forward on the right side with his back towards an excavator.  The excavator operator did not see the employee and ran over him.  The employee's mid section of his body was pinned and crushed by the excavator and the employee was killed. killed.

during the fall from the bucket truck. The incident occurred due to the limb splitting unexpectedly and pulling the bucket down, causing the employee to be catapulted from the bucket. The lack of fall protection further exacerbated the situation, resulting in a tragic outcome.
An employee was standing in a canoe in the process of changing a light bulb.  The employee lost his balance, fell out of the canoe into a lake and drowned.

While collecting traffic cones in a utility truck after completing a job, an employee was thrown from the vehicle and hit his head on the pavement. This occurred when another vehicle failed to change lanes and collided with their truck.

The incident involved an employee standing in a window opening with guardrails in place. It is believed that the employee lost their balance while straddling the guardrails and fell, resulting in fatal injuries to multiple body parts. Despite no eyewitnesses, the cause of death was determined to be traumatic blunt force injuries.

An employee was standing in a wooden apple crate. The employee fell approximately 15 feet after the crate he was in was not restrained to the powered industrial truck. The  bin tipped over and the employee was killed from fall.

An employee was standing in front of the oil storage tanker.  The employee was struck by the oil storage tanker cover/lid when the tanker exploded and was killed. Two other employees were hospitalized for unspecified injuries.

While working on an asphalt silo, an employee in a John Deere Model 325 Skid Steer was using a cutting torch to remove a brace holding open a clam-shell door. A co-worker accidentally closed the door on the employee's head, causing a fatal injury. The employee's supervisor had to cut an air cylinder to release the employee's head, but unfortunately, the employee passed away soon after.

While flagging traffic in the shutdown lane at an intersection, an employee was tragically struck and killed by a power sweeper while walking with it. The employee sustained multiple blunt force injuries, including contusions, abrasions, and fractures, ultimately resulting in asphyxia.
An employee was standing in the yard when he collapsed. The death certificate noted the employee died from cardiac arrest.

During a construction job, an employee was drilling holes into a pan deck while standing 25 feet up in a scissor-lift. The employee's glove got caught in the roto-hammer drill bit, pulling his hand in and resulting in the amputation of his left pinky finger.

The employee was found unresponsive in the lumber yard by a customer. Despite being rushed to the Emergency Room, the employee was declared dead from a brain aneurysm as per medical reports from her husband. The incident did not involve any fall or elevated surface. The coroner's report is awaited for further investigation.
An employee was standing near the back of a truck loading agricultural fertilizer.  The employee was killed when the truck backed over him.
An employee was standing near the west direction on the north side of a fog line.  The employee was struck by on-coming traffic and killed.
An employee was standing nearby an energized line.  The employee touched the energized line and was electrocuted.

An employee was fatally struck by a falling tree while standing near it as an excavator operator dug around its base to push it over. The tree unexpectedly fell towards the employee, resulting in fatal injuries to their left side.
An employee was standing next to an open trench when the side wall of the trench collapsed and he become engulfed. The employee was killed from asphyxia.

Tragically, an employee fell to the ground from a 6-foot A-frame ladder while examining an installation area for antenna cables. The employee missed a step while coming down from the ladder and struck his head on the concrete ground, resulting in a fatal injury.

The employee was climbing an 8 foot folding step ladder to access a hole in the ceiling to check for water leaks, holding only a flashlight. He fell with the ladder, suffering blunt force trauma to his head and was killed.

An employee standing on a catwalk atop a storage tank fell 25 feet to the ground when the catwalk buckled under the weight of an unsupported ladder. The employee struck their head on the ground and was killed in the incident.

During the process of unloading boxes from a docked container, an employee fell through the open space between the dock and the container floor, landing approximately 4 feet below on the ground. The impact resulted in the employee sustaining a fractured pelvis, leading to hospitalization and treatment for the injury.

While using a step ladder to cut wood with a circular saw, the employee either fell and accidentally struck his inner leg with the saw, or brought the saw down and hit his leg. Unfortunately, the employee suffered a severe laceration to his femoral artery and passed away due to significant blood loss before receiving medical treatment.

An employee was attaching a tarp to a wall while standing on a makeshift platform raised by a forklift. While using a drill, the platform slid from the forks of the forklift causing the employee to fall 4 feet to the concrete floor below, resulting in fractured knee caps.
An employee was standing on a ladder and fell. The employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee was standing on a ladder clearing a jam from a conveyor. The employee fell and fractured his left (humerus) arm.
An employee was standing on a ladder jack scaffold and one of the support ladders collapsed. The employee sustained contusion to head and multiple body parts ground and was killed.

The employee was disconnecting a water supply hose from a Boeing 777 when he was knocked off the ladder by high winds and heavy rain. He landed feet first on the pavement below, fracturing his femur. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for his injuries.
An employee was standing on a ladder.  The employee fell from the ladder to the floor and was killed as a result of head injuries.
An employee was standing on a ladder. He fell and fractured his lumbar discs. The employee was hospitalized and treated for his injuries.
